It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it dissolves into ink): as an action expend 1 to cast comprehend languages (written only) or illusory script, or 2 to write up to 10 words in the sky in cloud or smoke for as long as you concentrate (up to 1 hour) or until a moderate wind disperses them.

magic-item:archivist-s-key.description: As an action, turn it to summon a door over 1 minute, duplicating magnificent mansion with an extra library of shifting books, scrolls, and maps where the GM sets checks to find specific knowledge. When the spell ends, it can't be used for 24 hours.

magic-item:arista-wand-of-the-spire.description: It has 7 charges, all regained at dawn (a non-wizard spending the last rolls a d20; on a 1 it returns to the Spire of Aristaeus). Each once per dawn, cast create or destroy water, floating disk, fog cloud, gaseous form, identify, or sanctuary; expend 1 charge to cast magic missile (2nd level at 9th, 3rd at 13th). Up to 3 variant properties active at once, chosen on attunement or a long rest by prerequisite: 5th level, +1 spell attack and DC (+2 at 9th, +3 at 17th); 5th-level wizard, unseen servant at will; 9th level, 2 charges for a 60-foot line of wind (Constitution save, 3d6 piercing plus 3d6 cold, pushed 15 feet) or a 15-foot whirlpool within 60 feet (Strength save, 4d6 bludgeoning, pulled 10 feet); 9th-level wizard, 3 charges for banishment and permanent see invisibility; 13th level, 10-foot truesight; 13th-level wizard, arcanist's magic aura 1, dimension door 2, private sanctum 2, fog cloud (1-mile radius) 4, guards and wards 4, etherealness 5, teleport 5; 20th-level wizard, all properties. Destroyed only after 100 years in an antimagic field on the Ethereal Plane.

magic-item:armor-of-icarus.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn; as an action expend 1 to fly 60 feet straight toward a bright light you can see without provoking, then glide (falling 30 feet per round with a 30-foot horizontal flying speed) until you land unharmed.

magic-item:arrow-of-anchoring.description: A 1-pound chained arrow or bolt. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is grappled for 1 minute (action to repeat the save), or has its speed halved until your next turn on a success. It then becomes a 2-foot nonmagical chain.

magic-item:astral-caltrops.description: Spread over a 5-foot square as an action, they float nearly invisible (DC 20 Perception to notice). A creature entering makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or stops, takes 1 piercing damage, and the caltrops explode for 6d6 force damage, levitating it 20 feet with speed 0 for 1d4 rounds (ending if it takes damage). Unused caltrops can be gathered in 1 minute.

magic-item:astronomer-s-boon.description: Viewing the night sky shows constellations, and once per dusk as an action with its command word you gain one found constellation's stars until the next dusk. The Drum (3 stars): as a reaction on initiative, you and allies within 10 feet gain +1 and can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action on the first turn. The Knight (5 stars): spend one on your melee hit, or as a reaction on an ally's melee hit within 30 feet, for an extra 1d4 radiant damage. The Seer (4 stars): as a bonus action touch a creature, which can add 1d4 to one check or save within 10 minutes.

magic-item:aurora-dust.description: A bag of 1d6 + 4 pinches. As an action sprinkle one on a flame to turn it blue, green, and purple with a shimmering aurora, lasting as long as the flame (up to 24 hours).

magic-item:badge-of-the-savant.description: A platinum bookplate for a school of magic; while on your spellbook, copying spells of that school costs half the gold and time. Attach or remove one as an action by expending a spell slot of level 1 + the number of badges already attached (maximum 9th).

magic-item:badge-of-the-wayfarer.description: Reciting its secret command phrase over 1 minute casts plane shift to the Wayfarer's Respite, a luxurious astral inn, returning you after 24 hours (or earlier by casting it again); then unusable for 7 days. Identify reveals only that it's magical; legend lore reveals its phrase and purpose.

magic-item:bag-of-bellstones.description: Holds up to 20 stones (found with 1d12 + 8). A stone left in it for 1 minute and drawn out rings like a bell (audible 60 feet) when it hits anything that turn.

magic-item:ball-of-wild-earth.description: A sentient neutral pebble (Int 2, Wis 6, Cha 4; darkvision 60 feet; understands Common and Terran) that rolls at 10 feet seeking rich soil and can shape its dirt coating into figures or expressions. It has AC 10, 15 hit points, resistance to all damage, and heals fully after 1 hour buried.

magic-item:ballista-prosthesis.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature missing an arm, forearm, or hand; hand crossbow
magic-item:ballista-prosthesis.description: A prosthetic arm with a retractable hand crossbow; it can't be removed against your will and you can detach or reattach it as an action. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Its 20-bolt magazine removes the loading property (1 minute to reload). As a bonus action extend or retract the crossbow; retracted it's a normal hand, revealed by a DC 13 Investigation check.

magic-item:bandolier-of-the-elements.description: Holds 6 magic daggers. When you take the Attack action, throw one as a bonus action with a free hand; on a hit it deals an extra 1d6 acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage (roll a d6) and vanishes; on a miss it returns. 1d6 missing daggers return at dawn.

magic-item:bane-shield.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a reaction when a creature within 5 feet damages you, expend 1 to curse it: its next ability check or attack roll before the end of its next turn subtracts 1d4.

magic-item:bartender-s-armistice.description: Found in sets of 1d3 + 1 coasters. As an action with its command word, throw one to a point within 30 feet, where it fixes in place and projects a 30-foot-radius, 15-foot-high cylinder for 10 minutes. Creatures entering or starting there make a DC 15 Charisma save (they may choose to fail) or are charmed by you and indifferent to foes while inside, ending if they or their friends are harmed. Any creature attacking or casting a harmful spell into, out of, or within the field must first succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or the attack or spell is wasted. Creatures inside have advantage on Persuasion checks to deescalate violence, and a creature at 0 hit points stabilizes when the field appears. The coaster has AC 15 and 25 hit points; after a full duration there's a 10 percent chance it stays magical.

magic-item:battlechef-field-dresser.description: Hits with this rune-heated knife deal an extra 1d4 fire damage. When you reduce a living beast or monstrosity within 5 feet to 0 hit points with it, you can slice and cook a prime cut (no action required), gaining 1 ration.

magic-item:beads-of-meditation.description: While wearing or holding them, you can use an action to end one effect causing you to be charmed or frightened. Once per dawn, a cleric or paladin can use an action to regain one use of Channel Divinity, or a monk regains 1d4 + 1 ki points.

magic-item:beard-cannon.description: A hair cuff worn on hair or a beard at least a foot long, which weaves 6 beads into the hair on attunement. When you take the Attack action, forgo one attack to fire a bead (range 15/30 feet, proficient), which grows fist-sized and deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a hit. 1d6 fired beads reappear at dawn. Otherwise it's indistinguishable from a normal cuff.

magic-item:bell-of-alarm.description: A clapperless bell with 4 charges, all regained at dawn. As an action expend 1 and speak a duration of up to 8 hours; when it elapses, a ringing only you hear sounds in your ears if you're within 1 mile on the same plane. End a timer as a bonus action.

magic-item:bellhop-topper.description: A purple top hat with 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As an action expend 1 and toss it within 5 feet to duplicate floating disk, except the disk is opaque and stays within 10 feet of you; end it with an action, and it reverts to the hat.

magic-item:belt-of-the-hell-hound.description: When you make a melee attack with advantage, a hit deals an extra 1d6 fire damage. Once per dawn, as an action exhale a 15-foot cone of fire: DC 15 Dexterity save, 6d6 fire damage or half on a success, igniting unattended flammables. Curse: you can't remove it without remove curse, must eat twice the normal food (minimum 2 pounds) daily to avoid exhaustion, and when you die, and each hour you stay dead, there's a cumulative 10 percent chance your body burns to ash.

magic-item:bird-s-eye-bolt.description: As an action, fire it straight up; it vanishes in feathers and creates an invisible sensor (seen as a glowing fist-sized bird by those who see invisible) up to 120 feet directly above you for 1 minute, or until you move more than 120 feet away. As an action, see and hear through the sensor until the start of your next turn. If it hits a target instead, it's no longer magical.

magic-item:blackthorn-spear-of-the-moonl.description: You can always see its outline while attuned, even in total darkness. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a bonus action, assume the moonless hunter's spirit for up to 8 hours (ends if released as a bonus action or you're over 60 feet from the spear for more than 1 minute): you ignore exhaustion, can't sleep or benefit from a long rest, have advantage on Stealth checks, see normally in darkness (including magical) to 60 feet, gain +10 feet of walking speed, and can call the spear to your hand or feet from within 60 feet as a bonus action. Afterward you gain 1 level of exhaustion per 2 hours (minimum 1), removable only by a long rest.

magic-item:blood-moon-blade.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Small or larger living creature, it takes an extra 2d4 necrotic damage (constructs, plants, and undead are immune) and you regain hit points equal to half that necrotic damage. Curse: attuning curses you; you won't part with it, have disadvantage on attacks with other weapons unless no foe you can see or hear is within 60 feet, and regain only half hit points from magical healing other than the sword.

magic-item:bloodhound-amulet.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on ability checks that rely on smell. Once per dawn, as an action focus on one scent to see it as a red vapor for up to 1 hour.

magic-item:bloodmire-phiale.description: A ceramic bowl holding 8 ounces of blood; left undisturbed for 1 hour, it becomes a glowing tonic. Drinking it all: roll a d12; on a 12 you take 12 necrotic damage (stable if it drops you to 0), otherwise you regain 4 + the roll in hit points. Pouring it out wastes the magic. After use it can't be used again for 1d4 days.

magic-item:bloodmire-rod-of-the-witch-do.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric, druid, paladin, or warlock
magic-item:bloodmire-rod-of-the-witch-do.description: A spellcasting focus with 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dusk. As an action expend 1 to tether a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute (one of each kind at a time). Empowering (white): it regains 2d10 hit points and its first melee weapon hit each turn deals an extra 1d10 damage; on later turns expend 1 charge as a bonus action to heal it 2d10 more. Withering (red): Constitution save against your spell save DC; on a failure 2d10 necrotic damage and 1d10 necrotic as a bonus action on later turns; on a success half damage and the tether ends. The tether ends early if severed, you drop the rod, the target ends its turn over 30 feet away or behind total cover, or either of you falls unconscious.

magic-item:bloodmire-soulflame-lantern.description: On attunement an inextinguishable crimson flame lights it (bright light 30 feet, dim 30 more); as a bonus action adjust each radius between 10 and 30 feet and darken panels for a radius, cone, or no light. While carried: advantage on sight-based Perception checks; resistance to necrotic damage and immunity to disease; when reduced to 0 hit points but not killed, as a reaction spend a Hit Die to heal (once per 1d12 hours); a creature in its light that drops a living target to 0 gains 1d8 temporary hit points; truesight within its bright light; and fiends and undead in its bright light lose damage resistances and effects triggered by reaching 0 hit points. Curse: attunement lasts until wish or a powerful fey's touch ends it (persisting 7 days past death). You won't part with it, and must sacrifice a Hit Die whenever you gain or spend Hit Dice, or one as an action; if fed none for 24 hours, you die.

magic-item:bloodshard-trident.description: As a bonus action, sacrifice any number of hit points as unpreventable necrotic damage; each 5 creates a floating obsidian shard for 1 minute (maximum 3). It deals an extra 1d4 piercing damage per shard on a hit, and when thrown with at least 1 shard it returns to your hand after the attack.

magic-item:bloodthirster-scimitar.description: While holding it you have resistance to necrotic damage. When you take the Attack action, forgo one attack to take 1d6 + 3 piercing damage (ignoring resistance and immunity), gaining a cumulative +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with it for 1 minute (maximum +3); while empowered it deals an extra 1d6 necrotic damage on a hit.

magic-item:bloodthirsty-bistoury.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The dagger never shows blood, and when wielded by an evil creature, those it hits don't bleed from the attack or its wound for 10 minutes.

magic-item:bloody-marilith.description: A peppery crimson cocktail whose alcohol affects you twice as strongly as normal. Common: for 1 minute you can take one extra reaction even if you've already used yours, ending the effect. Drinking another before a long rest leaves you unable to move or act until after your next turn when the effect ends. Very rare (true marilith blood): for 1 minute you can take one reaction on every turn of combat, and using it doesn't end the effect.

magic-item:bonfire-charm.description: A glass sculpture with an ember inside; placed on a burning campfire or torch, it suffuses the light so that you and friendly creatures within it treat Hit Die rolls of 1 as 2 when spending Hit Dice on a short rest.

magic-item:book-of-clothier-s-croquis.description: Found with 2d6 + 8 pages of humanoid outlines. Spend 10 minutes drawing an outfit to charge a page; a creature holding the torn-out page can use an action and command phrase to make the clothes appear on it or transform a similar worn garment (the page turns to dust). Transformed garments lose properties their new form wouldn't have, and drawn clothes give no AC or magic. The effect lasts up to 4 hours, ending if removed or the phrase is spoken again as an action.

magic-item:book-of-instant-copying.description: A glass-covered book found with 2d10 + 30 blank pages. As an action with its command word, an object pressed under the glass (paper, leaf, fabric) is inked onto the next blank page; magic scrolls and spellbooks copy as nonsense glyphs. Rebind with 50 pages for 50 gp and 8 hours.

magic-item:bounder-s-ball.description: A playful animal spirit fetches it back whenever you throw it. Pressed onto a non-heavy weapon for 10 minutes, it attaches; as a bonus action the weapon sheds bright light 10 feet and dim 10 more, and while glowing, after any ranged attack with it the spirit returns it to your hand or feet. Remove it during a short rest.

magic-item:bow-of-the-cobra.description: Arrows you fire can be coated in acid for an extra 1d4 acid damage on a hit (nonmagical coated arrows are destroyed). It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; when you take the Attack action, expend 1 to replace one attack with acid arrow, using your attack bonus with the bow.

magic-item:bow-of-the-eldritch-archer.description: Arrows fired become force bolts dealing 1d10 force damage instead of their normal damage, keeping their magic, and are lost after the attack. Once on each of your turns when you attack with it, a creature 10 feet directly behind the target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 1d10 force damage.

magic-item:bow-of-the-spelldrinker.description: Hits deal an extra 1d4 force damage. Once per short or long rest, as a reaction when you see a creature within 60 feet cast a spell, take 30 unpreventable force damage to fire a force arrow: a spell of 5th level or lower fails, and the caster makes a DC 16 save with its spellcasting ability, taking 30 force damage or half on a success.

magic-item:bow-of-the-twilight-valkyrie.description: Once per turn when attacking with it as part of the Attack action, take a -5 penalty to channel energy. Positive: on a hit, an extra 2d6 radiant damage and the next attack roll against the target by someone else before your next turn has advantage. Negative: on a hit, an extra 2d6 necrotic damage and the target's next attack roll before the end of your next turn has disadvantage.

magic-item:bracers-of-the-iron-octopus.description: While wearing them, you gain +5 on checks and saves to resist or escape grapples. As an action with their command word, they become a giant octopus (a construct with +2 AC) within 10 feet that acts on its own initiative and obeys your mental commands within 60 feet; revert it as a bonus action, restoring its hit points. If it drops to 0 hit points, the bracers shatter.

magic-item:bramble-buckler.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger; shield
magic-item:bramble-buckler.description: Vines bind it to your arm so it can't be dropped or disarmed against your will. Once per dawn, as an action touch it to the ground to doff it into a 20-by-15-foot field of thorns duplicating spike growth without concentration; it reforms when the effect ends, or end it early as an action within 5 feet to don it again.

magic-item:brawler-s-ring.description: While wearing it, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.

magic-item:brutal-macuahuitl.description: Its obsidian edges deal bludgeoning or slashing damage (your choice). On a 20 on the attack roll against a creature, it's marked for death until the start of your next turn: it can't regain hit points, and takes 1d8 necrotic damage when the mark ends.

magic-item:bulette-bulwark.description: While held it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as a bonus action expend 1 for tremorsense to 30 feet while you concentrate, up to 1 minute.

magic-item:bulette-torpedo.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When making a ranged attack, you can throw it into the ground to burrow through dirt and unworked stone toward a creature you see or a described point within range, then return to your hand. On a 20 made this way, it erupts for an extra 1d6 bludgeoning and 1d6 slashing damage, and a Large or smaller target makes a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity save or falls prone. Prone targets don't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks with it.

magic-item:bullfrog-totem.description: A mossy 3-pound statue inhabited by a bullfrog spirit (visible to those who see invisible) that repels harmless insects in a 30-foot radius.

magic-item:burrage-s-collegiate-case.description: A lute case weighing no more than 7 pounds whose star-latch opens five compartments: up to 7 small instruments, up to 3 large instruments, 4 stools and a music stand, up to 60 organized sheets of music, and a normal lute space. Retrieving an item takes an action; non-musical items placed in the extradimensional compartments reappear beside it when closed.

magic-item:caduceus-flail.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin; flail
magic-item:caduceus-flail.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a bonus action it glows (bright light 10 feet, dim 10 more) until you repeat the command or drop or stow it; glowing, it deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage to undead. When you use Channel Divinity while it glows, hostile creatures in its bright light take 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier radiant damage and friendly ones regain that many hit points, and undead in the light that fail your Channel Divinity's save are also blinded until the end of your next turn.

magic-item:camilla-s-quicksilver-mirror.description: An unattuned holder who views their reflection makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or is frightened of it, can't look away or let go, and has speed 0 (repeat each turn or when damaged; advantage if unable to see it; success grants 24-hour immunity). Attuned, three times per dawn as an action you can make a creature within 30 feet that sees you view its reflection (DC 16 Wisdom save): either the same fright effect for up to 1 minute, or its reflection is stored (up to 3). As an action, use a stored reflection to take on that appearance as alter self's Change Appearance, lasting until dispelled; this doesn't count against the uses.

magic-item:camper-s-crutch.description: This fire poker deals bludgeoning or piercing damage (your choice). Once per dusk, as an action touch dry wood or an unattended flammable object and speak its command word to set it slowly burning.

magic-item:camper-s-respite.description: As a bonus action its brazier lights or goes out, working as a torch. As an action plant it upside down to unfold over 1 minute into a 5-foot tent of your chosen style containing a 15-foot-square, 10-foot-high extradimensional room with a stone floor, a smokeless fireplace, and a dry, comfortable atmosphere. The tent lasts up to 12 hours, until dismissed as an action, or until it takes 20 damage (AC 13; immune to poison and psychic), ejecting occupants; then 12 hours before reuse.

magic-item:candleflame-bow.description: An unremovable, never-ending candle lights or goes out as a bonus action; lit, ranged hits deal an extra 2 fire damage. Once per dawn, when you roll matching d20s on a ranged attack with advantage or disadvantage while lit, the ammunition explodes for 4d6 fire damage instead of normal damage (half if the attack missed), igniting unattended flammables within 5 feet of the target.

magic-item:candleflame-helm.description: As a bonus action, create a tiny flame above your head (bright light 15 feet, dim 15 more); as an action adjust each radius by 5 feet (10 to 30 feet). It lasts until extinguished as a bonus action, the helm is removed, or you're incapacitated.

magic-item:candy-xorn.description: Bags of 2d6 + 3 waxy candies painted with reptilian pupils. Eating one turns your eyes orange or yellow with matching pupils for 1 minute. Each has a 5 percent chance of being a sugared gemstone: eye agate (40 percent, 10 gp), tiger's eye (40 percent, 10 gp), or amber (20 percent, 100 gp).

magic-item:canister-of-vreyval-s-soothin.description: Holds 2d4 + 2 tea bags; steep one for 1 minute in boiling water. Drinking it hot (an action, but usually sipped over 1 minute) restores 1d6 + 2 hit points, grants that many temporary hit points, and suppresses charmed and frightened effects for 1 hour. Cooled tea grants half and suppresses nothing.

magic-item:captain-s-pride.description: Its longcoat bears your insignia once attuned. While wearing it, climbing and swimming cost no extra movement and you can breathe underwater. Once per dawn, as a bonus action take a watery form while concentrating, up to 1 minute: +10 feet of speed; resistance to acid and to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage; advantage to avoid or escape grapples and restraints (escaping automatically if already held); and disadvantage on Perception checks to see you underwater.

magic-item:carrion-shroud.description: While wearing it, your Constitution increases by 2 (maximum 20), and you have advantage on saves against disease and poison and resistance to poison damage. Once per dusk, as a bonus action it becomes vulture wings for 1 minute: a 60-foot flying speed, and melee weapon hits against creatures missing any hit points deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. Curse: until remove curse, you won't take it off, no longer enjoy normal food, and when you drop a creature within 5 feet to 0 hit points you make a DC 13 Wisdom save (automatic success against constructs, oozes, plants, and undead) or spend your remaining turn feasting, repeating the save each turn.

magic-item:celestial-sunrise.description: A glowing pineapple-and-honey cocktail whose alcohol affects you twice as strongly as normal. Common: for 1 hour light pours from your mouth in a cone (bright 20 feet, dim 20 more). Uncommon: the cone extends to 40 feet bright and 40 dim, and you see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness for 8 hours.

magic-item:chain-devil-gloves.description: While wearing them, ethereal chains (up to 4, reach 60 feet) attach to weapons you throw, breaking if a creature holds the weapon or you get more than 60 feet away. As an action, retract them: each creature in a weapon's path makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes force damage equal to that weapon's damage die; solid objects block the path. Weapons land at your feet or in an open hand.

magic-item:champion-s-greatbow.description: Requires Strength 13 to wield. Its damage die is a d10 and it scores a critical hit on a 19 or 20. Once per turn it can fire a javelin or spear instead of an arrow at half range; on a hit the target takes extra piercing damage equal to your Strength modifier.

magic-item:charged-rapier.description: While holding it you have resistance to lightning damage. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d4 lightning damage. If proficient, after moving at least 20 feet in a straight line, as a bonus action become lightning and streak up to 20 feet further along that line to an unoccupied space; roll d20 + 9 against each creature in the 5-foot line, dealing 1d4 + 1 lightning damage to each whose AC you meet.

magic-item:chi-balancing-tea.description: A warm, smoky brew from the monks of Durheim. Drinking it cures short-term madness and ends the charmed and frightened conditions, and a creature with 2 or more monk levels regains 1d4 + 1 ki points.

magic-item:chimeric-collar.description: Place it on a willing Medium or smaller creature as an action, bonding with a friendly beast companion or familiar. Once per dawn, as a bonus action while it's within 30 feet and you can see it, it becomes Large for up to 1 minute (until 0 hit points or ended as a bonus action), gaining 2d10 + 4 temporary hit points, understanding Draconic, growing a second head, and making two attacks (or Multiattack) when it takes the Attack action. It fails on polymorphed or transformed creatures. A dismissed familiar takes the collar with it. A creature benefits from only one magic collar at a time.

magic-item:chromatic-obsidian-greataxe.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a 20 on the attack roll, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 1d6 each of cold, fire, lightning, and radiant damage, or half on a success. Each die that rolls a 6 adds an effect: cold halves its speed until the end of your next turn; fire deals 6 more fire damage at the end of its next turn; lightning denies reactions until the end of your next turn; radiant grants advantage on the next attack against it before the end of your next turn.

magic-item:chronal-sphere.description: As a bonus action spectral clock hands show the current time (Material Plane only). As an action, cast haste or slow (save DC 18, no concentration); each spell can be cast once, after which the property is lost.

magic-item:chronomancer-s-eyepiece.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. As a reaction at the end of another creature's turn, expend 1 targeting a creature you see within 60 feet. Past: it teleports back to where it began its turn (or the nearest unoccupied space); an unwilling target makes a DC 16 Charisma save. Future: a willing target moves up to half its speed without provoking, then has halved speed until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:circlet-of-the-sharpened-mind.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature with an Intelligence score of 17 or higher
magic-item:circlet-of-the-sharpened-mind.description: Holds up to 4 gemstones (found with 2); add one worth at least 5,000 gp over 1 minute. As a special Attack action, summon spectral swords equal to its gemstones and make a melee spell attack with each against targets within 10 feet (proficient, Intelligence-based), dealing 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier force damage; the glowing swords stay until dismissed as a bonus action, you fall unconscious, or remove it, letting you repeat this once per turn. You can swap spell attacks for up to your normal number of weapon attacks, and use a reaction to make one sword attack instead of an opportunity attack.

magic-item:claymore-of-the-great-badger.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; when you hit a Large or smaller creature, expend 1 to push it 5 feet away.

magic-item:cleaning-cube.description: A dehydrated 2-inch cube that, dropped in a gallon or more of water as an action, grows into a soapy 1-foot cube for up to 8 hours (or squeeze it dry as an action). It's an object with speed 1 foot that climbs any surface, AC 10, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, fully healing when rehydrated. Sentient and unaligned (Int 1, Wis 6, Cha 1; hearing and blindsight 60 feet), it obeys simple commands, ignores combat, and absorbs small stray valuables to polish them until removed as an action.

magic-item:cloche-of-surprise-treats.description: As an action lift it and roll a d12: 1, a meal equal to a day of rations; 2 to 5, twice the roll in berries that work like goodberry for 10 days; 6 to 12, a heroes' feast for creatures equal to the roll. It can't be used again for days equal to the roll.

magic-item:clockwork-colony-toolbox.description: Metal objects left inside the closed box for 1 hour become clean and polished, and small machines are repaired. Magic items with "clockwork" in their name regain all hit points, 1d4 expended charges, and used properties. An item can be restored this way once per 24 hours.

magic-item:clockwork-earwig.description: A copper ear cuff worn or removed as an action. While worn: advantage on hearing-based Perception checks; tap to record up to 1 minute of sound and replay it privately (a new recording erases the old); and once per dawn, as an action, cast comprehend languages, ending if removed.

magic-item:clockwork-mend-a-pillar.description: A copper caterpillar (speed 5 feet) that, as an action with its command phrase, repairs a break or tear no more than 1 foot across in more than one dimension, fabricating wood, metal, stone, or crystal and taking 10 minutes per cubic foot (minimum 1 minute), then chirps. It can physically repair magic items and constructs but not restore magic. After 10 cubic feet, it rests 24 hours. It's an object with AC 10, 15 hit points, and resistance to all damage; mending restores 2d6 hit points, and at 0 it's inert for 24 hours, then fully restored.

magic-item:club-of-dancing.description: It flashes prismatic light on hits. As an action, cast dancing lights from it. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk; on a hit, expend 1 for an extra 1d6 thunder damage, and a creature makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or has speed 0 until the start of your next turn and spends its next action dancing.

magic-item:club-of-the-forest-drake.description: Once per dawn, as an action strike the ground to raise thorny vines in a 15-foot cone: DC 13 Dexterity save or take 2d6 slashing damage and be grappled for up to 1 minute (action and DC 13 Strength or Dexterity check to escape), taking 1d6 piercing damage at the end of each of its turns.

magic-item:club-of-the-rook.description: Once per dawn, as an action move up to 30 feet in a line along the ground without provoking or slowing for difficult terrain, barreling through creatures no more than one size larger than you and objects up to 400 pounds; each makes a DC 13 Strength save, taking 3d4 bludgeoning damage and falling prone, or half and not prone on a success. Structures and things too large stop you, as does impassable terrain.

magic-item:coldfire-anvil.description: A 50-pound anvil. Over a workday (half that if proficient with smith's tools), turn a nonmagical metal weapon into a coldfire weapon for 7 days: it's magical and deals an extra 1d6 cold damage, but when you roll a 1 on an attack, roll a d20; on a 9 or lower it shatters, dealing 2d6 cold damage to all creatures within 10 feet. The anvil then can't enchant again for 1d6 + 1 days.

magic-item:comet-ballista.description: It fires sling bullets, dealing bludgeoning damage plus an extra 1d6 cold damage. The first time each turn you hit with it, each creature within 10 feet of the target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes 1d6 cold damage. Once per dawn, as an action fire into the sky at a point within 120 feet to rain comets in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder: DC 13 Dexterity save, 8d6 cold damage or half on a success.

magic-item:conspirator-s-coat.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on Deception checks. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dusk; as a bonus action expend 1 to vanish into up to three ravens you control (AC 12, 1 hit point) that each fly up to 40 feet without provoking. At the start of your next turn you reappear in a raven's space of your choice; if all die you reappear where the last fell, taking any excess damage.

magic-item:contingency-band.description: Submerge it in a healing potion for 1 minute to absorb it (up to 3 stored, each lighting a serpent). Immediately after you take damage while wearing it, as a reaction gain the effect of one stored potion.

magic-item:cottage-chest.description: As an action with its command word, the 1-foot chest grows into a two-story wooden cottage, 40 by 65 feet, until dismissed as an action while empty (failing if there's no space or creatures are in the way). It holds a kitchen, dining room, parlor with an endless fire, and four furnished bedrooms; its door opens only at your bonus-action command and resists knock. Cook's utensils checks inside have advantage, and baked goods for up to 8 creatures appear daily, sustaining each for a day. Objects vanish if taken outside. Fey and fiends need your permission to enter, and teleportation, extradimensional, or planar travel can't enter it. It can't be moved; its roof, door, and each wall have 60 hit points, immunity to nonmagical weapons other than siege weapons, and resistance to other damage, repairable only by wish (one section per casting).

magic-item:courtesan-s-fanblade.description: Flicking a lever opens the dagger into a paper fan (no action), which can't attack until closed as a bonus action. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; with the fan open, as an action expend 1 or more to cast charm person (DC 13) at 1st level, plus one level per additional charge.

magic-item:covolt-dagger.description: On a critical hit, the target takes an extra 1d8 lightning damage and can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.

magic-item:covolt-scythe.description: Hits deal an extra 1d8 lightning damage, and once per turn when you hit a creature, another creature within 10 feet of it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 1d8 lightning damage.

magic-item:crown-of-storms.description: While wearing it, you have resistance to lightning and thunder damage and take none from either on a successful save for half (giants can wear it as a ring). Once per dawn, as a bonus action take the stormbringer aspect for 1 minute (end it as a bonus action): a 30-foot flying speed with hover; as an action, strike a point within 60 feet and at least 15 feet below you with lightning (creatures within 5 feet make a DC 17 Dexterity save, 4d10 lightning damage or half); as an action, cast thunderwave at 2nd level (DC 17), the first casting at 4th level; and as a reaction when an attacker within 30 feet hits you with a weapon, it makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or takes 1d10 lightning damage (half on success), repeating for each further hit that turn.

magic-item:crown-of-the-mindmaster-matri.description: While wearing it, you can cast telepathic bond as an action. Once per dawn, as an action cast dominate person with your spell save DC; a failed save also grants advantage on Charisma checks with it for 24 hours after (ending if you or allies damage it), and a creature in your telepathic bond has disadvantage on the save.

magic-item:cube-of-teleportation.description: A 3-pound cube with a stamp face that generates a new sigil sequence each dawn and five blank faces. Hold a blank face to a permanent teleportation circle for 1 hour, concentrating, to record its sequence (replacing any). It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: concentrate 1 minute with a recorded face down and expend 1 to duplicate teleportation circle to that destination. Once per dawn (or by expending 1 charge for a new sequence), concentrate 1 minute with the stamp face down to create a 10-foot destination-only circle for 1 hour, which that face can then target.

magic-item:cuff-of-captions.description: While wearing it, sounds and speech in earshot appear as illusory Common text only you see, conveying literal meaning (with similar idioms for other languages); you can dismiss ones you don't care about. You gain +2 to hearing-based Perception checks, even while deafened.

magic-item:dagger-of-first-light.description: While holding it, you have advantage on initiative rolls, and if you're first in initiative your speed increases by 15 feet for the first round. As a bonus action its blade glows (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more) and deals radiant damage instead of piercing until you end it as a bonus action.

magic-item:dark-mantle.description: While wearing it, climbing costs no extra movement and you have advantage on Athletics checks to climb. Once per dawn, as an action emit a 15-foot aura of magical darkness that moves with you while you concentrate, up to 1 minute; darkvision can't see through it, nonmagical light can't illuminate it, and it dispels overlapping light from spells of 2nd level or lower.

magic-item:davy-jones-s-key.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon (+3 underwater). On a 20 on the attack roll, the creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save or begins suffocating and can't speak, repeating the save at the end of each turn (immune if it doesn't breathe or has legendary actions). Once per dawn, as an action open a 15-foot one-way gate within 60 feet (difficult terrain) for 1 minute, through which up to 3 kraken tentacles emerge (each a Large monstrosity with AC 18, 60 hit points, 30-foot reach, immunity to conditions, +7 to checks and saves), moving freely within the gate and making reaction opportunity attacks. On arrival, and as an action thereafter, each makes a +10 melee attack for 3d6 bludgeoning damage, grappling (escape DC 17) and restraining a Large or smaller target, which takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage at the end of its turn; instead a tentacle can hurl a held target 60 feet randomly, prone, for 1d6 per 10 feet on impact (a creature struck makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or shares the damage and falls prone). It closes early if dismissed as a bonus action or you're incapacitated or die.

magic-item:dawn-and-dusk.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the light property. At dawn it becomes a spiked mace dealing an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit; at dusk, a starry sickle dealing an extra 1d6 necrotic damage.

magic-item:death-s-shadow.description: While wearing it, you're immune to necrotic damage. Once per 7 days, when you drop to 0 hit points, you control a shadow of yourself with your statistics and gear, 100 temporary hit points, and resistance to all damage except force, psychic, and radiant, which can't go more than 60 feet from your body. Meanwhile your body is veiled: immune to all damage and magic, making no death saves (a DC 30 Strength check as an action moves it 10 feet). After 1 minute the shadow returns and you regain hit points equal to its remaining temporary hit points; if it's destroyed, the amulet is too and you fail 2 death saves.

magic-item:deathloop-watch.description: Its skeletal dial shows your remaining hit points. If you die with it on your person, it reverses time to return you with 1 hit point, standing, and one of its three panes cracks permanently; each cracked pane adds a cumulative 25 percent chance it fails. With all three cracked, it's nonmagical.

magic-item:deathly-diadem.description: While wearing it, you have resistance to necrotic damage, are always under tongues, and can cast speak with dead at will (one yes, no, or maybe question per casting), and undead have disadvantage on attacks against you. Curse: revealed when you first die while attuned; you return with 1 hit point, turn evil, become undead in addition to your other types, and seek lichdom, until wish or divine intervention ends it (removing the crown doesn't).

magic-item:detective-s-notebook.description: While holding it, you gain +1 to Investigation and Insight checks, with advantage after 10 minutes of note-taking on the subject. As an action, cast comprehend languages, detect thoughts, or locate object (save DC 13); further uses before dawn each carry a cumulative 20 percent chance it tears into nonmagical tatters.

magic-item:direstone-dwarven-key.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a dwarf; handaxe
magic-item:direstone-dwarven-key.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits against stone objects are critical hits. Once per 12 hours, as an action strike a fixed stone surface up to 2 feet thick to open a doorway up to 5 feet across, closing without trace at the end of your next turn; anything inside is ejected to a random side and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

magic-item:direstone-runic-wand.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn. As an action trace a rune (spell save DC 15): Algiz (3 charges), a creature within 10 feet gains fire resistance for 1 hour; Eihwaz (2), arcane lock, ending on the first object if you lock a second; Hagalaz (2), shatter; Kenaz, burning hands (1) or heat metal (2); Raidho (4), stone shape on stone or natural metal. Or spend 1 minute and 1 charge to cast illusory script on stone or metal. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles, and a non-dwarf makes a DC 20 Constitution save or is petrified until greater restoration.

magic-item:diviner-s-dice.description: Once per dawn, roll the three crystal d6s as an action and record the results. As a reaction when you or a creature you see within 60 feet makes an attack roll or ability check, add or subtract one recorded number (after the roll but before the outcome is known); each number is used once, and unused ones vanish at dawn.

magic-item:djinn-and-tonic.description: A misty juniper cocktail whose alcohol affects you twice as strongly as normal. Common: a magical wind dramatically tousles your hair and clothes for 1 hour. Rare: you gain gaseous form for 10 minutes without concentration (end it as an action); when you rematerialize, Large or smaller creatures within 30 feet make a DC 15 Strength save or are pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

magic-item:dominic-s-field-guide-to-lang.description: Once per 24 hours, as an action name a language to fill its pages with translations to and from Common (a random language when found). Reading it for 1 hour (possible during a short rest) lets you speak, read, and write that language for 24 hours; one reader at a time.

magic-item:doom-bloom.description: A starry lotus that withers 1d6 + 1 days after picking. Once per 24 hours, as an action inhale its pollen and name a creature or place on your plane to duplicate scrying (DC 15). If the target fails, the flower bursts and is destroyed; if it succeeds, you suffer visions of your deaths until your next turn and take 6d6 psychic damage. A new bloom regrows 1d6 + 1 days later where it last grew, or where a successful sensor appeared (with a 10 percent chance each minute of an extra bloom where a following sensor ends up).

magic-item:doubloon-diver-s-goggles.description: While wearing them underwater, you have darkvision to 120 feet and advantage on sight-based Perception and Investigation checks.

magic-item:dragon-horn-pauldron.description: While wearing it, you gain +1 AC and resistance to the damage type of the dragon that gave the horn (acid for black or copper, lightning for blue or bronze, fire for brass, gold, or red, poison for green, cold for silver or white). When a save would halve damage of that type, as a reaction you take none on a success.

magic-item:dragon-turtle-barding.description: Over 1 hour after being donned, it expands to shell a mount, granting +1 AC, the ability to breathe air and water, and a swimming speed equal to its higher walking or flying speed.

magic-item:dragonband.description: As an action with its command word, the metallic dragon bracelet shatters, and each other creature within 20 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 10d6 damage (fire for brass or gold, lightning for bronze, acid for copper, cold for silver) or half on a success.

magic-item:dragonbreath-ammunition.description: When you take the Attack action and make a ranged weapon attack, fire it at a point in range instead, where it explodes into breath: each creature in the area makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 4d8 damage or half on a success. Brass, 60-foot line, fire; bronze, 90-foot line, lightning; copper, 60-foot line, acid; gold, 60-foot cone, fire; silver, 60-foot cone, cold.

magic-item:dramus-s-dancing-shoes.description: While wearing them, you have advantage on checks to dance. Attuned, your steps play music, letting you use your feet as a spellcasting focus for bard spells, with dancing checks made separately from music checks.

magic-item:dream-saber.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage. When it would drop a creature to 0 hit points, you can instead put it to sleep (unconscious for 10 minutes or until damaged or woken with an action); it can also make a DC 15 Wisdom save or you learn its surface thoughts and shape its dreams. A creature is then immune for 24 hours.

magic-item:dress-of-defense.description: While wearing it without armor, you gain +1 AC (shields allowed). Once per dawn, as a bonus action increase the bonus to +3 for 1 minute.

magic-item:dress-of-many-pockets.description: As a bonus action make any of its six pockets (each holding a parcel up to 4 inches and 2 pounds) appear anywhere on it or vanish, their contents spread invisibly through the fabric.

magic-item:drowner-s-pearl.description: Held in your mouth, it lets you survive 1 extra minute before suffocating, then crumbles to dust.

magic-item:dune-cowl.description: While wearing it, you withstand temperatures up to 200 degrees Fahrenheit and ignore Sunlight Sensitivity. Once per 7 days, as an action throw it within 10 feet to become a giant scorpion under your control for up to 8 hours, acting on its own initiative and obeying mental commands within 60 feet; revert it as a bonus action, and at 0 hit points it reverts to the hat.

magic-item:dusk-cleaver.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dusk, as an action attack magical darkness within 5 feet (AC 10 plus the creating spell's level, ignoring disadvantage from being inside it); on a hit the darkness is dispelled, or a 60-foot cube of it from you if larger.

magic-item:dusk-dagger.description: Hits against a creature entirely in dim light or darkness deal an extra 1d4 (uncommon), 1d8 (rare), or 1d12 (very rare) psychic damage.

magic-item:dwarven-boozehound-s-backpack.description: A 10-pound tank holding 8 gallons of magic ale (twice as potent) that refills at dawn. Over 10 minutes (1 minute for dwarves or those proficient with brewer's supplies), turn 1 gallon each into up to four elixirs; drinking one as an action grants advantage on saves against poison and poison resistance for 8 hours, or 10 temporary hit points for a dwarf; they lose magic at dawn. As an action with a free hand, blast 1 gallon at a target within 30 feet: an unattended object up to 300 pounds is knocked over or pushed 15 feet; against a creature make a +7 ranged spell attack for 1d8 bludgeoning damage and a 5-foot push, plus a DC 15 Constitution save or poisoned until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:ear-cuff-of-the-climber.description: While wearing it, you treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8 on ability checks to climb.

magic-item:eclipse-spear.description: In moonlight it sheds bright light 15 feet and dim 15 more. Attacks with it ignore disadvantage from magical darkness and deal piercing or slashing damage (your choice). Once per dusk, as a bonus action cast branding smite from it.

magic-item:egg-of-primal-water.description: As an action throw it at a point within 30 feet to create a pool up to 40 feet across opening into a 20-foot-deep demiplane of potable elemental water that never spills. After 24 hours anything inside is shunted out.

magic-item:ehagan-s-moving-ladder.description: A 2-foot, 4-pound platform holding up to 400 pounds. While standing on it, as a bonus action move it up to 30 feet vertically (15 if over 200 pounds), hovering up to 60 feet high; it moves horizontally only by pushing off surfaces as if climbing. After 10 total minutes of use, it drifts down and is inert until dawn.

magic-item:elder-sequoia-scale-mail.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid; scale mail
magic-item:elder-sequoia-scale-mail.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. You can use Wild Shape to become an evergreen tree up to 40 feet tall with hit points equal to 5 times your druid level, AC 20, and fire vulnerability, retaining your senses plus tremorsense 30 feet; your speed is 0 and you can only rustle, revert, or Wild Shape again.

magic-item:eldritch-bident.description: As an action, fire two eldritch beams (+7 ranged spell attack each) at one or two targets within 60 feet, each dealing 1d8 force damage. Warlocks are proficient with it and can use their spell attack bonus, beams deal 1d12 + Charisma modifier force damage, and a 20 forces a DC 10 Charisma save or the target is shunted to a horror-filled plane, incapacitated, returning at the start of your next turn with 2d12 psychic damage. Once per year, a warlock can cast plane shift to their patron's location for up to 24 hours, returning as an action.

magic-item:enzymatic-gastrostaff.description: While holding it you have resistance to acid damage. It works as a magic quarterstaff dealing an extra 1d4 acid damage on a hit. Once per dawn, as an action touch a willing Medium or smaller creature to enlarge it (enlarge/reduce, no concentration); it also deals double damage to objects and structures and gains 1d6 + 4 temporary hit points at the start of each turn, ending early at 0 hit points, after which it gains 1 level of exhaustion.

magic-item:eternal-slayer.description: While held it burns with bright light 20 feet and dim 20 more (doubled in combat). You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Its whirring toothed chain deals an extra 1d6 fire and 1d6 slashing damage on a hit (doubled against aberrations and fiends), and the fire ignores resistance and immunity. Wooden creatures, objects, and structures take maximum damage from its hits.

magic-item:everglacier-prosthesis.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature missing a hand, arm, or leg
magic-item:everglacier-prosthesis.description: Attached to a missing limb, it forms a working icy copy that can't be removed against your will. You have resistance to cold damage, and unarmed strikes with it deal cold damage. As an action, launch up to 3 of its 6 spikes at targets within 30 feet (+7 ranged spell attack each, 2d6 cold damage); 1d4 + 2 regrow at dawn.

magic-item:evoker-s-exchange.description: Using this amulet as your focus for a 1st-level or higher spell that deals only fire or lightning damage and doesn't require concentration, you can swap its damage to the other type; converted lightning ignites objects as fire would, and converted fire doesn't.

magic-item:eyedrops-of-clarity.description: Holds 1d4 + 2 doses; as an action apply one to yourself or a willing creature within reach. It ends blindness for a creature with eyes and grants darkvision 30 feet (or +30 feet to existing darkvision) and advantage on sight-based Perception checks for 1 hour.

magic-item:eyes-of-the-beheld.description: Button-sized eyes, usually in pairs. As an action fix one to a solid surface. Within 5 feet of one, as a bonus action open it to peer through another eye of the set on the same plane (changeable as a bonus action), viewing both ways one connection at a time; nothing passes through, and areas immune to divination or scrying don't appear. Each eye has AC 10 and 5 hit points. Hold a new eye to one in the set for 1 minute to join it.

magic-item:faeflame-torch.description: As a bonus action it lights with waterproof blue flame (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more) until extinguished as a bonus action or stowed. Once per dawn each, as an action: outline illusions in its bright light in your chosen color for 1 minute; or hurl the flame to a point within 60 feet for a 20-foot faerie fire (save DC 15, no concentration) that also deals 3d6 fire damage on a failed save or half on a success, endable as a bonus action.

magic-item:failed-purity-spear.description: A corrupted copy of a purity spear. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dusk; on a hit expend 1 and the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains a point of corruption for 1 minute, taking 1d4 poison damage (ignoring resistance and immunity) per point at the start of each turn (maximum 3d4), repeating the save at the end of each turn to shed a point, and poisoned at 3 or more. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff. Moving 20 feet straight toward a target and hitting it deals an extra 1d6 piercing damage. Curse: you won't part with it, have disadvantage on attacks with other weapons unless no foe you see or hear is within 60 feet, and have disadvantage on saves against poison, but while poisoned you gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it.

magic-item:fell-rider-chariot.description: A 300-pound Large iron chariot for up to four Medium creatures; riders have resistance to fire damage. As an action crack its flaming reins to summon two hitched armored nightmares (+1 AC) that defend only themselves and can't be ridden or unhitched; dismiss them as an action while aboard, and they heal fully after 24 hours dismissed. A slain nightmare returns after 1d4 + 1 days. You steer with the reins, though a good-aligned driver has a 20 percent chance each turn of the nightmares refusing. With both, the chariot uses their average speeds and flies upright; with one, it moves at half speed and can't fly. With both present, as an action shift the chariot and everything aboard between the Material and Ethereal Planes.

magic-item:felling-greataxe.description: Once per dawn, as an action fell a spectral tree in a 60-by-5-foot line: DC 13 Dexterity save, 3d6 bludgeoning damage and prone, or half and not prone on a success. You have advantage on checks to chop down trees with it.

magic-item:feywatch-shield.description: While holding it, you gain +5 to checks to identify or perceive illusions and to saves against being charmed.

magic-item:feywood-ivy.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid, ranger, or fey creature
magic-item:feywood-ivy.description: As an action the seed sprouts vines over a held object, forming a grip and a self-stowing sheath until recalled as an action. You can't be disarmed of it unless incapacitated, and it's a spellcasting focus for you. Once per dawn, as a bonus action the vines lash a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet: DC 13 Dexterity save or grappled and restrained for 1 minute (action and DC 13 Strength or Dexterity check to escape), ending if you move more than 5 feet away.

magic-item:fists-of-the-guiding-star.description: While wearing these wraps, as a bonus action spend 1 ki point to give a creature you see within 30 feet advantage on its next attack before the end of your next turn; if it hits, it deals extra radiant damage equal to your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You can cast light as an action.

magic-item:flamebreather-staff.description: Hits deal an extra 1d4 fire damage. Once per dawn, as an action cast burning hands (save DC 13) from it.

magic-item:flood-pauldron.description: While wearing it, you can breathe underwater and have a 30-foot swimming speed. Once per dawn, as an action its illusory water cape becomes a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder of water centered on you while you concentrate, up to 10 minutes (ending if you leave it); other creatures inside when it appears make a DC 13 Strength save, taking 4d6 bludgeoning damage and being pushed out, or half and not pushed on a success.

magic-item:focus-breaker.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Creatures concentrating on a spell make the concentration save from its hits with disadvantage. Once ever, as an action shatter the metal book on its head to dispel every spell and magical effect of 5th level or lower within 60 feet as dispel magic.

magic-item:focus-circlet.description: While wearing it, you add the spell's level (maximum +3) to Constitution saves to maintain concentration on spells you cast.

magic-item:fool-s-lamp.description: A djinni's cruel joke: identify and legend lore reveal it's empty, but any other means suggests a ring of djinni summoning activated by speaking a wish. When a holder does so as an action, the GM picks or rolls a d10: 1, trapped in a demiplane in the lamp for 1 hour (DC 20 Charisma save each turn to escape); 2, a 5th-level fireball (DC 16) centered on you; 3, gibberish speech for 2d6 hours; 4, faerie fire for 24 hours; 5, a hostile air, earth, fire, or water elemental appears within 30 feet; 6, unsteady legs for 1d6 hours (disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves, and a DC 16 Dexterity check or prone after moving your full speed); 7, levitate for 1 minute, randomly rising or sinking 5 to 20 feet each turn; 8, compelled to obey harmless polite requests for 1d6 hours as suggestion; 9, age 1d10 years, taking 5 necrotic damage per year, until a long rest; 10, roll twice. Greater restoration ends one effect.

magic-item:forecaster-s-cloak.description: As an action, open it to display a harmless sensory illusion of the next 8 hours of local weather for 1 minute.

magic-item:forgekeeper-s-spark.description: A coal housing a fire spirit that emerges when placed in fire (or for 1 minute if carried away burning). It tends a fire up to a 5-foot cube: windproof, smokeless unless you wish, twice as long-lasting, and holding cooking food at the ideal temperature. You have advantage on checks with cook's utensils or glassblower's, smith's, or tinker's tools using its fire, halving the time on a d20 roll of 15 or higher. Sentient and lawful neutral (Int 1, Wis 6, Cha 1; immune to fire; hearing and darkvision 60 feet; understands Common and Ignan), it keeps its fire contained and loves new things to heat.

magic-item:forgework-dragon-shield.description: While held it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. Once per dawn, as a reaction when a creature within 5 feet misses you, it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 3d10 fire damage and ignites (1d10 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until doused as an action), or half and no ignition on a success.

magic-item:fortune-s-flower.description: As an action pluck one of its five petals; there's a 5 percent chance it brands with a rune, duplicating augury, and 1d6 new flowers grow there in 30 days on suitable ground. Picked flowers live 7 days; unpicked plants regrow a flower yearly and can't be repotted.

magic-item:foxfire-charm.description: Placed in a hot fire up to a 10-foot cube, it summons a warm fox-shaped fire elemental (cat statistics, but an elemental immune to fire and poison, understanding Common and Ignan, shedding bright light 10 feet and dim 10 more) that stays within 100 feet and gathers unattended fuel with advantage on checks to find it. It vanishes at 0 hit points, on touching fire, or if the fire dies.

magic-item:freerunner-s-armor.description: The first time on a turn you long jump onto or along a non-slippery wall, you can move along it for the jump's length and make a second jump if you have movement left.

magic-item:frostburn-spear.description: It returns to your hand after being thrown. Held, it's sheathed in ice (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more), dealing an extra 1d6 cold damage on a hit and granting fire resistance; as a bonus action swap to flames for fire damage and cold resistance, or back. Once per dawn, as an action cast fire shield on a creature you see within 30 feet.

magic-item:furious-flail.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a barbarian; flail
magic-item:furious-flail.description: It has the heavy property. While you rage holding it, it gains reach and versatile (1d10) and deals an extra 1d8 fire damage, but you take 1d4 fire damage when it transforms and at the start of each turn holding it; it reverts when your rage ends or you stop holding it. Once per dawn, as an action smash a point within reach to erupt a 20-foot cube: each other creature makes a DC 26 Dexterity save, taking 2d12 bludgeoning plus 2d12 fire damage or half on a success, and the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared (1 minute per 5-foot square).

magic-item:fused-chimeric-hide.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a barbarian or druid; hide armor
magic-item:fused-chimeric-hide.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. When you rage or Wild Shape into a beast, you can take one aspect for 1 minute (each once per dawn). Dragon: 20 temporary hit points and fire resistance. Goat: after moving 20 feet straight toward a target no more than one size larger and making a melee weapon attack, it makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls prone. Lion: advantage on melee attacks against a creature with a non-incapacitated ally of yours within 5 feet of it.

magic-item:gateway-ring.description: Once per 10 days, as an action speak its command word and a precise location on any plane, then toss it within 10 feet to become a floating 5-foot stone portal for up to 1 minute, duplicating gate to that location (it can't target a creature, but can reach a precise point on your own plane). Close it early as an action by touch to return the ring to your hand; otherwise it falls beside the portal.

magic-item:gauntlets-of-deliverance.description: When you magically cure blindness, deafness, disease, or poison while wearing them, you can store the condition instead (one at a time). As a bonus action touch a creature, which makes a DC 13 Constitution save or suffers the stored condition until the end of your next turn; either way the condition is spent.

magic-item:gauntlets-of-eldritch-ferocit.description: While wearing them, you treat 1s on eldritch blast damage dice as 2s, and can create one extra beam whenever you cast it. If the extra beam's attack roll is a 1 or 2, you take 3d12 necrotic damage (ignoring resistance and immunity) and your hit point maximum drops by that much until a short or long rest; if this drops you to 0, you die.

magic-item:gelatinous-whip.description: An ooze-bladed hilt that stretches into a whip with 10 feet of reach. Targets it hits are coated in acid, taking 1d4 acid damage at the start of your next turn. Its ooze is harmless to you while attuned.

magic-item:gentleman-s-saber.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Opportunity attack hits deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage (both even without attunement). Attuned, its guard shows your crest and it has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn: as a reaction when hit by a ranged attack, expend 1 and roll a d6 for that bonus to AC against ranged attacks until the start of your next turn, including the triggering attack.

magic-item:gi-of-shifting-seasons.description: On attunement it takes a season, changeable with 1 minute of meditation or shifted forward one season whenever you spend ki (before or after the action). Winter: immune to extreme cold, and Flurry of Blows hits reduce speed by 5 feet (minimum 15) until your next turn. Spring: gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points on shifting to it, and Step of the Wind triples your jump and ignores difficult terrain this turn. Summer: immune to extreme heat, and unarmed strikes deal an extra 2 fire damage (3 outdoors by day). Autumn: advantage on Constitution saves, and after Patient Defense creatures provoke opportunity attacks by moving within 5 feet of you until your next turn.

magic-item:giantcraft-ambusher.description: Requires Strength 15 to wield. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn, as a bonus action it grows to triple size until the start of your next turn, gaining reach and dealing an extra 2d12 slashing damage on a hit without penalty for its size.

magic-item:gladius-of-the-everfighter.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a fighter; shortsword
magic-item:gladius-of-the-everfighter.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding it, you gain an extra use of Second Wind and of Action Surge (Action Surge still once per turn). As an action it becomes any simple or martial melee weapon and stays mutable for 1 minute, changing form as a bonus action; thrown forms return to your hand. Sentient and lawful neutral (Int 12, Wis 15, Cha 15; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, speaks Common), it prefers combat to talk, warms only after shared victories, and resists being parted from you.

magic-item:glaive-of-the-revenant-king.description: It has the finesse property. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Elves and half-elves are proficient with it, and while attuned you have advantage on Charisma checks with fey. A target resistant or immune to cold or fire that it hits loses that until the end of your next turn. Sentient and chaotic good (Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 16; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathy, Elvish and Sylvan), it houses the elven king Kelren, who hunts fiends and threats to nature and may refuse weak or evil wielders.

magic-item:glass-carver.description: As an action, cut a glowing straight line up to 1 foot long in nonmagical glass up to 1 inch thick, concentrating as for a spell (lines vanish if concentration ends). Completing a shape requires a Sleight of Hand check against DC 8 + half the actions used; on a success you remove it silently, otherwise it shatters. Replacing the piece and retracing for 1 minute mends it seamlessly.

magic-item:gloves-of-amphibios.description: While wearing them, climbing costs no extra movement, you gain +1 to Athletics checks to grapple, and an unarmored creature you grapple takes 1d4 poison damage at the end of each of your turns.

magic-item:gloves-of-healing.description: When you cast a 1st-level or higher healing spell, or use a healer's kit to stabilize or heal a creature, one target regains extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus, once per creature per short or long rest.

magic-item:gloves-of-mimicry.description: Cast mage hand as an action, and once per dawn arcane hand (save DC 16, +8 to hit). They have 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Applaud: as a reaction when a creature that sees and hears you rolls Bardic Inspiration, expend 1 to add your Charisma modifier. Barrier: as a reaction when hit, expend 1 for +5 AC against that attack. Pinch: as an action expend 1; a creature within 60 feet makes a DC 16 Intelligence save, taking 3d4 psychic plus 3d4 force damage or half, with disadvantage on concentration saves from it. Taunt: as an action expend 1 to mime-slap a creature within 30 feet (DC 16 Wisdom save, 2d4 psychic plus 2d4 force damage and disadvantage on attacks against others until your next turn, or half and no disadvantage).

magic-item:gloves-of-the-great-badger.description: While wearing them, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage, and you have a 5-foot burrowing speed. Once per dawn, as a bonus action for 1 minute: doubled burrowing speed through unworked stone, +1 to attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes, and critical hits on a 19 or 20 with them.

magic-item:gnashing-key.description: Placed in a lock, it chews it apart over 1 minute (audible 90 feet), forcing it open. For a lock DC above 15, it has a chance equal to 5 times the difference to break first, jamming the lock.

magic-item:godsteel-warplate.description: On attunement and after each long rest, you gain 50 temporary hit points, lost if you remove it. You gain +1 AC, and resistance to nonmagical damage while you have temporary hit points.

magic-item:godsteel-worldcarver.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, and Small creatures suffer no heavy penalty with the greatsword form. As a bonus action store it in or summon it from an extradimensional space; it goes there on its own if more than 30 feet from you. On a 20, the target makes a DC 17 Charisma save or takes an extra 3d8 radiant damage and, if a creature, is incapacitated and banished until the start of your next turn (half damage and no banishment on a success); a cleric or paladin wielder and chosen creatures within 30 feet regain hit points equal to half that radiant damage.

magic-item:golem-sapper.description: As an action place it on a construct within reach: DC 18 Constitution save or 2d10 necrotic damage and stunned until your next turn, repeating the save each turn with the DC dropping by 2 each time (minimum 10). On a success it falls off, unusable for 1 hour. The DC recovers by 2 per 24 hours unused, up to 18.

magic-item:gorget-of-the-holy-soldier.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment
magic-item:gorget-of-the-holy-soldier.description: While wearing it, you have resistance to radiant damage and a benefit for each class you have 10 or more levels in (an item-requirement-ignoring feature picks one on attunement). Barbarian: +2 Strength (maximum 26), and rage melee hits deal an extra 1d6 radiant. Bard: all languages, and Bardic Inspiration also heals twice your Charisma modifier. Cleric: commune, dispel evil and good, and raise dead always prepared; once per 7 days cast raise dead as an action without components, returning the target at half hit points. Druid: control weather and insect plague always prepared, and bonus-action wings granting a 60-foot fly speed. Fighter: immunity to charmed and frightened, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Monk: +10 feet speed, advantage against grapples, +2 AC unarmored. Paladin: Lay on Hands pool +10; spend 10 to end blindness, deafness, or paralysis, or 15 to remove a curse. Ranger: advantage on Perception, 15-foot truesight, and fine sight up to 1 mile. Rogue: bonus-action self invisibility without concentration once per short rest, and 30-foot telepathy. Sorcerer: light, dancing lights, and guiding bolt known (cast for 2 sorcery points, blinding on a failed Constitution save), and 1 sorcery point turns spell damage radiant. Warlock: you know when you hear a lie and can force a truthful answer (Charisma save) Charisma modifier times per long rest. Wizard: AC 13 + Dexterity or Intelligence modifier, and advantage on saves against magic.

magic-item:grasping-staff.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a warlock or wizard
magic-item:grasping-staff.description: While holding it you have resistance to necrotic damage. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn; as an action cast with your spell save DC and attack bonus: arcane hand (5), bestow curse (3), chill touch (0, or 1 for 5th level), inflict wounds (1 per level, up to 5th), mage hand (0), or vampiric touch (3). On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it turns to ash and 2d6 hostile crawling claws appear within 10 feet.

magic-item:great-owl-s-shroud.description: It has 10 charges, all regained at dawn. When you take the Attack action, replace attacks with feather barrages for 1 charge each: +5 ranged spell attack, range 30/120 feet, 2d4 + 3 force damage. Once per dawn, as a reaction when you fall, cast feather fall on yourself.

magic-item:green-knight-s-vow.description: Wearing these bracers grows horns on a non-tiefling (falling away 24 hours after attunement ends). They have 7 charges, all regained at dawn. As a bonus action expend 2 to give a creature within 30 feet a spectral shield granting half cover until the end of your next turn, plus another creature per extra charge. When you make an opportunity attack, expend charges so that one ally per charge within 60 feet who can see or hear you makes a reaction weapon attack. Expend 1 to cast hellish rebuke (DC 15) at 3rd level, plus one level per extra charge. Flaw: you're fanatically loyal to a sovereign; after 24 hours attuned you can't attune to the Red Queen's Burden or Violet King's Promise, and become charmed by and obedient to the first wielder of either you meet (or guard an unclaimed one with your life), curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:griffon-coinpouch.description: A storybook-style purse holding up to 1,000 coins at a constant 1 pound; coins come out freshly shiny. At the GM's discretion it holds a cryptic slip of advice.

magic-item:griffon-component-pack.description: Once per dawn, as an action place coins worth 5 gp plus a material component's exact cost inside and name it; the coins become that component. At the GM's discretion it takes only the 5 gp and leaves a note pointing to someone or somewhere that can help.

magic-item:griffon-key-loop.description: Hold a key to it for 1 minute to store it extradimensionally (up to 10; remove one with a minute's tugging). As an action recall or dismiss chosen keys. Touching it to a lock whose key it holds locks or unlocks it.

magic-item:guardian-s-reliquary.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature missing an arm
magic-item:guardian-s-reliquary.description: A saint's prosthetic arm that can't be removed against your will (detach or reattach as an action). While attached you gain +3 to saving throws, which you can lend to a touched creature as a bonus action for 1 minute. It has 10 charges, all regained at dawn: as an action cast greater restoration (5), lesser restoration (2), protection from evil and good (1), remove curse (3), or warding bond (2). Final Sacrifice: as an action cast mass heal or true resurrection, destroying the relic's bones; it remains a working prosthesis without attunement.

magic-item:gusting-blowgun.description: Ranged hits deal an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage and push a Medium or smaller creature 5 feet on a failed DC 13 Strength save, and long range imposes no disadvantage. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; as an action expend 1 for a 30-by-5-foot gust pushing Medium or smaller creatures 10 feet on a failed DC 13 Strength save.

magic-item:h-rethi-soul-scepter.description: While attuned you ignore sandy difficult terrain and tolerate 200 degrees Fahrenheit. It has 20 charges, regaining 2d6 + 8 at dawn (at 0, roll a d20; on a 1 it bursts into sand). Sandblast (1): +10 ranged attack within 60 feet, 4d6 bludgeoning damage. Sandstorm (5): a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high storm follows you while you concentrate, up to 1 hour, heavily obscuring others, deflecting ordinary projectiles, and dealing 4d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 Constitution half) to creatures entering or starting inside; on sandy ground you can teleport 60 feet between sandy spaces as a bonus action. Sand Summon (3): a 30-foot radius within 60 feet becomes shifting sand for 1 minute, costing 3 feet per foot moved. Soul of the H'rethi (3): summon a friendly sand elemental (earth elemental limited to sand, advantage on grapples) on sand within 30 feet while you concentrate, up to 1 hour.

magic-item:hadiya-s-handy-quill.description: It returns to your hand after a ranged attack. Once per dawn, speak a command word as you throw it; on a hit the target is blinded by ink until the end of its next turn (an action clears it). As a quill it makes its own ink in a color you choose as a bonus action. As a bonus action it becomes a feather tattoo on your body, or returns to your hand or feet.

magic-item:half-plate-of-the-blind-marty.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric; half plate
magic-item:half-plate-of-the-blind-marty.description: You gain a +2 bonus to AC while wearing it. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d4 + 4 at midday; as an action cast with your spellcasting statistics: cure wounds or inflict wounds (1), blindness/deafness or lesser restoration (2), bestow curse or remove curse (3), banishment or death ward (4), contagion or mass cure wounds (5), harm or heal (6). Curse: ended only by wish or similar magic; you're blind but have blindsight 60 feet while wearing it, and take 3 psychic damage (ignoring resistance and immunity) whenever you hit a creature or affect another creature with a spell.

magic-item:harbinger-s-flail.description: It has the reach property, deals an extra 1d4 thunder damage on a hit, and tolls audibly to 100 feet when it strikes.

magic-item:harvest.description: Hits against plant creatures deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage, and nonmagical plants harvested with it stay fresh 7 extra days.

magic-item:hat-of-osnomnosis.description: A sentient hat (chaotic good; Int 4, Wis 8, Cha 6; hearing and darkvision 30 feet; telepathic emotions and images) that works as your arcane focus while worn. As an action feed it a page; while wearing it you instantly know the nonmagical contents. Magic pages are spat back, and a page holding a spell deals 1d6 psychic damage per spell level to you. It loves being worn, eating paper, and being petted.

magic-item:hat-of-the-sanguine-coven.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:hat-of-the-sanguine-coven.description: While wearing it, you can cast chill touch at will. At 0 hit points, you need six successes or failures on death saves instead of three, but succeed only on a 15 or higher; when you roll a death save, the hat can cast chill touch (+5 to hit, no action) at a creature within 30 feet, and a hit adds +5 to the save.

magic-item:hatred-the-wrathful-edge.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature the axe deems worthy; greataxe
magic-item:hatred-the-wrathful-edge.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
