magic-item:snow-rider-s-sleigh.description: This sled glides over any land as if over fresh snow, trailing illusory flurries.

magic-item:soul-pendant.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a reaction when a creature you see within 60 feet dies, expend 1 to trap its soul for 24 hours (constructs, undead, and soulless creatures are immune), until you trap another or release it as a bonus action; its body is under gentle repose. While a soul is held you gain +2 to Wisdom checks and saves, and as an action you can ask it a question as speak with dead (released after 3). Raising the creature returns its soul.

magic-item:soul-searing-scythe.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a bonus action its blade erupts in flame (bright light 40 feet, dim 40 more) until ended, dropped, or stowed, dealing an extra 3d4 fire damage that ignores fire resistance and immunity (necrotic against creatures with Fire Absorption). On a critical hit against a creature that isn't a construct or undead, it makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 3d4 necrotic damage and stunned until your next turn, or half and not stunned. A non-construct, non-undead creature it drops to 0 is utterly destroyed, restorable only by wish or divine intervention.

magic-item:sovereignseed-satchel.description: Produces 4 seeds each dawn (unused ones crumble), rolled on a d6 when first opened: 1, Binding Bur, thrown as a dart or sling bullet, restrains a Large or smaller creature on a failed DC 15 Strength save for 1 minute (action and DC 15 Strength check to escape); 2, Bouncing Bloom, a 5-foot flower that triples a creature's jump without a running start, for 10 minutes or ten uses; 3, Cloaking Cotton, a 20-foot heavily obscuring cloud for 1 minute (dispersed by moderate wind or 5 fire damage inside); 4, Fiddle-Ferry Fig, a 10-by-5-foot leaf supporting 300 pounds that floats or slows falls to 60 feet per round for 1 hour; 5, Rose of Radiance, glows (bright light 30 feet, dim 30 more) or is planted to grow a rose shining twice as far for 8 hours; 6, Spanning Sprout, a 5-by-30-foot vine bridge holding 500 pounds for 1 hour (AC 10, destroyed by 15 slashing or fire damage).

magic-item:spellfire-bow.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a spellcaster; longbow
magic-item:spellfire-bow.description: Drawn without an arrow, it creates an arcane arrow granting +3 to attack and damage rolls and dealing force damage (even unattuned). Attuned, you're proficient with it and can use it as a spellcasting focus; you gain +3 to ranged spell attacks made through it (drawing the bow as the somatic component), and 1st-level or higher spells with a range of 5 feet or more gain 30 feet of range.

magic-item:spellsword.description: A hilt. As a bonus action expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to form an energy blade for 8 hours (bright light 20 feet, dim 20 more; hide or show it as a bonus action): you're proficient, it's a spellcasting focus, and it uses your spellcasting ability and deals force damage. With a 3rd or 4th-level slot its die is a d8 with +1 to attack and damage; with 5th or higher, a d10 and +2. Ending it early as an action releases a 10-foot cone: DC 15 Dexterity save, 3d6 force damage (4d8 or 5d10 for higher slots) or half.

magic-item:spellwriter-s-brace.description: After a long rest, prepare four extra spells of 5th level or lower (duplicates allowed) as tattoos on your arm. As an action transfer one to a willing creature (one at a time), which can cast it with its own slot and statistics, consuming the tattoo. Tattoos vanish on a long rest or if you remove the brace.

magic-item:spirit-cleaver.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a rogue; dagger
magic-item:spirit-cleaver.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals slashing damage. Once per dawn, as an action cast etherealness for 1 minute, letting you attack creatures on your original plane with advantage (ending after such an attack); a non-construct, non-undead target left with 75 hit points or fewer after your Sneak Attack makes a DC 17 Constitution save or dies.

magic-item:spirit-sheath.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature with a Wisdom score of 13 or higher; scimitar
magic-item:spirit-sheath.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you're proficient with it and can use Wisdom for its attack and damage rolls. Once per dawn, as a bonus action cast spiritual weapon (+7 spell attack, +4 modifier) as a duplicate of the scimitar.

magic-item:spiritwalker-breastplate.description: Once per dawn, when you drop to 0 hit points, your incorporeal, damage-immune spirit rises for 1 minute or until you wake, tethered within 30 feet of your body with your senses and a 30-foot hovering fly speed, able only to move and Help. Damage doesn't cause death save failures, you die only from damage on one turn equal to your hit point maximum, and your death save DC rises by 1 per 5 feet your spirit is from your body. Turn undead effects send it back.

magic-item:splinterguard.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger; splint
magic-item:splinterguard.description: Critical hits against you become normal hits. The first critical hit each day splinters its panels: other creatures within 10 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 3d8 piercing damage or half, and the armor takes -2 AC until dawn (plant growth can regrow it once early). Attuned, you're proficient with it, suffer no Stealth disadvantage, choose who the shrapnel hits, and it deals 5d8.

magic-item:sream-s-stoppered-oasis.description: As an action pour the water over its planter to grow a 100-foot-square oasis over 10 minutes for 24 hours (or until dispel magic at 5th level or higher): clean water and fruit for fifteen humanoids or five steeds, a comfortable climate, allies there can't be frightened and regain 1d4 extra Hit Dice on a long rest. It's under alarm, and each intruder summons a friendly, unobedient swarm of poisonous snakes (maximum 3) that fights until hostiles are gone. Drinking the water does nothing.

magic-item:staff-of-cubic-cultivation.description: It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. As an action tap it and expend charges to create one sticky 5-foot gelatinous cube per charge adjacent to you or each other (AC 10, 20 hit points, acid resistance, difficult terrain to walk on) for 1 minute. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 its gem becomes a hostile gelatinous cube and it turns nonmagical.

magic-item:staff-of-the-dream-shepherd.description: Within 5 feet of it you can fall asleep as an action but can't be magically put to sleep, and while attuned you regain 1 extra Hit Die on a long rest. Once per dawn, as an action loose spectral sheep in a 20-by-10-foot line: chosen creatures make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 psychic damage or half; those who fail with 20 or fewer hit points fall asleep for 1 minute (not undead or charm-immune creatures).

magic-item:staff-of-the-vineyard.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric, druid, monk, or ranger
magic-item:staff-of-the-vineyard.description: A magic quarterstaff bearing up to 10 grapes; eating one as an action works as a goodberry, and 1d10 regrow at dawn. Once per dawn, as an action cast entangle (DC 13) as grapevines; a creature that fails a Strength check to escape is drunk (poisoned) until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:stalagmight-geode.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Rolling maximum on its damage die grows the die one size (up to d12); rolling a 12 on the d12 bursts it, forcing other creatures within 5 feet to make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 1d12 piercing damage (half on a success), and resets it to d8.

magic-item:stalwart-staff.description: Used as a walking stick on foot, it grants advantage on your first save against a forced march.

magic-item:starmetal-nova-armor.description: A chain shirt and half plate worn together. You gain +2 AC and resistance to lightning damage, and always know north. Wearing the shirt, as an action summon the half plate onto you from within 30 feet or shed it. As a reaction when a creature carrying metal first moves within 10 feet of you on its turn, repel yourself 10 feet without provoking. Wearing both, as an action blast off the half plate in a 30-foot burst: you escape grapples, and creatures not behind total cover make a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 3d8 radiant damage or half.

magic-item:starmetal-shard-spear.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It returns after ranged attacks. On a hit, you can leave one of its 3 shards in the target; as a bonus action recall all shards, dealing 1d6 slashing damage each as they leave and halving the speed of a creature holding all 3 until the end of your next turn. Shards more than 120 feet away return harmlessly.

magic-item:starmetal-sliver.description: Tossed as an action, it orbits you; another creature can grab it as an action with an attack against AC 24 or a DC 24 Acrobatics check, and you can seize it as an action. When you take the Attack action, as a bonus action it attacks a target within 10 feet with your attack and damage modifiers. While orbiting, ranged weapon attack damage to you is reduced by 1d10 + 4, a missile reduced to 0 dropping at your feet.

magic-item:status-signets.description: Paired rings; two friendly wearers within 100 feet who can see each other know each other's hit points and conditions.

magic-item:steam-harpoon.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per turn, make a special ranged attack firing its chained head at a target within 20 feet using Dexterity; on a hit it makes a DC 15 Strength save or is pulled 15 feet toward you (Huge or larger succeed). The head then reels back.

magic-item:stonemason-s-companion.description: You gain +1 to checks with these mason's tools. If proficient, carve 10 gp of fine stone over a workday to create a familiar as find familiar, except it's an elemental indistinguishable from a statue when still; it crumbles at 0 hit points, and you can have only one at a time.

magic-item:storm-seer-lamp.description: As a bonus action touch it to glow with bright light of 5 to 20 feet plus equal dim light, adjust, or dim it; after 8 total hours lit it rests until dusk. Its light turns cold gray up to 3 hours before a storm reaches within 1 mile.

magic-item:storm-s-eye-shield.description: While holding it, you have resistance to lightning damage, and once per dawn as a reaction to lightning damage from a hostile source cast thunderwave (DC 15). Laid flat, a 1-minute ritual casts augury read in its swirling cyclone (calm good, roiling bad, lightning both, nothing neutral), usable again after an hour in another thunderstorm.

magic-item:stormbrewer-bracers.description: After you roll initiative, each melee weapon hit on a hostile creature adds a charge (maximum 5, lost after 1 minute); a hit at 5 charges discharges them for 1d8 lightning damage to the target and up to 2 chosen creatures within 10 feet. As a reaction to lightning damage, reduce it by 1d8 + 4 and gain a charge.

magic-item:storyteller-s-stein.description: While you tell a story holding it, its lid mouths along, producing harmless matching sounds and sensory effects.

magic-item:stuffy-familiar.description: Usable as an unconsumed component for find familiar; the familiar inhabits the plush (restyled to fit its form and resizing to match), becoming a construct as well as its usual type, indistinguishable from a toy while still. It travels with the familiar when dismissed and is left behind if the familiar is dismissed forever or destroyed.

magic-item:stylist-s-circlet.description: As a bonus action restyle your hair's length (up to 5 feet), color, and style while wearing it; cut hair vanishes and it reverts on removal.

magic-item:tarrasque-plate.description: You gain +1 AC and resistance to damage from spells. When targeted by magic missile, a line spell, or a spell attack, roll a d6; on a 6 you're unaffected and it reflects at the caster.

magic-item:tea-weird.description: A sentient fragment of water elemental (chaotic good; Int 3, Wis 8, Cha 6; hearing and darkvision 60 feet; understands Aquan and Common) inhabiting 1 ounce to 1 gallon of water, which it heats to steep any ingredient it's given. It's an object with speed 5 feet, hovering 5 feet, AC 10, 10 hit points, and resistance to all damage, healing fully with an ounce of water. It avoids combat, loves cups and pockets, and drinking all of it is harmless but destroys it.

magic-item:tempest-griffon-bracers.description: While wearing them, your speed increases by 5 feet. Once per dawn, as an action vanish in sparks and feathers to make a melee weapon attack against each of up to 3 creatures within 60 feet, dealing an extra 2d8 lightning damage on a hit (half on a miss), then appear within 5 feet of one or back in your space.

magic-item:thalamus-thread.description: A bowstring that makes ranged attacks magical. Once per dawn, on a hit with a bow or crossbow strung with it, add 1d8 psychic damage and force a DC 15 Intelligence save or the target is stunned until the end of your next turn (constructs and undead succeed).

magic-item:thomas-s-dimensional-trousers.description: Pants weighing 1 pound with four extradimensional pockets, each with a 6-inch mouth holding 20 pounds and 2 cubic feet. Retrieving an item takes an action. If overloaded or torn they rupture, scattering contents within 300 feet (30 days of daily mending restores them); turned-out pockets spill harmlessly. Breathing creatures inside survive 10 minutes divided by their number. Placing them in another extradimensional item destroys both and opens a one-way gate to the Astral Plane that pulls in creatures within 10 feet.

magic-item:tide-turner.description: A brass timepiece showing the moon phase, time until dawn or dusk, and time between tides on the Material Plane, behaving strangely on other planes.

magic-item:titan-cricket-greaves.description: While wearing them, your long jump is 25 feet and high jump 15 feet (with or without a running start) unless already higher, and your speed increases by 5 feet. As an action chirp like one or many crickets, from a whisper to a scream.

magic-item:titan-s-tooth-claymore.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits against objects are critical hits, and a 20 on the attack deals an extra 2d6 slashing damage.

magic-item:tome-of-advanced-fighting-sty.description: Study it for 48 hours within 6 days to gain one Advanced Fighting Style (each once only): Advanced Simplicity, critical hits with simple weapons on 19 or 20; Crushing Blows, heavy-weapon critical hits add 5 + your attack modifier bludgeoning damage; Net Mastery, doubled net range and an escape DC of 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity on the first attempt; Quick Shot, a firing reach of 5 feet + your reach, provoking opportunity attacks with ranged weapons; Readied Bulwark, +2 AC against opportunity attacks with a shield; Versatile Expert, two-handed damage with versatile weapons one-handed. It then goes dormant for a century.

magic-item:tome-of-lost-knowledge.description: A spellbook and arcane focus whose writing vanishes if attunement ends. As a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a 1st-level or higher spell, make an Arcana check (DC 10 + its level) to copy it in (usable only if a wizard spell you have slots for), then wait days equal to its level. Once per dawn, swap up to 3 prepared spells on a short rest. Once per dawn, as an action gain proficiency (or double it) in a skill or tool until dawn. Curse: you won't part with it, must use it as your spellbook, and take psychic damage equal to the level of each spell prepared from another book.

magic-item:torrdok-s-magnificent-forgery.description: A 20-pound mirror fastened to or released from a wall as an action. After 24 hours facing a room up to 40 feet on a side, it becomes a painting of the room; as an action touch it to enter a demiplane copy of the room (furniture included but nonmagical, no doors or windows), or return beside it. Removing the mirror ejects anything inside. A DC 15 Arcana or Investigation check reveals its nature but not its command words.

magic-item:traitor-s-gauntlet.description: Your unarmed strikes with your hands become magic, dealing 1d8 necrotic damage. As a bonus action a nonmagical melee weapon held in the gauntleted hand becomes magical until thrown, dropped, or stowed, dealing necrotic damage plus an extra 1d8 fire. Unworn, it can be refit to either hand as an action. Curse: you won't part with it or remove the gloves, and trust no one, having disadvantage on Insight and Persuasion checks with friendly creatures and being unable to Help.

magic-item:trampling-crossbow.description: On a 20, the bolt becomes a spectral stampede: the target and up to 2 chosen creatures within 15 feet of it make a DC 13 Strength save, taking 1d8 bludgeoning damage and a 10-foot push if Large or smaller, or half and no push (double damage to objects and structures).

magic-item:tremor-spike.description: A 15-pound rod that stands or folds as an action, anchored until knocked over with a DC 20 Strength check. Active (toggled as a bonus action), it pounds out shockwaves audible 300 feet (1,200 for tremorsense), halving tremorsense within 300 feet and blinding it within 30 feet, though creatures sense the source.

magic-item:turtle-brooch.description: While wearing it, standing from prone costs 5 feet less movement (minimum 5).

magic-item:tyrannosaurus-rax.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Twice per dawn, as a bonus action rampage for up to 1 minute (ending if you don't move through a hostile creature's space on your turn or drop to 0): move through creatures your size or smaller without provoking them, once per turn force one to make a DC 15 Strength or Dexterity save or take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and fall prone, and score critical hits on 19 or 20 against objects, structures, and prone creatures.

magic-item:underworld-asphodel-regalia.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or wizard
magic-item:underworld-asphodel-regalia.description: Cast animate dead over 1 minute spellcasting-modifier times per dusk. Undead you create with necromancy gain five times your spellcasting modifier in hit points, and one necrotic damage roll of your spells adds your spellcasting modifier. Chthonic Command (modifier times per dusk): as an action an undead within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save (turn-immune creatures succeed) or for 1 minute either flees as if turned (ending if damaged) or is charmed and telepathically obeys you, resaving when damaged. You're always under sanctuary against undead, lost for 24 hours against one you attack or target.

magic-item:urnblade.description: A cremation urn that pours out a smoky blade as a bonus action; proficiency with shortswords or longswords covers it. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals necrotic damage. As an action animate your shadow as a shadow under your mental command (it doesn't spawn new shadows); while it exists the bonus is +2, and within 5 feet of it you can use a reaction to redirect an attack to it. It ends at 0 hit points, beyond 120 feet, or when dismissed as an action; each time it drops to 0 there's a cumulative 5 percent chance the urn crumbles.

magic-item:vain-virtuoso-s-violin.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration with it, you also gain a d4 inspiration die. Curse: when a creature you see fails a roll after adding your Bardic Inspiration, you take psychic damage equal to the die roll (ignoring resistance and immunity).

magic-item:verax-weapon.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Quenched in the blood of one creature type (chosen or rolled), it negates disadvantage on attacks against creatures of that type.

magic-item:violet-king-s-promise.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a bard, cleric, paladin, or ranger; rapier
magic-item:violet-king-s-promise.description: Hits deal an extra 1d8 fire damage, and it's a spellcasting focus. It has 7 charges, all regained at dawn. As a reaction impose disadvantage on a spell attack against you or a creature within 5 feet, regaining a charge if a leveled spell misses. Clemency (2, reaction after a single-target healing spell): another creature within 10 feet regains 1d8 per spell level, and both gain advantage on their next check or save before the end of their next turn. Condemn (2, reaction after a single-target damage spell): it and another creature within 10 feet make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 3d8 fire damage and disadvantage on their next attack, or half. Overrule (up to 2, no action): for each charge, maximize two dice of a single-target healing roll or a spell or weapon damage roll. Flaw: you're slow to violence; after 24 hours attuned you have disadvantage on Intimidation and -5 to initiative, curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:viper-khopesh.description: Hits deal an extra 1d6 poison damage. On a 20 against a Large or smaller creature, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 2d6 poison damage and being poisoned and incapacitated until the start of your next turn, or half and not poisoned.

magic-item:voyage-collar.description: Place it on a willing Medium or smaller creature as an action, bonding with a friendly beast companion or familiar. Once per dawn, as a bonus action while it's within 30 feet, it becomes Large for up to 8 hours (until 0 hit points or ended as a bonus action), gaining +2 AC if unarmored, +10 feet of speed, a magical saddle and tack, a riding horse's carrying capacity, and understanding of friendly riders' directions. It fails on polymorphed creatures, travels with a dismissed familiar, and a creature benefits from only one magic collar.

magic-item:vyra-s-broken-path.attunementNote: Requires attunement by an elf or half-elf
magic-item:vyra-s-broken-path.description: While wearing the cloak, you have advantage on Stealth checks. As a bonus action with a free hand, break its clasp to turn it into a +3 longbow you're proficient with whose ranged attacks ignore half cover; an Elvish command phrase as a bonus action turns it back. Once per dawn, as an action sense for 1 hour whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead are within 1 mile (type only).

magic-item:wand-of-dowsing.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as an action expend 1 to cast locate object, with a 10-mile range when seeking water. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it bursts into harmless steam.

magic-item:wand-of-gilding.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a bard, sorcerer, or wizard
magic-item:wand-of-gilding.description: As an action enhance a living target's beauty within 30 feet for 1 hour. Once per dawn, as an action make an object up to 1 foot look and feel like gold for 1 hour (DC 15 Investigation reveals the illusion). It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles): as an action expend 1 to cast alter self (Change Appearance only), charm person at 2nd level, enthrall, or hypnotic pattern (DC 15); or as a reaction expend 1 for advantage on a Charisma check or save.

magic-item:wand-of-merriment.description: A holly sprig with 10 berry charges, regrowing 1d6 + 4 at dawn; while attuned you gain +2 to Charisma checks and saves. As an action cast (DC 16) create food and water (3), goodberry (1), hideous laughter (1), or irresistible dance (6). As a bonus action expend 2 to Dash without provoking, ignoring ice and snow terrain. As an action expend 1 to turn a gallon of water into a mild, tasty alcoholic drink. On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a common wand with 1 charge and only the drink property.

magic-item:wand-of-necrosis.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:wand-of-necrosis.description: While it has a charge, you have resistance to necrotic damage while holding it. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn; as an action cast (DC 15, +7) blight (4), finger of death (7), inflict wounds (1 per level, plus 1 for 30-foot range), or ray of enfeeblement (2). On the last charge roll a d20; on a 1 it explodes as finger of death on you, and a resulting zombie obeys the nearest lich within 100 miles.

magic-item:wand-of-puppetry.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it turns nonmagical). As an action expend charges to attach that many invisible strings to the limbs and head of a humanoid within 60 feet (DC 16 Arcana to see; cut with 10 slashing from a magic weapon, AC 10; DC 16 Strength save at the end of each turn breaks any; break beyond 100 feet). Arm: DC 16 Strength save to use it or the use fails (advantage if only one of several arms is strung), no shield benefit, and as an action force a save to drop held items. Head: disadvantage on Intelligence checks, Perception, and concentration saves, and as an action make it say up to 25 words. Leg: -15 feet of speed per leg (fliers sink gently at 0), with disadvantage on Acrobatics and Dexterity saves if all legs are strung. Or expend 5 to cast dominate person (DC 16).

magic-item:wand-of-stars.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it scatters into dust). As an action cast (DC 15) color spray (1 per level, up to 3rd), daylight (3), hypnotic pattern (3), light (0), magic missile (1 per level, up to 3rd), or prestidigitation (0). Under visible stars, as an action expend 1 to make stars in a named direction shine brighter to you for 1 hour.

magic-item:wand-of-the-alicorn.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned spellcaster
magic-item:wand-of-the-alicorn.description: It has 7 charges, all regained at dawn. As an action cast (DC 17) dispel evil and good (1), find steed as a pegasus (1), guiding bolt at 6th level (1, +10 to hit), or sacred flame at 5th level (0). As a bonus action expend 1 for pegasus wings granting you a 60-foot flying speed for 1 hour, or give them to a creature within 60 feet, which can fly its speed as a reaction without provoking. As an action expend charges to heal a creature within 60 feet 10 hit points each and cure one disease or the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned condition, with healing beyond its maximum becoming temporary hit points.

magic-item:wand-of-the-frostrose.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll a d20; on a 1 it melts and the rose crumbles). As an action expend up to 3 to raise that many Medium ice rose sculptures within 60 feet (AC 12, 1 hit point, difficult terrain), melting after 1 minute (8 hours in extreme cold); DC 15 Arcana or Investigation reveals they're explosive. A destroyed sculpture explodes, setting off others in range: creatures within 20 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 3d8 piercing plus 3d6 cold damage and 1d8 piercing per additional blast, or half.

magic-item:war-s-wager.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit, you can roll another d20: on 11 or higher the hit becomes a critical hit; on 10 or lower it instead scores a critical hit on you that ignores resistance and immunity.

magic-item:wardancer-s-spear.description: Held in one hand it has finesse. When you take the Attack action and make a one-handed melee attack with it, make another attack as a bonus action (no ability modifier to damage unless negative), then move up to 10 feet without provoking.

magic-item:warding-staff.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin
magic-item:warding-staff.description: While held its brazier sheds holy light (bright 20 feet, dim 20 more); it's a magic quarterstaff dealing an extra 1d6 radiant damage. A friendly creature within reach can take its floating orb as a bonus action, gaining warding bond from you until it's over 60 feet away, you drop the staff, are incapacitated, die, or end it, then the orb returns. Once per dawn, as a bonus action either of you can teleport within 5 feet of the other, up to 60 feet.

magic-item:warhammer-of-eruptions.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. After its first hit in a combat it smolders, dealing an extra 1d6 fire damage; at the end of your third turn smoldering it erupts in a 30-foot cone (DC 13 Dexterity, 3d6 fire plus 3d6 lightning or half), then is inert for 2d6 hours. It cools harmlessly if combat ends or it's dropped or stowed first.

magic-item:warp-anchor.description: As an action split it into two batons or rejoin them. Holding one baton, as an action teleport yourself within 5 feet of the other, even across planes; it recharges after 12 hours rejoined.

magic-item:waterskin-of-voices.description: Holds 1d6 + 4 servings; as an action drink one to make your next 25 words within 10 minutes sound like a chosen voice (DC 20 Insight detects it; the voice's owner always knows).

magic-item:wavecutter.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn, when you take the Attack action, forgo an attack to unleash a 10-foot-tall wave in a 30-foot cone: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d8 bludgeoning damage and prone, or half and standing, dousing unprotected flames within 30 feet.

magic-item:wayfinder-sphere.description: A 5-pound orb, toggled by tapping twice, that maps what it sees within 100 feet (darkvision 100 feet, but not through heavy obscurement or illusions). Within 30 feet, name a mapped place to project a 5-foot illusory map you can rotate and scale (25 feet to 1 mile). It can hover and follow within 30 feet, or as an action guide you 10 feet ahead to a recorded location within 1 mile.

magic-item:weapon-of-verdict.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature of good alignment; any melee weapon
magic-item:weapon-of-verdict.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. On a hit expend 1 for an extra 1d8 fire damage, or as an action expend 1 to touch another creature and heal it 1d8 + 2.

magic-item:weaving-wasp-needles.description: A needle that hits a Large or smaller creature circles it for 1 minute; once per dawn, if both circle the same creature, they restrain it until released as a bonus action or a DC 13 Strength check as an action frees it. They also work as self-sewing weaver's tools, mending a tear in 1 minute or crafting a simple garment over a short rest.

magic-item:webgrip-bow.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; expend 1 on a ranged attack and a hit releases a web: a Medium or smaller target and Medium or smaller creatures within 5 feet (only the target if Large; Huge unaffected) make a DC 15 Dexterity save or are restrained until the end of your next turn. Once per dawn, as an action summon 2 swarms of spiders or 1 giant spider that obey you for 1 hour.

magic-item:whirling-weapons.attunementNote: Any melee weapon without the special or two-handed property
magic-item:whirling-weapons.description: They have finesse and light. When you take the Attack action with one in one hand, make a bonus-action attack with it (no ability modifier to damage unless negative or you have Two-Weapon Fighting); wielding two, the bonus action grants one attack with each.

magic-item:whirlpool-dart.description: Once per dawn, as an action throw it within 20 feet to create a 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-high whirlpool: other creatures make a DC 13 Strength save, taking 4d4 bludgeoning damage and pulled 15 feet inward, or half and not pulled; unsecured objects are pulled and nonmagical flames doused.

magic-item:whispergust-mote.description: A sentient chaotic good breath of air (Int 1, Wis 8, Cha 7; hearing and darkvision 60 feet; understands Auran and Common) that can turn invisible as an action, tousles hair, and wanders as it pleases while enjoying travel with adventurers. It's an object with a 20-foot hovering fly speed, AC 10, 5 hit points, and resistance to all damage, healed fully by gust of wind.

magic-item:widemouth-bucket.description: A 3-pound fish-mouth bucket holding 10 gallons of liquid while weighing at most as much as 1 gallon.

magic-item:widow-s-tea.description: A hag-haunted tea set; once per 5 days, the first cup poured into its teacups forces its drinker to make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 4d6 poison damage and being paralyzed for 1 minute (repeating the save each turn), or half and not paralyzed.

magic-item:wildfire-ammunition.description: When fired, it vanishes into a pocket dimension for up to 3 rounds. As a bonus action choose a point within 120 feet of where you fired it to explode it in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d8 fire damage plus 2d8 per round it waited, or half. Left the full time, it explodes over a random point. It's destroyed on exploding.

magic-item:wildskin-armor.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid; hide armor
magic-item:wildskin-armor.description: Once per dawn, when you use Wild Shape, it can reinforce your new form so your AC is 14 + your Dexterity modifier (maximum 2) unless already higher, even if it merges into you.

magic-item:williwig-s-time-stopper.description: A gargoyle-topped stopper that resizes to seal openings up to 6 inches as an action; nonliving liquid inside doesn't age or spoil until it leaves the vessel.

magic-item:wind-and-whirl.description: Twin scimitars attuned as one item. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. They have the thrown property (range 20/60) and return after ranged attacks, and two-weapon fighting with both adds your ability modifier to the second attack. Once per dawn, as an action hurl both at a point within 60 feet to raise a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high whirlwind: DC 15 Strength save, 6d6 bludgeoning damage and flung 20 feet randomly and prone (1d6 per 10 feet on impact; a struck creature makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or shares it), or half and unmoved; then they return.

magic-item:wind-riders.description: While wearing them, strong winds don't hinder your movement. Once per dawn, as an action become a cloud of vapor and leaves as gaseous form for up to 1 minute, moving vertically at your speed while the wind carries you horizontally (20 feet per round in a moderate or stronger wind of 10 miles per hour or more, 10 feet in a weaker one); going where the leaves can't follow ends it.

magic-item:wind-up-merchant.description: Once per 24 hours, wind it as an action to print a list of 3 items rolled on its d12 table (25 to 50 gp minor items such as potions, 1st-level scrolls, a broom of flying, or an immovable rod). For 5 minutes it walks and bows, and as an action you can deposit coins and name a listed item to receive it if you paid enough. Unspent coins drop out afterward in change. Purchased items vanish after 24 hours or if sold or traded.

magic-item:wisp-cloak.description: While wearing it, you have advantage on death saves and once per turn can move through a Medium or smaller creature's space (not stopping there). Curse: until remove curse, you can't remove it, and the first time each turn you move or end your turn within 10 feet of a friendly creature at 0 hit points, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save or suffers a failed death save.

magic-item:wispy-sour.description: A sweet, ashy drink whose alcohol affects you twice as strongly as normal. Common: for 1 minute you gain a 10-foot flying speed, hovering only 1 foot up. Uncommon: for 1 minute, once per turn when you drop a hostile creature that isn't a construct or undead to 0 hit points, regain 1d8 + 2 hit points.

magic-item:wraps-of-the-restless.description: While wearing them, you have resistance to necrotic damage. When you take the Attack action, a bonus-action lash hits a target within 10 feet with a +7 melee spell attack for 1d8 necrotic damage. They have 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as an action expend charges for a 15-foot cone of sand: DC 15 Constitution save, blinded until your next turn and 1d6 bludgeoning plus 2d8 necrotic damage per charge, or half and not blinded. Curse: until remove curse, you can't remove them, have disadvantage on attacks against undead and saves against their abilities, and roll each Hit Die twice taking the lower.

magic-item:wyrmling-wristlet.description: Hung with 1d6 + 3 colored beads of chosen or rolled dragon types. As an action throw one up to 30 feet to summon a friendly wyrmling of that color for 1 hour (until 0 hit points or another is summoned), acting right after you and obeying your commands. Nonmagical once the last bead is used.

magic-item:wyrmshide-bow.description: Once per dawn (or after helping slay a Large or larger dragon), as a bonus action form a draconic cowl: 25 temporary hit points for 1 minute, resistance to the energy of the dragon that gave its scales (acid for black or copper, lightning for blue or bronze, fire for brass, gold, or red, poison for green, cold for silver or white), and hits deal an extra 1d8 of that type, ignoring dragons' resistance or immunity. It lasts until those temporary hit points are gone.

magic-item:xibalban-blade.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits against creatures other than constructs, plants, and undead deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. Once per dawn, if it dealt such damage in the past hour, as an action summon a blood elemental as conjure elemental (water elemental statistics, neutral evil, also resisting necrotic), which regains hit points equal to the sword's necrotic damage while within 120 feet.

magic-item:xorn-sole-boots.description: As a bonus action click your heels to gain tremorsense 30 feet and a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed, pinpointing precious metals and gems in range, for up to 10 minutes total in 1-minute increments per long rest.

magic-item:yellow-harbinger-s-path.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature with a Dexterity score of 17 or higher; any armor
magic-item:yellow-harbinger-s-path.description: You gain +5 to Stealth checks. With more than half your Hit Dice left, as an action spend 2 to extend this for 1 hour to chosen creatures within 30 feet, who also gain advantage on initiative and can't be tracked nonmagically while near you. It has 7 charges, all regained at dawn. At Arrow's Length (1): as a reaction impose disadvantage on an opportunity attack by a creature within 60 feet without blindsight, optionally moving your hunter's mark to it; or 2 as a reaction when a hostile creature ends its turn within 5 feet, move half your speed without provoking. From Sky to Earth (4): as an action a 30-foot-radius, 60-foot-high arrow volley within 120 feet (DC 16 Dexterity, 6d8 force or half). There Is No Escape (bonus action): cast hunter's mark (1 charge, 3rd level for 2, 5th for 3). Flaw: you must plan for everything; after 24 hours attuned you obey a trusted field commander, can't attune to the Red Queen's Burden or Violet King's Promise, become the charmed servant of the first wielder of either you meet, and guard either if found unowned, curable by greater restoration only after attunement ends.

magic-item:horn-of-the-wild-hunt-gsb.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn, and its blast is audible 300 feet away. As an action expend 1 to summon a war elk as find steed (giant elk statistics, but Large, AC 14 from hide barding, 37 hit points), which vanishes if your attunement ends. Or as an action expend 1 to send a spectral stampede in a 60-by-15-foot line: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d10 force damage and prone, or half and not prone on a success.

equipment:acid-vial.description: As an action, you can splash the contents of this vial onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw the vial up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the acid as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 acid damage.

equipment:alchemist-s-fire-flask.description: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

equipment:alms-box.description: A small box for alms, typically found in a priest's pack.

equipment:amulet.description: A holy symbol is a representation of a god or pantheon. It might be an amulet depicting a symbol representing a deity, the same symbol carefully engraved or inlaid as an emblem on a shield, or a tiny box holding a fragment of a sacred relic. Appendix B lists the symbols commonly associated with many gods in the multiverse. A cleric or paladin can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus. To use the symbol in this way, the caster must hold it in hand, wear it visibly, or bear it on a shield.

equipment:antitoxin-vial.description: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.

equipment:ball-bearings-bag-of-1-000.description: As an action, you can spill these tiny metal balls from their pouch to cover a level, square area that is 10 feet on a side. A creature moving across the covered area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.

equipment:block-and-tackle.description: A set of pulleys with a cable threaded through them and a hook to attach to objects, a block and tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

equipment:block-of-incense.description: A block of incense, typically found in a priest's pack.

equipment:book.description: A book might contain poetry, historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, diagrams and notes on gnomish contraptions, or just about anything else that can be represented using text or pictures. A book of spells is a spellbook (described later in this section).

equipment:caltrops.description: As an action, you can spread a bag of caltrops to cover a square area that is 5 feet on a side. Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage. Taking this damage reduces the creature's walking speed by 10 feet until the creature regains at least 1 hit point. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.

equipment:candle.description: For 1 hour, a candle sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

equipment:case-crossbow-bolt.description: This wooden case can hold up to twenty crossbow bolts.

equipment:case-map-or-scroll.description: This cylindrical leather case can hold up to ten rolled-up sheets of paper or five rolled-up sheets of parchment.

equipment:censer.description: A censer, typically found in a priest's pack.

equipment:chain-10-feet.description: A chain has 10 hit points. It can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength check.

equipment:climber-s-kit.description: A climber's kit includes special pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. You can use the climber's kit as an action to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the point where you anchored yourself, and you can't climb more than 25 feet away from that point without undoing the anchor.

equipment:component-pouch.description: A component pouch is a small, watertight leather belt pouch that has compartments to hold all the material components and other special items you need to cast your spells, except for those components that have a specific cost (as indicated in a spell's description).

equipment:crowbar.description: Using a crowbar grants advantage to Strength checks where the crowbar's leverage can be applied.

equipment:crystal.description: An arcane focus is a special item--an orb, a crystal, a rod, a specially constructed staff, a wand-like length of wood, or some similar item--designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus.

equipment:disguise-kit.description: This pouch of cosmetics, hair dye, and small props lets you create disguises that change your physical appearance. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to create a visual disguise.

equipment:emblem.description: A holy symbol is a representation of a god or pantheon. It might be an amulet depicting a symbol representing a deity, the same symbol carefully engraved or inlaid as an emblem on a shield, or a tiny box holding a fragment of a sacred relic. Appendix B lists the symbols commonly associated with many gods in the multiverse. A cleric or paladin can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus. To use the symbol in this way, the caster must hold it in hand, wear it visibly, or bear it on a shield.

equipment:fishing-tackle.description: This kit includes a wooden rod, silken line, corkwood bobbers, steel hooks, lead sinkers, velvet lures, and narrow netting.

equipment:forgery-kit.description: This small box contains a variety of papers and parchments, pens and inks, seals and sealing wax, gold and silver leaf, and other supplies necessary to create convincing forgeries of physical documents. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to create a physical forgery of a document.

equipment:healer-s-kit.description: This kit is a leather pouch containing bandages, salves, and splints. The kit has ten uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 hit points, without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

equipment:herbalism-kit.description: This kit contains a variety of instruments such as clippers, mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials used by herbalists to create remedies and potions. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to identify or apply herbs. Also, proficiency with this kit is required to create antitoxin and potions of healing.

equipment:holy-water-flask.description: As an action, you can splash the contents of this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a target creature, treating the holy water as an improvised weapon. If the target is a fiend or undead, it takes 2d6 radiant damage. A cleric or paladin may create holy water by performing a special ritual. The ritual takes 1 hour to perform, uses 25 gp worth of powdered silver, and requires the caster to expend a 1st-level spell slot.

equipment:hunting-trap.description: When you use your action to set it, this trap forms a saw-toothed steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 piercing damage and stop moving. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet long). A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 piercing damage to the trapped creature.

equipment:lamp.description: A lamp casts bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.

equipment:lantern-bullseye.description: A bullseye lantern casts bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for an additional 60 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.

equipment:lantern-hooded.description: A hooded lantern casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil. As an action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.

equipment:little-bag-of-sand.description: A small bag of sand, typically found in a scholar's pack.

equipment:lock.description: A key is provided with the lock. Without the key, a creature proficient with thieves' tools can pick this lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check. Your GM may decide that better locks are available for higher prices.

equipment:magnifying-glass.description: This lens allows a closer look at small objects. It is also useful as a substitute for flint and steel when starting fires. Lighting a fire with a magnifying glass requires light as bright as sunlight to focus, tinder to ignite, and about 5 minutes for the fire to ignite. A magnifying glass grants advantage on any ability check made to appraise or inspect an item that is small or highly detailed.

equipment:manacles.description: These metal restraints can bind a Small or Medium creature. Escaping the manacles requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity check. Breaking them requires a successful DC 20 Strength check. Each set of manacles comes with one key. Without the key, a creature proficient with thieves' tools can pick the manacles' lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check. Manacles have 15 hit points.

equipment:mess-kit.description: This tin box contains a cup and simple cutlery. The box clamps together, and one side can be used as a cooking pan and the other as a plate or shallow bowl.

equipment:oil-flask.description: Oil usually comes in a clay flask that holds 1 pint. As an action, you can splash the oil in this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a target creature or object, treating the oil as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target is covered in oil. If the target takes any fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an additional 5 fire damage from the burning oil. You can also pour a flask of oil on the ground to cover a 5-foot-square area, provided that the surface is level. If lit, the oil burns for 2 rounds and deals 5 fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn in the area. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

equipment:orb.description: An arcane focus is a special item--an orb, a crystal, a rod, a specially constructed staff, a wand-like length of wood, or some similar item--designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus.

equipment:poison-basic-vial.description: You can use the poison in this vial to coat one slashing or piercing weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. Applying the poison takes an action. A creature hit by the poisoned weapon or ammunition must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute before drying.

equipment:poisoner-s-kit.description: A poisoner's kit includes the vials, chemicals, and other equipment necessary for the creation of poisons. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to craft or use poisons.

equipment:pouch.description: A cloth or leather pouch can hold up to 20 sling bullets or 50 blowgun needles, among other things. A compartmentalized pouch for holding spell components is called a component pouch (described earlier in this section).

equipment:quiver.description: A quiver can hold up to 20 arrows.

equipment:ram-portable.description: You can use a portable ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus on the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you advantage on this check.

equipment:rations-1-day.description: Rations consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

equipment:reliquary.description: A holy symbol is a representation of a god or pantheon. It might be an amulet depicting a symbol representing a deity, the same symbol carefully engraved or inlaid as an emblem on a shield, or a tiny box holding a fragment of a sacred relic. Appendix B lists the symbols commonly associated with many gods in the multiverse. A cleric or paladin can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus. To use the symbol in this way, the caster must hold it in hand, wear it visibly, or bear it on a shield.

equipment:rod.description: An arcane focus is a special item--an orb, a crystal, a rod, a specially constructed staff, a wand-like length of wood, or some similar item--designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus.

equipment:rope-hempen-50-feet.description: Rope, whether made of hemp or silk, has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

equipment:rope-silk-50-feet.description: Rope, whether made of hemp or silk, has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

equipment:scale-merchant-s.description: A scale includes a small balance, pans, and a suitable assortment of weights up to 2 pounds. With it, you can measure the exact weight of small objects, such as raw precious metals or trade goods, to help determine their worth.

equipment:small-knife.description: A small knife, typically found in a scholar's pack.

equipment:spellbook.description: Essential for wizards, a spellbook is a leather-bound tome with 100 blank vellum pages suitable for recording spells.

equipment:sprig-of-mistletoe.description: A druidic focus might be a sprig of mistletoe or holly, a wand or scepter made of yew or another special wood, a staff drawn whole out of a living tree, or a totem object incorporating feathers, fur, bones, and teeth from sacred animals. A druid can use such an object as a spellcasting focus.

equipment:spyglass.description: Objects viewed through a spyglass are magnified to twice their size.

equipment:staff.description: An arcane focus is a special item--an orb, a crystal, a rod, a specially constructed staff, a wand-like length of wood, or some similar item--designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus.

equipment:string-10-feet.description: A 10-foot length of string, typically found in a burglar's pack.

equipment:tent-two-person.description: A simple and portable canvas shelter, a tent sleeps two.

equipment:tinderbox.description: This small container holds flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a torch--or anything else with abundant, exposed fuel--takes an action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

equipment:torch.description: A torch burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. If you make a melee attack with a burning torch and hit, it deals 1 fire damage.

These vehicles can't be rowed against any significant current, but they can be pulled upstream by draft animals on the shores. A rowboat weighs 100 pounds, in case adventurers carry it over land.

condition:blinded.description: A blinded creature can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature's attack rolls have disadvantage.

condition:charmed.description: A charmed creature can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on any ability check to interact socially with the creature.

condition:deafened.description: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

condition:frightened.description: A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

condition:grappled.description: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed. The condition ends if the grappler is incapacitated, or if the creature is removed from the grappler's reach by an effect such as Thunderwave.

condition:incapacitated.description: An incapacitated creature can't take actions or reactions.

condition:invisible.description: An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense; for hiding, it is heavily obscured. Its location can be detected by noise or tracks. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage, and its attack rolls have advantage.

condition:paralyzed.description: A paralyzed creature is incapacitated and can't move or speak. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and any attack that hits it is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

condition:petrified.description: A petrified creature is transformed, along with any nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Its weight increases by a factor of ten, and it ceases aging. It is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and it automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. It has resistance to all damage and is immune to poison and disease.

condition:poisoned.description: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

condition:prone.description: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up and thereby ends the condition. It has disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against it has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet, otherwise disadvantage.

condition:restrained.description: A restrained creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and its attack rolls have disadvantage. It has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

condition:stunned.description: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against it have advantage.

condition:unconscious.description: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. It drops whatever it's holding and falls prone. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and any attack that hits it is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

condition:exhaustion.description: Exhaustion is measured in six levels, and effects are cumulative. Level 1: disadvantage on ability checks. Level 2: speed halved. Level 3: disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Level 4: hit point maximum halved. Level 5: speed reduced to 0. Level 6: death. A creature removes one level of exhaustion when it finishes a long rest, provided it has also ingested some food and drink.

feat:aberrant-dragonmark.description: +1 Constitution, gain a cantrip and 1st level spell Buff, Debuff Prerequisite: No other dragonmark You have manifested an aberrant dragonmark. Determine its appearance and the flaw associated with it. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn a cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. In addition, choose a 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list. You learn that spell and can cast it through your mark. Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast the 1st-level spell through your mark, you can expend one of your Hit Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage. You also develop a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table. Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws OPTION: GREATER ABERRANT POWERS At the DM’s option, a character who has the Aberrant Dragonmark feat has a chance of manifesting greater power. Upon reaching 10th level, such a character has a 10 percent chance of gaining an epic boon from among the options in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master’s Guide. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a 10 percent chance the next time they gain a level. If the character gains a boon, the DM chooses it or determines it randomly. The character also permanently loses one of their Hit Dice, and their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1). This reduction can’t be reversed by any means.

feat:actor.prerequisite: 4th Level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) Feat
feat:actor.description: +1 Charisma, skilled at mimicry and dramatics Buff, Social, Deception Adept of the Black Robes

feat:alert.description: +5 Initiative, can't be surprised, no advantage for hidden attackers Buff, Detection Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative. You can't be surprised while you are conscious. Other creatures don’t gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

feat:athlete.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity - you have undergone extensive physical training Buff, Movement, Exploration You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement. Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement. You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

feat:charger.description: Make a melee attack or shove after the Dash action Movement, Combat When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack’s damage roll (if you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10 feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).

feat:chef.description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom, Cook's Utensils proficiency, cook special food Healing, Buff Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off , granting you the following benefits: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with cook’s utensils if you don’t already have it. As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and cook’s utensils on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points regains an extra 1d8 hit points. With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

feat:crossbow-expert.description: No loading, no within 5 ft. disadvantage, bonus action attack with hand crossbow Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow, you gain the following benefits: You ignore the loading property of crossbows with which you are proficient. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

feat:defensive-duelist.description: Add your proficiency bonus to your AC as a reaction Combat, Warding Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

feat:dual-wielder.description: +1 AC bonus, wield heavier weapons, draw or stow two weapons at once Buff, Combat You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light. You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

feat:dungeon-delver.description: You are alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons Buff, Detection, Warding Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors. You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps. You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps. Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal −5 penalty on your passive Wisdom (Perception) score.

feat:durable.description: +1 Constitution, minimum Con modifier x2 on spent Hit Dice Healing, Buff Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

feat:elemental-adept.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
feat:elemental-adept.description: Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type Damage, Control Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

feat:fey-touched.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn misty step and another 1st level spell Buff, Utility Your exposure to the Feywild’s magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the misty step spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the divination or enchantment school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat:grappler.description: You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling. You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

feat:great-weapon-master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage Damage, Combat You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

feat:healer.description: You are an able physician, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits: When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point. As an action, you can spend one use of a healer's kit to tend to a creature and restore 1d6 + 4 hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

feat:heavily-armored.description: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

feat:heavy-armor-master.description: +1 Strength, damage reduction from nonmagical weapons Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with heavy armor You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.

feat:inspiring-leader.description: Inspire your companions to grant temporary hit points Healing, Buff, Social Prerequisite: Charisma 13 or higher You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain temporary hit points from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest.

feat:keen-mind.description: +1 Intelligence, track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision Buff, Utility, Exploration You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You always know which way is north. You always know the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

feat:lightly-armored.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, proficiency with light armor Buff, Warding You have trained to master the use of light armor, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with light armor.

feat:linguist.description: +1 Intelligence, additional languages, create written ciphers Buff, Utility You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages of your choice. You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.

feat:lucky.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment. You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a d20, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled. You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

feat:mage-slayer.description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters Buff, Debuff, Combat You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration. You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.

feat:magic-initiate.description: Learn basic spells from a chosen class Buff, Utility Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class’s spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell to learn from that same list. Using this feat, you can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard.

feat:martial-adept.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits: You learn two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). You gain one superiority die, which is a d6 (this die is added to any superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

feat:medium-armor-master.description: You have practiced moving in medium armor Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with medium armor You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits: Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks. When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

feat:mobile.description: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits: Your speed increases by 10 feet. When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

feat:moderately-armored.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, proficiency with medium armor and shields Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with light armor You have trained to master the use of medium armor and shields, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

feat:mounted-combatant.description: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted Buff, Warding You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted. While you are mounted and aren't incapacitated, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount. You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead. If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

feat:observant.description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom, quick to notice details of your environment Buff, Detection Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips. You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation) scores.

feat:piercer.description: +1 Strength, or Dexterity, reroll damage dice for piercing damage You have achieved a penetrating precision in combat, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack’s damage dice, and you must use the new roll. When you score a critical hit that deals piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra piercing damage the target takes.

feat:poisoner.description: Learn to make and use poisons in combat Buff, Combat You can prepare and deliver deadly poisons, granting you the following benefits: When you make a damage roll that deals poison damage, it ignores resistance to poison damage. You can apply poison to a weapon or piece of ammunition as a bonus action, instead of an action. You gain proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit if you don’t already have it. With one hour of work using a poisoner’s kit and expending 50 gp worth of materials, you can create a number of doses of potent poison equal to your proficiency bonus. Once applied to a weapon or piece of ammunition, the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon or ammunition. When a creature takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 poison damage and become poisoned until the end of your next turn.

feat:polearm-master.description: You can keep your enemies at bay with reach weapons Control, Combat You gain the following benefits: When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack. The weapon’s damage die for this attack is a d4, and it deals bludgeoning damage. While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

feat:resilient.description: +1 stat and proficiency with saving throws to a chosen ability score Buff, Warding Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

feat:ritual-caster.prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom of 13 or higher
