feat:ritual-caster.description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals Prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom of 13 or higher You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals. These spells are written in a ritual book, which you must have in hand while casting one of them. When you choose this feat, you acquire a ritual book holding two 1st-level spells of your choice. Choose one of the following classes: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You must choose your spells from that class’s spell list, and the spells you choose must have the ritual tag. The class you choose also determines your spellcasting ability for these spells: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard. If you come across a spell in written form, such as a magical spell scroll or a wizard’s spellbook, you might be able to add it to your ritual book. The spell must be on the spell list for the class you chose, the spell’s level can be no higher than half your level (rounded up), and it must have the ritual tag. The process of copying the spell into your ritual book takes 2 hours per level of the spell, and costs 50 gp per level. The cost represents material components you expend as you experiment with the spell to master it, as well as the fine inks you need to record it.

feat:savage-attacker.description: Reroll damage dice for melee weapon attacks Damage, Combat Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon’s damage dice and use either total.

feat:sentinel.description: Take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard Control, Warding You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard, gaining the following benefits: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach. When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.

feat:shadow-touched.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn invisibility and another 1st level spell Buff, Utility Your exposure to the Shadowfell’s magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the invisibility spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the illusion or necromancy school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat:sharpshooter.description: Ranged weapons mastery - make shots that others find impossible Damage, Buff You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

feat:shield-master.description: Use shields not just for protection but also for offense Damage, Combat, Warding You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You gain the following benefits while you are wielding a shield: If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield. If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you. If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

feat:skill-expert.description: +1 to an ability score, +1 proficiency, expertise You have honed your proficiency with particular skills, granting you the following benefits: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill you choose must be one that isn’t already benefiting from a feature, such as Expertise, that doubles your proficiency bonus.

feat:skilled.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

feat:skulker.description: You are expert at slinking through shadows Buff, Deception Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher You are expert at slinking through shadows. You gain the following benefits: You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding. When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged weapon attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

feat:slasher.description: +1 Strength, or Dexterity, wound and disable targets with bladed weapons Buff, Combat You’ve learned where to cut to have the greatest results, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage, you can reduce the speed of the target by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. When you score a critical hit that deals slashing damage to a creature, you grievously wound it. Until the start of your next turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.

feat:spell-sniper.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
feat:spell-sniper.description: Enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells Buff, Combat Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells, gaining the following benefits: When you cast a spell that requires you to make an attack roll, the spell’s range is doubled. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll. Choose the cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. Your spellcasting ability for this cantrip depends on the spell list you chose from: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard.

feat:svirfneblin-magic.description: Inherit the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors Deception, Warding, Species Feat Prerequisite: Gnome (deep gnome) You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you cast them at their lowest possible levels.

feat:tavern-brawler.description: +1 Strength or Constitution, improved improvised weapons Damage, Utility, Combat Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

feat:telekinetic.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn mage hand, and move things with your mind. Control You learn to move things with your mind, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the mage hand cantrip. You can cast it without verbal or somatic components, and you can make the spectral hand invisible. If you already know this spell, its range increases by 30 feet when you cast it. Its spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. As a bonus action, you can try to telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat) or be moved 5 feet toward you or away from you. A creature can willingly fail this save.

feat:telepathic.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Telepathy 60 ft. Communication, Psionic You awaken the ability to mentally connect with others, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn’t give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically. You can cast the detect thoughts spell, requiring no spell slot or components, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. If you have spell slots of 2nd level or higher, you can cast this spell with them.

feat:tough.description: Gain +2 hit points per character level Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

feat:war-caster.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
feat:war-caster.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat Combat, Warding Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage. You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands. When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

feat:weapon-master.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, 4 additional weapon proficiencies Buff, Combat You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.

feat:bountiful-luck.description: Reaction when an ally you can see within 30 feet rolls a 1 on an attack, check or save: it rerolls and must use the new roll. You can't use Lucky until the end of your next turn.

feat:dragon-fear.description: +1 Str, Con or Cha. Spend a Breath Weapon use to roar instead: chosen creatures within 30 feet that can see or hear you make a Wis save (DC 8 + proficiency + Cha) or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save when they take damage.

feat:dragon-hide.description: +1 Str, Con or Cha. Unarmored AC 13 + Dex (shields allowed). Retractable claws: unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Str slashing.

feat:drow-high-magic.description: Detect magic at will; levitate and dispel magic once each per long rest without a slot. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.

feat:dwarven-fortitude.description: +1 Con. When you take the Dodge action in combat, spend a Hit Die to heal its roll + Con mod (min 1).

feat:elven-accuracy.description: +1 Dex, Int, Wis or Cha. With advantage on an attack using Dex, Int, Wis or Cha, reroll one of the dice once.

feat:fade-away.description: +1 Dex or Int. Reaction right after taking damage: invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or force a save. Once per short or long rest.

feat:fey-teleportation.description: +1 Int or Cha. Speak, read and write Sylvan. Misty step once per short or long rest without a slot (Intelligence).

feat:flames-of-phlegethos.description: +1 Int or Cha. Reroll 1s on your spells' fire damage dice (must keep the reroll). After casting a fire spell, flames wreathe you until the end of your next turn: bright light 30 feet, dim 30 more, and a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire.

feat:infernal-constitution.description: +1 Con. Resistance to cold and poison damage; advantage on saves against being poisoned.

feat:orcish-fury.description: +1 Str or Con. Once per short or long rest, on a simple or martial weapon hit, roll one weapon damage die again and add it. Right after Relentless Endurance, reaction to make one weapon attack.

feat:prodigy.description: One skill, one tool and one language of your choice, plus expertise in one skill you're proficient in that isn't already doubled.

feat:second-chance.description: +1 Dex, Con or Cha. Reaction when a creature you can see hits you with an attack: it rerolls. Usable again after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest.

feat:squat-nimbleness.description: +1 Str or Dex. +5 feet walking speed. Proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics. Advantage on Athletics or Acrobatics checks to escape a grapple.

feat:wood-elf-magic.description: One druid cantrip of your choice; longstrider and pass without trace once each per long rest without a slot. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability.

feat:artificer-initiate.description: One artificer cantrip and one 1st-level artificer spell (Intelligence); cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest without a slot or with your slots. Proficiency with one artisan's tool, usable as a focus for your Intelligence spells.

feat:eldritch-adept.description: Learn one Eldritch Invocation (Int, Wis or Cha, chosen now); one with a prerequisite only if you're a warlock who meets it. Swap it when you gain a level.

feat:fighting-initiate.description: Learn one fighter Fighting Style you don't have; swap it at levels that grant an Ability Score Improvement.

feat:gunner.description: +1 Dex. Proficiency with firearms, ignore their loading property, and no disadvantage on ranged attacks for being within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

feat:metamagic-adept.description: Learn two sorcerer Metamagic options (one per spell unless an option says otherwise; swap one at Ability Score Improvement levels) and 2 sorcery points usable only on Metamagic, regained on a long rest.

feat:revenant-blade.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). While wielding a double-bladed scimitar with two hands, +1 AC, and it has the finesse property for you.

feat:anvilwrought.description: Forged by Purphoros. Constructed Resilience: advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison; no need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep; immune to disease; magic can't put you to sleep. Sentry's Rest: a long rest is 6 hours motionless but aware.

feat:heroic-destiny.description: Defy Death: advantage on death saving throws. Hard to Kill: once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

feat:iconoclast.description: Enlightened Protection: cast protection from evil and good on yourself once per long rest without material components (Wisdom). Reject the Gods: you can't gain or lose piety. At 5th level cast dispel magic once per long rest; at 11th dispel evil and good once per long rest and dispel magic at 4th level; at 17th antimagic field once per long rest and dispel magic at 5th level.

feat:inscrutable.description: Psychic Shield: resistance to psychic damage. Sphinx's Shroud: immune to effects that sense your emotions or read your thoughts; Insight checks to read your intentions have disadvantage.

feat:lifelong-companion.description: Boon Aura: allies within 5 feet have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed while you aren't incapacitated. Companion's Protection: once per long rest, reaction when a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack roll to be hit instead.

feat:nyxborn.description: Cloak of Stars: once per long rest, action to wrap yourself in starlight for 1 minute, giving attack rolls against you disadvantage. Nyxborn Resistance: resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

feat:oracle.description: Ears of the Oracle: speak, read and write Celestial, and a god can speak through you. Oracle's Insight: once per short or long rest add 1d10 to an ability check (after rolling, before the result). Instead of a god's piety benefits: piety 3+ augury as a ritual, 10+ divination as a ritual, 25+ commune as a ritual and can't be surprised, each once per long rest (Wisdom); 50+ +2 Intelligence or Wisdom and that maximum.

feat:pious.description: Pious Protection: once per long rest, reroll a failed save and use the new roll. Religious Study: advantage on Religion checks about your god. Starting Piety: 3 with your chosen god.

feat:unscarred.description: Unscarred Resilience: once per short or long rest, reaction when you take damage to reduce it by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier.

feat:strixhaven-initiate.description: Choose a Strixhaven college; learn two of its cantrips and one 1st-level spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots (Int, Wis or Cha). Lorehold: two of light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, plus a 1st-level cleric or wizard spell. Prismari: two of fire bolt, prestidigitation, ray of frost, plus a 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell. Quandrix: two of druidcraft, guidance, mage hand, plus a 1st-level druid or wizard spell. Silverquill: two of sacred flame, thaumaturgy, vicious mockery, plus a 1st-level bard or cleric spell. Witherbloom: two of chill touch, druidcraft, spare the dying, plus a 1st-level druid or wizard spell.

feat:strixhaven-mascot.description: Cast find familiar as a ritual, with your college's mascot as a form (spirit statue, art elemental, fractal, inkling or pest). When you Attack, forgo one attack to let it attack with its reaction. Action: swap places with it within 60 feet, once per long rest or by spending a 2nd-level or higher slot.

feat:divinely-favored.description: Learn one cleric cantrip, augury, and one 1st-level spell set by your alignment: a warlock spell if evil, a cleric spell if good, a druid spell if neutral. Cast augury and the 1st-level spell once each per long rest without a slot, or with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with this feat), and you can use a holy symbol as a focus for spells using it.

feat:initiate-of-high-sorcery.prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Sorcerer or Wizard class or Mage of High Sorcery background
feat:initiate-of-high-sorcery.description: Choose a moon of Krynn. Learn one wizard cantrip and two 1st-level spells from its list. Nuitari: dissonant whispers, false life, hex, ray of sickness. Lunitari: color spray, disguise self, feather fall, longstrider. Solinari: comprehend languages, detect evil and good, protection from evil and good, shield. Cast each 1st-level spell once per long rest without a slot, or with any slots. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with this feat).

feat:adept-of-the-black-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-black-robes.description: Ambitious Magic: learn one 2nd-level enchantment or necromancy spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Life Channel: when a creature you can see within 60 feet fails a save against a damaging spell you cast, spend Hit Dice equal to the spell's level, roll them, and add the total to its damage.

feat:adept-of-the-red-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-red-robes.description: Insightful Magic: learn one 2nd-level illusion or transmutation spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Magical Balance: when you roll 9 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll or ability check, treat it as a 10; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:adept-of-the-white-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Solinari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-white-robes.description: Protective Magic: learn one 2nd-level abjuration or divination spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Protective Ward: when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction and expend a spell slot to reduce the damage by d6s equal to the slot's level plus your spellcasting modifier.

feat:squire-of-solamnia.prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Fighter or Paladin class or Knight of Solamnia background
feat:squire-of-solamnia.description: Mount Up: mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement. Precise Strike: once per turn, give a weapon attack roll against a creature advantage; on a hit add 1d8 to the damage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest, spent only on a hit.

feat:knight-of-the-crown.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution (max 20). Commanding Rally: as a bonus action, an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you can make one weapon attack with its reaction, adding 1d8 damage on a hit; proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.

feat:knight-of-the-rose.description: +1 Constitution, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Bolstering Rally: as a bonus action, a creature you can see within 30 feet (you included) that can see or hear you gains temporary HP equal to 1d8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the score this feat raised; proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.

feat:knight-of-the-sword.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Demoralizing Strike: once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the score this feat raised) or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn; on a success it has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.

feat:scion-of-the-outer-planes.description: Choose a plane type for a damage resistance and a cantrip (cast without material components; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma chosen with this feat). Chaotic: poison, minor illusion. Evil: necrotic, chill touch. Good: radiant, sacred flame. Lawful: force, guidance. The Outlands: psychic, mage hand.

feat:agent-of-order.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Lawful) feat
feat:agent-of-order.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Stasis Strike: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d8 force and it makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your Scion spellcasting modifier) or is restrained until the start of your next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:baleful-scion.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Evil) feat
feat:baleful-scion.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Grasp of Avarice: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d6 + proficiency bonus necrotic and regain that many HP. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:cohort-of-chaos.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Chaotic) feat
feat:cohort-of-chaos.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Chaotic Flare: when you roll a 1 or 20 on an attack roll or save, roll a d4 for a flare lasting until the end of your next turn (one at a time). 1 Battle Fury: a creature you can see has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on ability checks. 2 Disruption Field: creatures starting their turn within 5 feet of you or first entering that area on a turn take 1d8 force. 3 Unbound: you can spend movement to teleport that far to an unoccupied space you can see, once. 4 Wailing Winds: creatures within 15 feet of you, you included, have disadvantage on Wisdom saves.

feat:outlands-envoy.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (The Outlands) feat
feat:outlands-envoy.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Crossroads Emissary: learn misty step and tongues; cast each once per long rest without a slot (tongues needs no material components), or with slots, using your Scion spellcasting ability.

feat:planar-wanderer.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes feat
feat:planar-wanderer.description: Planar Adaptation: after each long rest, choose resistance to acid, cold or fire until your next long rest. Portal Cracker: as an action, concentrate on a portal within 5 feet and make a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check; on a success force it open or closed for 1 hour (its key works only with a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check as an action), on a failure take 3d8 psychic and can't try that portal again until a long rest. Portal Sense: you know the direction to the last portal you used on the same plane, and once per long rest, as an action, detect portals within 30 feet not behind total cover.

feat:righteous-heritor.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Good) feat
feat:righteous-heritor.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Soothe Pain: when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:rune-shaper.prerequisite: Spellcasting feature or Rune Carver background
feat:rune-shaper.description: Learn comprehend languages; cast it once per long rest without a slot, or with any slots. Rune Magic: you know runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down). After each long rest, inscribe each on a nonmagical object you touch and know its 1st-level spell until your next long rest; while carrying a marked object, cast that spell with your slots, or once per long rest per rune without a slot or material components. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the ability (chosen with this feat). Swap one rune each level. Runes: Cloud fog cloud, Death inflict wounds, Dragon chromatic orb, Enemy disguise self, Fire burning hands, Friend speak with animals, Frost armor of Agathys, Hill goodberry, Journey longstrider, King command, Mountain entangle, Stone sanctuary, Storm thunderwave.

feat:strike-of-the-giants.prerequisite: Martial weapon proficiency or Giant Foundling background
feat:strike-of-the-giants.description: Choose one strike. Once per turn when you hit with a melee or thrown weapon attack, add its effect (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Con modifier); proficiency bonus uses per long rest. Cloud: +1d4 thunder, and on a failed Wis save you are invisible to the creature until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Fire: +1d10 fire. Frost: +1d6 cold, and on a failed Con save its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. Hill: +1d6 of the weapon's type, and on a failed Str save it falls prone. Stone: +1d6 force, and on a failed Str save it is pushed 10 feet. Storm: +1d6 lightning, and on a failed Con save it has disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.

feat:ember-of-the-fire-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Fire Strike) feat
feat:ember-of-the-fire-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Born of Flame: resistance to fire. Searing Ignition: once per turn, replace one attack of your Attack action with a 15-foot burst: chosen creatures make a Dex save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier), taking 1d8 + proficiency bonus fire and blinded until the start of your next turn, or half damage only on a success. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:fury-of-the-frost-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Frost Strike) feat
feat:fury-of-the-frost-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Born of Ice: resistance to cold. Frigid Retaliation: right after a creature you can see within 30 feet hits and damages you, use your reaction to force a Con save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier); on a failure it takes 1d8 + proficiency bonus cold and has speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:guile-of-the-cloud-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Cloud Strike) feat
feat:guile-of-the-cloud-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Charisma (max 20). Cloudy Escape: when a creature you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to resist its damage, then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:keenness-of-the-stone-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Stone Strike) feat
feat:keenness-of-the-stone-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Cavernous Sight: darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet to existing darkvision. Stone Throw: as a bonus action, make a ranged spell attack with a rock (range 60 feet, using the raised ability): 1d10 force, and the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + that modifier) or falls prone. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:soul-of-the-storm-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Storm Strike) feat
feat:soul-of-the-storm-giant.description: +1 Strength, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Maelstrom Aura: as a bonus action, a 10-foot aura surrounds you until the start of your next turn (or until incapacitated): you resist lightning and thunder, attacks against you have disadvantage, and a creature starting its turn in it can be forced to make a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier) or have half speed until the start of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:vigor-of-the-hill-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Hill Strike) feat
feat:vigor-of-the-hill-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Bulwark: when an effect would move you 5 feet or more or knock you prone, use your reaction to stay put and standing. Iron Stomach: when you eat during a short rest and spend Hit Dice, regain extra HP equal to your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus.

feat:gift-of-the-chromatic-dragon.description: Chromatic Infusion: once per long rest, as a bonus action, touch a simple or martial weapon so that for 1 minute it deals an extra 1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice) on a hit. Reactive Resistance: when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage, use your reaction to resist that instance; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:gift-of-the-gem-dragon.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Telekinetic Reprisal: when a creature within 10 feet damages you, use your reaction to force a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier): 2d8 force and pushed 10 feet, or half damage and no push on a success. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:gift-of-the-metallic-dragon.description: Draconic Healing: learn cure wounds; cast it once per long rest without a slot, or with slots, using Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (chosen with this feat). Protective Wings: when you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack, use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to its AC against that attack; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:blade-barrier.description: When you use a twinblade's Whirl special bonus action, you also make one extra melee attack with it (d4 damage die, same ability modifier), and until the start of your next turn creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they enter your reach or make a melee attack against you within it.

feat:cat-s-caress.description: After taking the Attack action with a claw in one hand, use a bonus action to make up to two melee attacks with a claw in your other hand (no ability modifier to damage unless negative or you have Two-Weapon Fighting). Advantage on claw attacks against a creature you are grappling. Equip or unequip one claw or a pair as an action or bonus action.

feat:fearsome-flourisher.description: When you take the Attack action with a nunchaku, use a bonus action to make one more melee attack with it (d4 damage die). When you take the Flourish special action with a nunchaku and don't fail the Dexterity check, a bonus action forces one creature in reach to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier, + proficiency bonus if proficient in Intimidation) or be frightened of you until the start of your next turn.

feat:scourge-master.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When you hit with a whip or tetherhook, use a bonus action to try to disarm the target of a shield or held item (your Strength or Dexterity check contested by its Strength); it lands midway between you. You can pull items under 1 pound within your weapon's reach back to you.

feat:spray-n-pray.prerequisite: Proficiency with a magitech firearm or tommybow
feat:spray-n-pray.description: Reload firearms and tommybows as an action or bonus action. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks. When you attack with a one-handed weapon, use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed firearm or tommybow you hold. After attacking with a tommybow or magitech firearm, use a bonus action to make one or two more ranged attacks with it (-5 to both if you make two; no ability modifier to damage unless negative).

feat:expert-enchanter.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Double your proficiency bonus on Enchanting checks with proficient skills, adjust enchanting quirk rolls by up to half your proficiency bonus, and each hour of enchanting counts as 2 hours.

feat:expert-forger.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Double your proficiency bonus on Manufacturing checks with proficient tools, adjust enchanting and manufacturing quirk rolls by up to half your proficiency bonus, and each hour of forging counts as 2 hours.

feat:field-cook.description: Proficiency with cook's utensils. Replace one ingredient type in a recipe with any other. Before rolling quirks, you can replace one boon roll with inspiration for everyone who eats a portion. After rolling quirks, remove one flaw or add a rolled boon.

feat:forgemaster.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Advantage on Manufacturing checks with proficient tools, proficiency with two tools of your choice, and each hour of forging counts as 3 hours.

feat:jack-of-all-tools.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Proficiency with three tools of your choice. Add half your proficiency bonus to Manufacturing checks with unproficient tools, without disadvantage. Each hour of manufacturing counts as 2 hours.

feat:weavebonder.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Advantage on Enchanting checks with proficient skills; roll a quirk's random element twice and choose; each hour of enchanting counts as 3 hours.

feat:expert-harvester.description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Double your proficiency bonus on Harvesting checks with proficient skills; add your proficiency bonus when you lack the required skill; add your full proficiency bonus when helping; no disadvantage for doing both Assessment and Carving alone.

feat:reapmaster.description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Proficiency in Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion, or Survival, and advantage on Harvesting checks with proficient skills.

feat:boomerang-expert.description: Boomerangs deal 1d8 for you, long range doesn't impose disadvantage with them, and you catch a thrown boomerang automatically.

feat:bumbling-fool.description: When you fail an ability check with a d20 roll at or below half your level (round up), replace the roll with 15. Three uses per long rest.

feat:canden-and-moon-s-master-cut.prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Canden and Moon's Sword School
feat:canden-and-moon-s-master-cut.description: +5 feet speed. After rolling initiative, use your reaction to draw a weapon, move half your speed, and make one melee attack if you end within reach. Once per long rest when hit, use your reaction for +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against that attack.

feat:cloud-hopper.description: While moving, step on conjured clouds through the air for up to 5 times your proficiency bonus feet per move (falling if you end aloft). Fog Cloud and Gust of Wind once each per long rest without a slot, or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

feat:coven-witch.description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Learn two random common and uncommon potion recipes, and two 1st-level divination, conjuration, or transmutation spells, each castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:forager.description: +1 Wisdom. Proficiency in Survival (expertise if already proficient). Foraging yields twice the common or uncommon ingredients.

feat:freediver.description: +1 Constitution. Swim speed equal to twice your Constitution score (rounded up to 5 feet), or +10 feet if you already swim. Triple your Constitution modifier for holding your breath, and resistance to cold damage.

feat:group-combatant.description: Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage to you is reduced by 2 (minimum 1); flanking grants no advantage against you; after you provoke one opportunity attack on your turn, your movement provokes no more that turn.

feat:light-foot.description: +1 AC when not in heavy armor; forgo one attack of the Attack action to move half your speed; nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement; move through hostile creatures' spaces.

feat:magically-mischievous.description: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand (expertise if proficient). When you steal a palm-sized object with Sleight of Hand, make it invisible for 1 minute as by Obscure Object, proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:member-of-aha.description: +1 Intelligence. You learn Jolt, plus Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Identify, or Illusory Script, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence).

feat:minor-corruption.description: +1 AC while below half your hit points. You need no spellcasting focus or uncosted, unconsumed material components. Once per long rest, as a reaction negate up to three times your level in damage; at the end of your next turn and each turn for 1 minute make a Constitution save (DC 10 or a third of the damage, whichever is higher), taking the negated damage on the first failure.

feat:nakudama-s-electric-bloodline.description: Resistance to lightning. Your tongue is a finesse, reach unarmed strike dealing 1d6 + Strength or Dexterity lightning (1d8 at 5th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 17th). When grappled, use your reaction to force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency bonus) or the grappler takes 1d10 lightning and the grapple ends.

feat:nakudama-s-toxin-bloodline.description: Resistance to poison and advantage against being poisoned. As an action spit poison at up to proficiency bonus creatures within 30 feet: Constitution save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency bonus), 1d8 + proficiency bonus poison or half.

feat:postal-knight.description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. Proficiency in Athletics and Survival, and exhaustion doesn't give you disadvantage on ability checks.

feat:potion-brewer.description: When brewing, you can use the second-highest ingredient attribute number instead of the first, and roll percentile dice: at or under your level, you make two potions.

feat:tellu-and-scale-s-master-cut.prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Tellu and Scale's Sword School
feat:tellu-and-scale-s-master-cut.description: One-handed versatile weapon: once before your next turn when a creature in reach misses you with a melee attack, it takes damage equal to twice your proficiency bonus. Two-handed: when a creature in reach misses you with a melee weapon attack, use your reaction to force a Dexterity save (DC 8 + Strength + proficiency bonus) or it falls prone.

feat:toraf-and-bolder-s-master-cut.prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Toraf and Bolder's Sword School
feat:toraf-and-bolder-s-master-cut.description: Before a proficient melee weapon attack, take -5 to hit for a strike: Head (target has disadvantage on its next attack), Torso (it can't speak until your next turn, then immune for a minute), or Leg (-10 feet speed, minimum 10, until your next turn). One per attack.

feat:vocalist-arcanist.description: When a spell you cast calls for a save or a spell attack, make a Charisma (Performance) check against DC 10 + the spell's level (deciding after the roll); on a success your proficiency bonus is doubled for that attack roll or save DC. Three successes per dawn.

feat:wetland-explorer.description: Choose two creature types. Add your proficiency bonus to initiative when hostile creatures of those types are present, +5 to Stealth and Survival checks involving them, and +2 to attack rolls against them.

feat:aerial-expert.description: No 10-foot run-up for long and high jumps, which can use Strength or Dexterity and double in distance. Dash while gliding to fly an extra distance equal to your speed, and change direction freely while gliding, gaining up to 10 feet of altitude once per descent.

feat:bandit-cunning.description: Once per long rest, use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to a saving throw. In combat, as an action make an Investigation check against DC 10 + the CR of a creature you've seen fight to learn one combat fact (a resistance or immunity, a condition immunity, a damaging or protective ability, an action option, or a special sense).

feat:heavy-glider.description: Glide while holding heavy weapons and wearing heavy armor if not encumbered. You can land a glide on a Large or smaller hostile creature: on a won Strength contest it is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone; otherwise you land nearby.

feat:opportunistic-thief.description: +1 Dexterity. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, a Sleight of Hand check against 10 + its Dexterity modifier steals an item it isn't holding or wearing. Out of combat, items you steal can be instantly concealed or swapped for another object.

feat:perfect-landing.description: +1 Dexterity. Fall damage uses d4s, you don't fall prone from falling damage, and you ignore the first 30 feet of a fall.

feat:speech-of-the-ancient-beasts.description: +1 Charisma. Large or larger beasts are friendly unless you attack them, you have advantage on Charisma checks against them, and you speak Giant Eagle, Giant Elk, and Giant Owl and can be understood by any Large or larger beast.

feat:woodwise.description: Proficiency in Survival or Nature, you ignore difficult terrain, and you can't become lost in nature except by magic.

feat:fate-touched.description: Fortune's Grace: once per long rest, reroll your own attack roll, ability check, or save before the outcome is known, or force a creature you can see to reroll an attack against you or a save against your spell or feature (rerolling both dice if it had advantage or disadvantage).

feat:cruel.description: You have cruelty dice (d6) equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, one per turn: add one to damage you deal, gain temporary hit points equal to one when you crit, or add one to an Intimidation check.

feat:flash-recall.prerequisite: Spellcasting feature from a class that prepares spells
feat:flash-recall.description: Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, prepare a spell of 1st level or higher (of a level you have slots for) in place of a prepared spell of equal or higher level.

feat:mystic-conflux.description: You can attune to four magic items at once, and cast identify once per long rest without a slot or material components.

feat:remarkable-recovery.description: +1 Constitution. When stabilized while dying, regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier, and regain that much extra whenever a spell, potion, or class feature heals you.

feat:spelldriver.prerequisite: Character level 11 or higher; Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:spelldriver.description: When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell as a bonus action, you can still cast another 1st-level or higher spell with your action, but only one spell that turn can be 3rd level or higher.

feat:thrown-arms-master.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Simple and martial melee weapons gain the thrown property for you (one-handed 20/60, two-handed 15/30), existing thrown ranges improve by 20/40, and a missed thrown light weapon returns to your hand at the end of your turn.

feat:vital-sacrifice.description: As a bonus action, take 1d6 unreducible necrotic for a blood boon lasting 1 hour: spend it to add 1d6 to an attack roll, deal +2d6 necrotic on a hit, or subtract 1d4 from a creature's Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution save against you.

feature:feature:fighting-style.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

feature:fighting-style:archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

feature:fighting-style:defense.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

feature:fighting-style:dueling.description: When you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

feature:fighting-style:great-weapon-figh.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2. The weapon must have the two-handed or versatile property for you to gain this benefit.

feature:fighting-style:protection.description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You must be wielding a shield.

feature:fighting-style:two-weapon-fighti.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.

feature:metamagic:metamagic.description: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two of the following Metamagic options of your choice. You gain another one at 10th and 17th level. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

feature:metamagic:careful-spell.description: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell.

feature:metamagic:distant-spell.description: When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell. When you cast a spell that has a range of touch, you can spend 1 sorcery point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

feature:metamagic:empowered-spell.description: When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls. You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

feature:metamagic:extended-spell.description: When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

feature:metamagic:heightened-spell.description: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

feature:metamagic:quickened-spell.description: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

feature:metamagic:subtle-spell.description: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

feature:metamagic:twinned-spell.description: When you cast a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip). To be eligible, a spell must be incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level. For example, magic missile and scorching ray aren't eligible, but ray of frost is.

feature:feature:eldritch-invocations.description: In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed eldritch invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability. At 2nd level, you gain two eldritch invocations of your choice. Your invocation options are detailed at the end of the class description. When you gain certain warlock levels, you gain additional invocations of your choice, as shown in the Invocations Known column of the Warlock table. Additionally, when you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the invocations you know and replace it with another invocation that you could learn at that level.

feature:invocation:agonizing-blast.description: When you cast eldritch blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals on a hit.

feature:invocation:armor-of-shadows.description: You can cast mage armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

feature:invocation:beast-speech.description: You can cast speak with animals at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:beguiling-influence.description: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

feature:invocation:book-of-ancient-secre.description: You can now inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Choose two 1st-level spells that have the ritual tag from any class's spell list (the two needn't be from the same list). The spells appear in the book and don't count against the number of spells you know. With your Book of Shadows in hand, you can cast the chosen spells as rituals. You can't cast the spells except as rituals, unless you've learned them by some other means. You can also cast a warlock spell you know as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. On your adventures, you can add other ritual spells to your Book of Shadows. When you find such a spell, you can add it to the book if the spell's level is equal to or less than half your warlock level (rounded up) and if you can spare the time to transcribe the spell. For each level of the spell, the transcription process takes 2 hours and costs 50 gp for the rare inks needed to inscribe it.

feature:invocation:devil-s-sight.description: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

feature:invocation:eldritch-sight.description: You can cast detect magic at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:eldritch-spear.description: When you cast eldritch blast, its range is 300 feet.

feature:invocation:fiendish-vigor.description: You can cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot or material components.

feature:invocation:gaze-of-two-minds.description: You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use your action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.

feature:invocation:mask-of-many-faces.description: You can cast disguise self at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:misty-visions.description: You can cast silent image at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

feature:invocation:repelling-blast.description: When you hit a creature with eldritch blast, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

feature:invocation:thief-of-five-fates.description: You can cast bane once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:voice-of-the-chain-ma.description: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through your familiar's senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. Additionally, while perceiving through your familiar's senses, you can also speak through your familiar in your own voice, even if your familiar is normally incapable of speech.

feature:invocation:mire-the-mind.description: You can cast slow once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:one-with-shadows.description: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move or take an action or a reaction.

feature:invocation:sign-of-ill-omen.description: You can cast bestow curse once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:thirsting-blade.description: You can attack with your pact weapon twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

feature:invocation:bewitching-whispers.description: You can cast compulsion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:dreadful-word.description: You can cast confusion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:sculptor-of-flesh.description: You can cast polymorph once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:ascendant-step.description: You can cast levitate on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

feature:invocation:minions-of-chaos.description: You can cast conjure elemental once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

feature:invocation:otherworldly-leap.description: You can cast jump on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

feature:invocation:whispers-of-the-grave.description: You can cast speak with dead at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:lifedrinker.description: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

feature:invocation:chains-of-carceri.description: You can cast hold monster at will--targeting a celestial, fiend, or elemental--without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this invocation on the same creature again.

feature:invocation:master-of-myriad-form.description: You can cast alter self at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:visions-of-distant-re.description: You can cast arcane eye at will, without expending a spell slot.

feature:invocation:witch-sight.description: You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion or transmutation magic while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

feature:feature:rage.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain the following benefits if you aren't wearing heavy armor: - You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. - When you make a melee weapon Attack using Strength, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll. This bonus increases as you level. - You have Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. If you are able to cast Spells, you can't cast them or concentrate on them while raging. Your rage lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you are knocked Unconscious or if Your Turn ends and you haven't attacked a hostile creature since your last turn or taken damage since then. You can also end your rage on Your Turn as a Bonus Action. Once you have raged the maximum number of times for your barbarian level, you must finish a Long Rest before you can rage again. You may rage 2 times at 1st level, 3 at 3rd, 4 at 6th, 5 at 12th, and 6 at 17th.

feature:feature:unarmored-defense.description: While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

feature:feature:reckless-attack.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

feature:feature:danger-sense.description: At 2nd level, you gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells. To gain this benefit, you can't be blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

feature:feature:primal-path.description: At 3rd level, you choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage. Choose the Path of the Berserker or the Path of the Totem Warrior, both detailed at the end of the class description. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th levels.

feature:feature:extra-attack.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

feature:feature:fast-movement.description: Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

feature:feature:feral-instinct.description: By 7th level, your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

feature:feature:brutal-critical-1-die.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

feature:feature:relentless-rage.description: Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.

feature:feature:brutal-critical-2-dice.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

feature:feature:persistent-rage.description: Beginning at 15th level, your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

feature:feature:brutal-critical-3-dice.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

feature:feature:indomitable-might.description: Beginning at 18th level, if your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

feature:feature:primal-champion.description: At 20th level, you embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

feature:feature:spellcasting-bard.description: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality in harmony with your wishes and music. Your spells are part of your vast repertoire, magic that you can tune to different situations.

feature:feature:bardic-inspiration-d6.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. Once within the next 10 minutes, the creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after it rolls the d20 before deciding to use the Bardic Inspiration die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. Once the Bardic Inspiration die is rolled, it is lost. A creature can have only one Bardic Inspiration die at a time. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.  Your Bardic Inspiration die changes when you reach certain levels in this class. The die becomes a d8 at 5th level, a d10 at 10th level, and a d12 at 15th level.

feature:feature:jack-of-all-trades.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:song-of-rest-d6.description: Beginning at 2nd level, you can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain hit points at the end of the short rest by spending one or more Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points.  The extra hit points increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

feature:feature:bard-college.description: At 3rd level, you delve into the advanced techniques of a bard college of your choice, such as the College of Lore. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th and 14th level.

feature:feature:expertise.description: At 3rd level, choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies. At 10th level, you can choose another two skill proficiencies to gain this benefit.

feature:feature:font-of-inspiration.description: Beginning when you reach 5th level, you regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

feature:feature:countercharm.description: At 6th level, you gain the ability to use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, you can start a performance that lasts until the end of your next turn. During that time, you and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear you to gain this benefit. The performance ends early if you are incapacitated or silenced or if you voluntarily end it (no action required).

feature:feature:magical-secrets.description: By 10th level, you have plundered magical knowledge from a wide spectrum of disciplines. Choose two spells from any class, including this one. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip.  The chosen spells count as bard spells for you and are included in the number in the Spells Known column of the Bard table.  You learn two additional spells from any class at 14th level and again at 18th level.

feature:feature:superior-inspiration.description: At 20th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use.

feature:feature:spellcasting-cleric.description: As a conduit for divine power, you can cast cleric spells.

feature:feature:divine-domain.description: Choose one domain related to your deity, such as Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, or War. Only the Life domain is detailed in the Open Game Licensed SRD. Additional Domains are described in the official rulebooks or products from other publishers. Your domain grants you domain spells and other features when you choose it at 1st level. It also grants you additional ways to use Channel Divinity when you gain that feature at 2nd level, and additional benefits at 6th, 8th, and 17th levels.

feature:feature:domain-spells.description: Each domain has a list of spells--its domain spells--that you gain at the cleric levels noted in the domain description. Once you gain a domain spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you have a domain spell that doesn't appear on the cleric spell list, the spell is nonetheless a cleric spell for you.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-1-rest.description: At 2nd level, you gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Turn Undead and an effect determined by your domain. Some domains grant you additional effects as you advance in levels, as noted in the domain description. When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again. Some Channel Divinity effects require saving throws. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your cleric spell save DC. Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-turn-un.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

feature:feature:destroy-undead-cr-1-2-or.description: Starting at 5th level, when an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-2-rest.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

feature:feature:destroy-undead-cr-1-or-b.description: Starting at 5th level, when an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold.

feature:feature:divine-intervention.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can call on your deity to intervene on your behalf when your need is great. Imploring your deity's aid requires you to use your action. Describe the assistance you seek, and roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your cleric level, your deity intervenes. The GM chooses the nature of the intervention; the effect of any cleric spell or cleric domain spell would be appropriate. If your deity intervenes, you can't use this feature again for 7 days. Otherwise, you can use it again after you finish a long rest. At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

feature:feature:destroy-undead-cr-2-or-b.description: Starting at 5th level, when an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold.

feature:feature:destroy-undead-cr-3-or-b.description: Starting at 5th level, when an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold.

feature:feature:destroy-undead-cr-4-or-b.description: Starting at 5th level, when an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold.

feature:feature:supreme-healing.description: Starting at 17th level, when you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 hit points to a creature, you restore 12.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-3-rest.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity twice between rests, and beginning at 18th level, you can use it three times between rests. When you finish a short or long rest, you regain your expended uses.

feature:feature:divine-intervention-impr.description: At 20th level, your call for intervention succeeds automatically, no roll required.

feature:feature:spellcasting-druid.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will.

feature:feature:druidic.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

feature:feature:wild-shape-cr-1-4-or-bel.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into, as shown in the Beast Shapes table. At 2nd level, for example, you can transform into any beast that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower that doesn't have a flying or swimming speed. You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die. While you are transformed, the following rules apply: - Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the beast, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You also retain all of your skill and saving throw proficiencies, in addition to gaining those of the creature. If the creature has the same proficiency as you and the bonus in its stat block is higher than yours, use the creature's bonus instead of yours. If the creature has any legendary or lair actions, you can't use them. - When you transform, you assume the beast's hit points and Hit Dice. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of hit points you had before you transformed. However, if you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. For example, if you take 10 damage in animal form and have only 1 hit point left, you revert and take 9 damage. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 hit points, you aren't knocked unconscious. - You can't cast spells, and your ability to speak or take any action that requires hands is limited to the capabilities of your beast form. Transforming doesn't break your concentration on a spell you've already cast, however, or prevent you from taking actions that are part of a spell, such as call lightning, that you've already cast. - You retain the benefit of any features from your class, race, or other source and can use them if the new form is physically capable of doing so. However, you can't use any of your special senses, such as darkvision, unless your new form also has that sense. - You choose whether your equipment falls to the ground in your space, merges into your new form, or is worn by it. Worn equipment functions as normal, but the GM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

feature:feature:druid-circle.description: At 2nd level, you choose to identify with a circle of druids, such as the Circle of the Land. Your choice grants you features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

Worn equipment functions as normal, but the GM decides whether it is practical for the new form to wear a piece of equipment, based on the creature's shape and size. Your equipment doesn't change size or shape to match the new form, and any equipment that the new form can't wear must either fall to the ground or merge with it. Equipment that merges with the form has no effect until you leave the form.

feature:feature:timeless-body.description: Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

feature:feature:beast-spells.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

feature:feature:archdruid.description: At 20th level, you can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times. Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shape from Wild Shape.

feature:feature:second-wind.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

feature:feature:action-surge-1-use.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

feature:feature:martial-archetype.description: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques, such as Champion. The archetype you choose grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

feature:feature:fighter:extra-attack.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.

feature:feature:indomitable-1-use.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

feature:feature:extra-attack-2.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.

feature:feature:indomitable-2-uses.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

feature:feature:action-surge-2-uses.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action on top of your regular action and a possible bonus action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

feature:feature:indomitable-3-uses.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

feature:feature:extra-attack-3.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.

feature:feature:monk:unarmored-defense.description: Beginning at 1st level, while you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.
