feature:feature:witch-s-curse-hideous.description: Proficiency in Intimidation. When you roll initiative, one Humanoid you can see makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-hollow.description: When you or your familiar drops a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points of your witch level + Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-infested.description: Immune to disease. Your familiar can take the form of a swarm of rats from 2nd level and a swarm of insects from 7th level.

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-possessed.description: Gain one extra witch spell (of a level you have slots for) at 1st, 4th, 8th, and 12th level; these don't count against spells known.

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-starving.description: You need no food or drink (potions still work on you) and are immune to the poisoned condition.

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-visions.description: You can add your Charisma modifier to initiative rolls.

feature:feature:witch-s-curse-whispers.description: You can speak telepathically with any creature you can see within 30 feet that understands at least one language, shared or not.

feature:feature:hexes.description: You know two hexes at 1st level and more per the Hexes Known column (up to 7); each witch level you may swap one. Hexes use your spell attack bonus and spell save DC, need a verbal or somatic component (your choice), and if they last a duration you concentrate on them. Casting another hex ends concentration on the current hex, but you can concentrate on one hex and one spell together, making a single Constitution save for both. Hexes count as 0-level spells for effects like counterspell and dispel magic and stop working in an antimagic field.

feature:feature:hex-abate.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Charisma save; on a failure it loses its reactions through the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-apathy.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Charisma save; on a failure it is indifferent toward one creature of your choice it is hostile to until the end of your next turn, ending early if that creature attacks or harms it. Afterward it is hostile again unless the GM decides otherwise.

feature:feature:hex-beckon-familiar.description: Requires the Familiar feature. Cast find familiar as an action with no slot or material components; you can't do so again for 1 minute.

feature:feature:hex-bleeding.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure it loses an extra 1d4 hit points each time it takes damage until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-charm.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save; on a failure you charm it through the end of your next turn, and it knows afterward that you charmed it.

feature:feature:hex-dire-familiar.description: Requires the Familiar feature. Action, for 1 minute your familiar's current and maximum hit points rise by twice your witch level and it adds your Charisma modifier to damage rolls. You can cast other hexes while it lasts; you can't reuse it until the familiar is dismissed or the duration ends.

feature:feature:hex-disorient.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure it subtracts 1d6 from each attack roll it makes until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-doomward.description: Action, one ally other than you within 60 feet: if it would fall to 0 hit points before your next turn ends without being killed outright, it stays at 1. The hex then ends and can't be used on that creature again before you finish a short or long rest.

feature:feature:hex-duplicity.description: Action, a shadow duplicate guards you until the end of your next turn: when a creature attacks you, roll any die; on an odd result the attack hits the duplicate and misses, ending the hex, and on an even result it targets you normally.

feature:feature:hex-evil-eye.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is frightened of you through the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-fortune.description: Action, one other ally within 60 feet makes saving throws with advantage through the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-go-unseen.description: Action, you and your familiar turn invisible (as invisibility) until the end of your next turn or until either of you attacks or casts a spell. Can't be cast again for 1 minute.

feature:feature:hex-hobble.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Strength save; on a failure its speed becomes 10 feet until the end of your next turn, and a flying creature falls unless it can hover or is held aloft by magic.

feature:feature:hex-knowing.description: Action, Wisdom (Insight) checks have advantage for you through the end of your next turn and learn one fact about every creature within 30 feet: whether it can speak a language, whether it is at or below half its hit points, or its lowest ability score. You can learn only one such fact per creature, even with repeated castings.

feature:feature:hex-mire.description: Action, ground in a 30-foot radius around the point you choose becomes difficult-terrain swamp until the end of your next turn; you and your familiar move through it normally.

feature:feature:hex-misfortune.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet: until the end of your next turn, any 20 it rolls on a d20 becomes a 1.

feature:feature:hex-obfuscate.description: Action, a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on you spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area; it lasts through the end of your next turn unless a wind of 10 miles per hour or more blows it away.

feature:feature:hex-peacebond.description: Action, weapons and ammunition of every creature within 30 feet are locked in their sheaths, quivers, and holsters through the end of your next turn; a creature can use its action and a Strength check against your spell save DC to free its weapon.

feature:feature:hex-pox.description: Action, one creature you can see within 5 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure it is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-ruin.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save; on a failure its AC drops by 3 (minimum 10) until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:hex-scurry.description: Action, a nonmagical object of up to 10 pounds within 30 feet (not worn as clothing or armor, not held, not wrapped around a body) grows legs, pulls free of its owner, and runs 20 feet in a direction you choose, with you steering it at the start of your turn. It has AC 10 (or its own if higher) and stays animated until the end of your next turn or until picked up.

feature:feature:hex-shriek.description: Bonus action, you push each chosen Large or smaller creature within 5 feet back 5 feet.

feature:feature:hex-slumber.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it falls unconscious until it takes damage or the end of your next turn. Undead, creatures immune to charm, and creatures with current hit points above five times your witch level are unaffected.

feature:feature:hex-slur.description: Action, one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Charisma save; on a failure it can't speak coherently until the end of your next turn, and when it tries to cast a spell with a verbal component it rolls a d20, failing the casting on an odd result.

feature:feature:hex-tremors.description: Action, every grounded creature within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save, falling prone on a failure.

feature:feature:hex-ward.description: Action, one creature other than you within 60 feet reduces each instance of damage it takes by 3 until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:cackle.description: As a bonus action (requires a verbal component), extend the hex you are concentrating on by 1 round; it extends only for targets within 60 feet of you.

feature:feature:familiar.description: You learn find familiar, castable as a ritual without material components and free of your spells known. Your familiar acts right before or after you (your choice); once per turn, as an action or bonus action, you can have it use its reaction to attack; it can deliver your spells of any range, not just touch. It uses your spell attack bonus, adds your proficiency bonus to its AC, saves, and damage, and adds twice your witch level to its hit point maximum. Extra forms: death snail, flying book, homunculus, mock, moon jelly, pet rock, pseudodragon, rag doll, sprite, tin soldier, winter wolf pup, and yarn golem.

feature:feature:witch-s-craft.description: Choose a craft at 3rd level: Black Magic, Blood Magic, Green Magic, Purple Magic, Red Magic, Steel Magic, Tea Magic, Technicolor Magic, White Magic. It grants features at 3rd, 6th, 10th, and 14th level. Craft spells count as witch spells but not against spells known, and a hex granted by your craft doesn't count against hexes known.

feature:feature:insidious-spell.description: When a witch spell you cast affects a hostile creature that is the only target of your hex, it has disadvantage on its first save against that spell.

feature:feature:improved-familiar.description: Your familiar's attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity, and it can also take the form of a brass dragon wyrmling (no breath weapon), fright, grep, imp, or quasit.

feature:feature:dying-curse.description: When a creature drops you to 0 hit points without killing you outright, you can curse it for up to 24 hours: it rolls attacks, ability checks, and saves at disadvantage. Should you wake up or it is targeted by remove curse, the curse ends at the end of its next turn. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:grand-hex.description: You learn one grand hex at 11th level and another at 13th, 15th, and 18th. Grand hexes use your spell attack bonus and spell save DC and are not themselves hexes.

feature:feature:grand-hex-cauldron.description: You have alchemy points equal to half your witch level (rounded down), restored on a long rest. Spend 10 minutes and any number of points to brew potions that stay potent for 24 hours, with saves using your spell save DC. Costs: 1 point for animal friendship, growth, healing, or water breathing; 2 for oil of slipperiness, philter of love, greater healing, heroism, or resistance; 3 for clairvoyance, diminution, or gaseous form.

feature:feature:grand-hex-coven.description: Through an 8-hour ritual (can be during a long rest) you bind a willing creature with Spellcasting or Pact Magic into your coven, up to two members besides you. While two or more members are within 30 feet of each other they can cast bane, hideous laughter (1st), invisibility, ray of enfeeblement (2nd), bestow curse, counterspell (3rd), banishment, polymorph (4th), and contagion, scrying (5th), and share a pool of five slots (one each of 1st to 5th), restored when all members finish a long rest. Members use their own casting stats and can't use a shared slot for a spell level they couldn't otherwise cast.

feature:feature:grand-hex-dual-hex.description: A hex that targets one creature other than you can target two instead, and Insidious Spell applies to both while both are hexed.

feature:feature:grand-hex-forceful-perso.description: Your Charisma rises by 2, and its maximum becomes 22.

feature:feature:grand-hex-hybrid.description: As a bonus action with your familiar within 5 feet, merge with it for 1 minute (or until you end it, no action): gain temporary hit points equal to its hit points; AC 10 + Dexterity modifier + Charisma modifier without a shield (usable if better than your armor); two proficient natural weapons using Charisma that deal 1d10 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing (your choice); two attacks per Attack action (not stacking with Extra Attack); and use of the familiar's actions and movement. When it ends the familiar is dismissed and can't be summoned again until a short or long rest.

feature:feature:grand-hex-poison-apple.description: As an action, create a magic apple. Eating it as an action heals you for twice your witch level + Charisma modifier, one expended slot of 5th level or lower, and ends blinded, deafened, poisoned, or paralyzed (paralysis only if fed to you as an action). Anyone else who eats it gets no benefit and makes a Wisdom save with disadvantage or is poisoned for up to 24 hours, losing 4d8 hit points per hour (unavoidable); if that would drop it to 0 it stays at 1 and sleeps unconscious for up to 7 days unless remove curse or similar wakes it. The apple goes inert after 24 hours. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:grand-hex-possession.description: As an action, your body dematerializes as you attempt to possess a visible Large or smaller creature within 10 feet; it makes a Charisma save, succeeding automatically if its CR exceeds your witch level. On a failure it is incapacitated and you control it while it stays aware; you can't be targeted, keep your Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and alignment, and use its other statistics but not its knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. You count as an Undead spirit for effects that end possession and reappear within 5 feet if expelled. Lasts 1 hour, until the body hits 0 hit points, or until magic forces you out. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:grand-hex-war-hex.description: After casting a single-target hex, you may spend your bonus action casting a cantrip at that same creature.

feature:feature:grand-hex-witch-s-broom.description: As an action, enchant one mundane object (broom, cauldron, rug) to carry you: a 60-foot flying speed while holding it, unless you wear medium or heavy armor or carry a shield. Enchanting another object ends the previous one.

feature:feature:grand-hex-witch-s-hut.description: A 24-hour ritual animates a structure that fits in a 15-foot cube as a Huge object (as animate objects) that walks on magical legs at your command. Its door opens to an extradimensional dwelling (as magnificent mansion) from which you can steer it; if the structure is destroyed the dwelling survives and occupants are ejected near the entrance. Once per long rest, as an action, teleport the structure to a space you can see within 60 feet. Repeating the ritual moves the enchantment to a new structure.

feature:feature:witch:grand-hex.description: You learn an additional grand hex.

feature:feature:hexmaster.description: Creatures make their saving throws against your hexes with disadvantage.

feature:feature:frenzy.description: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion (as described in appendix A).

feature:feature:mindless-rage.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

feature:feature:intimidating-presence.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to extend the duration of this effect on the frightened creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you.  If the creature succeeds on its saving throw, you can't use this feature on that creature again for 24 hours.

feature:feature:retaliation.description: Starting at 14th level, when you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon Attack against that creature.

feature:feature:bonus-proficiencies.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

feature:feature:cutting-words.description: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the GM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.

feature:feature:additional-magical-secre.description: At 6th level, you learn two spells of your choice from any class. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen spells count as bard spells for you but don't count against the number of bard spells you know.

feature:feature:peerless-skill.description: Starting at 14th level, when you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the GM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

feature:feature:bonus-proficiency.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

feature:feature:disciple-of-life.description: Also starting at 1st level, your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-preserv.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured. As an action, you present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

feature:feature:blessed-healer.description: Beginning at 6th level, the healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

feature:feature:divine-strike.description: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-land.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

feature:feature:bonus-cantrip.description: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

feature:feature:natural-recovery.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

feature:feature:circle-spells.description: Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

feature:feature:land:land-s-stride.description: Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.

feature:feature:nature-s-ward.description: When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

feature:feature:nature-s-sanctuary.description: When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

feature:feature:improved-critical.description: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

feature:feature:remarkable-athlete.description: Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

feature:feature:additional-fighting-styl.description: At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

feature:feature:superior-critical.description: Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

feature:feature:survivor.description: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

feature:feature:open-hand-technique.description: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can manipulate your enemy's ki when you harness your own. Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target: - It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. - It must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, you can push it up to 15 feet away from you. - It can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:wholeness-of-body.description: At 6th level, you gain the ability to heal yourself. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

feature:feature:tranquility.description: Beginning at 11th level, you can enter a special meditation that surrounds you with an aura of peace. At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (the spell can end early as normal). The saving throw DC for the spell equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:quivering-palm.description: At 17th level, you gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you use your action to end them. To do so, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you use this action, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, it is reduced to 0 hit points. If it succeeds, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage. You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can choose to end the vibrations harmlessly without using an action.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-sacred-.description: As an action, you can imbue one weapon that you are holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration. You can end this effect on your turn as part of any other action. If you are no longer holding or carrying this weapon, or if you fall unconscious, this effect ends.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-turn-th.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring fiends and undead, using your Channel Divinity. Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage. A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

feature:feature:aura-of-devotion.description: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

feature:feature:purity-of-spirit.description: Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

feature:feature:holy-nimbus.description: At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that. Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant damage. In addition, for the duration, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead.

feature:feature:hunter-s-prey.description: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Colossus Slayer Giant Killer Horde Breaker

feature:feature:hunter-s-prey-colossus-s.description: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

feature:feature:hunter-s-prey-giant-kill.description: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

feature:feature:hunter-s-prey-horde-brea.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

feature:feature:defensive-tactics.description: At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Escape the Horde Multiattack Defense Steel Will

feature:feature:defensive-tactics-escape.description: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

feature:feature:defensive-tactics-multia.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

feature:feature:defensive-tactics-steel-.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

feature:feature:multiattack.description: At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Volley Whirlwind Attack

feature:feature:multiattack-volley.description: You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

feature:feature:multiattack-whirlwind-at.description: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

feature:feature:superior-hunter-s-defens.description: At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Evasion Stand Against the Tide Uncanny Dodge

When you are subjected to an effect, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell, that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.
When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.
When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

feature:feature:fast-hands.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

feature:feature:second-story-work.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

feature:feature:supreme-sneak.description: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

feature:feature:use-magic-device.description: By 13th level, you have learned enough about the workings of magic that you can improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

feature:feature:thief-s-reflexes.description: When you reach 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.

feature:feature:dragon-ancestor.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

feature:feature:dragon-ancestor-black-ac.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

feature:feature:dragon-ancestor-blue-lig.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. feature:feature:draconic-resilience.description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class. Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

feature:feature:elemental-affinity.description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

feature:feature:dragon-wings.description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn. You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

feature:feature:draconic-presence.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

feature:feature:dark-one-s-blessing.description: Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1).

feature:feature:dark-one-s-own-luck.description: Starting at 6th level, you can call on your patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

feature:feature:fiendish-resilience.description: Starting at 10th level, you can choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.

feature:feature:hurl-through-hell.description: Starting at 14th level, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. At the end of your next turn, the target returns to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is not a fiend, it takes 10d10 psychic damage as it reels from its horrific experience. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

feature:feature:evocation-savant.description: Beginning when you select this school at 2nd level, the gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

feature:feature:sculpt-spells.description: Beginning at 2nd level, you can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocation spells. When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

feature:feature:potent-cantrip.description: Starting at 6th level, your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

feature:feature:empowered-evocation.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any wizard evocation spell you cast.

feature:feature:overchannel.description: Starting at 14th level, you can increase the power of your simpler spells. When you cast a wizard spell of 1st through 5th level that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell. The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a long rest, you take 2d12 necrotic damage for each level of the spell, immediately after you cast it. Each time you use this feature again before finishing a long rest, the necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12. This damage ignores resistance and immunity.

feature:feature:ancestral-protectors.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on your turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn, and anyone else it hits has resistance to that attack's damage. Ends early if your rage ends.

feature:feature:spirit-shield.description: While raging, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 14th).

feature:feature:consult-the-spirits.description: Cast augury or clairvoyance without a slot or material components (Wisdom); clairvoyance summons an invisible ancestral spirit instead of a sensor. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:vengeful-ancestors.description: When Spirit Shield reduces an attack's damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.

feature:feature:storm-aura.description: While raging, a 10-foot aura activates on entering rage and again as a bonus action each turn; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Choose an environment (change on leveling): Desert, other creatures in the aura take 2 fire (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th); Sea, one creature makes a Dex save, 1d6 lightning, half on success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th); Tundra, chosen creatures gain 2 temporary HP (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).

feature:feature:storm-soul.description: Desert: fire resistance, ignore extreme heat, set an unattended flammable object alight with an action. Sea: lightning resistance, breathe underwater, swim speed 30 feet. Tundra: cold resistance, ignore extreme cold, freeze a 5-foot cube of water for 1 minute with an action.

feature:feature:shielding-storm.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura share your Storm Soul resistance.

feature:feature:raging-storm.description: Desert: after a creature in your aura hits you, reaction for a Dex save or fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: after you hit a creature in your aura, reaction for a Str save or it falls prone. Tundra: each time the aura activates, one creature in it makes a Str save or its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:divine-fury.description: While raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon each turn takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level, necrotic or radiant (chosen when you gain this).

feature:feature:warrior-of-the-gods.description: Spells that only restore you to life (not undeath) need no material components.

feature:feature:fanatical-focus.description: Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new roll.

feature:feature:zealous-presence.description: Bonus action: up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet that can hear you have advantage on attacks and saves until the start of your next turn. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:rage-beyond-death.description: While raging, 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious; you still make death saves, but you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if still at 0 HP.

feature:feature:mantle-of-inspiration.description: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet that can see you gain 5 temporary HP (8 at 5th, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th) and can use a reaction to move their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

feature:feature:enthralling-performance.description: After performing for 1 minute, up to Cha mod (min 1) humanoids within 60 feet that watched make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 hour, idolizing you; ends if damaged or if you attack them or their allies. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:mantle-of-majesty.description: Bonus action: cast command without a slot, then again as a bonus action each turn for 1 minute (concentration). Creatures charmed by you automatically fail. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:unbreakable-majesty.description: Bonus action, 1 minute or until incapacitated: a creature attacking you for the first time on a turn makes a Cha save or must pick another target (or waste the attack); on a success it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:college-of-swords:bonus-.description: Medium armor and the scimitar; a proficient simple or martial melee weapon can be your bard spellcasting focus.

feature:feature:blade-flourish.description: When you take the Attack action, +10 feet walking speed this turn; once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration die for extra damage equal to the roll plus one flourish: Defensive (add the roll to AC until your next turn), Slashing (same damage to another creature within 5 feet), or Mobile (push 5 feet plus the roll, then reaction to move your speed to a space within 5 feet of the target).

feature:feature:college-of-swords:extra-.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

feature:feature:master-s-flourish.description: Roll a d6 for a Blade Flourish instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

feature:feature:psychic-blades.description: Once per round on your turn, on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for an extra 2d6 psychic (3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

feature:feature:words-of-terror.description: After talking 1 minute alone with a humanoid, it makes a Wis save or is frightened of you or another creature you choose for 1 hour or until it or an ally is attacked or damaged. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:mantle-of-whispers.description: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 feet: capture its shadow until a long rest. As an action, become a disguise of that person for 1 hour, with what it would share with a casual acquaintance; Insight vs your Deception +5 sees through it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:shadow-lore.description: Action, one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you makes a Wis save or is charmed for 8 hours (ends if you or allies harm it or force a save), believing you know its deepest secret; it obeys you short of risking its life. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:forge-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: identify, searing smite (1st); heat metal, magic weapon (3rd); elemental weapon, protection from energy (5th); fabricate, wall of fire (7th); animate objects, creation (9th).

feature:feature:blessing-of-the-forge.description: At the end of a long rest, touch a nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon: it becomes magic (+1 AC, or +1 to attack and damage) until your next long rest or your death.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-artisan.description: A 1-hour ritual crafts a nonmagical metal-containing item worth up to 100 gp (weapon, armor, ten ammunition, tools, other metal object), consuming metal or coins of equal value; can duplicate a metal item you hold, such as a key.

feature:feature:soul-of-the-forge.description: Resistance to fire damage; +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

feature:feature:forge-domain:divine-stri.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th level).

feature:feature:saint-of-forge-and-fire.description: Immunity to fire damage; while wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

feature:feature:grave-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: bane, false life (1st); gentle repose, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); revivify, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, raise dead (9th).

feature:feature:circle-of-mortality.description: Healing dice from your spells use their maximum on a creature at 0 hit points. You learn spare the dying (not counted against your cantrips), with 30-foot range and castable as a bonus action.

feature:feature:eyes-of-the-grave.description: Action: until the end of your next turn you know the location of undead within 60 feet not behind total cover or shielded from divination. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-path-to.description: Action, curse one creature within 30 feet until the end of your next turn: the next attack by you or an ally that hits it deals vulnerable damage, then the curse ends.

feature:feature:sentinel-at-death-s-door.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet suffers a critical hit: make it a normal hit, cancelling crit-triggered effects. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:potent-spellcasting.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

feature:feature:keeper-of-souls.description: When an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet, you or a creature within 60 feet regains HP equal to its Hit Dice count, if you aren't incapacitated. Once per turn cycle (until the start of your next turn).

feature:feature:balm-of-the-summer-court.description: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: spend up to half your druid level in dice on a creature within 120 feet; it regains the total in HP plus 1 temporary HP per die.

feature:feature:hearth-of-moonlight-and-.description: At the start of a rest, an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere: you and allies inside have +5 to Stealth and Perception, and firelight inside isn't visible outside. Ends with the rest or if you leave.

feature:feature:hidden-paths.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet; or action: teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:walker-in-dreams.description: After a short rest, cast dream (you as messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle without a slot or material components; the circle opens to where you last finished a long rest on this plane. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:speech-of-the-woods.description: You speak, read and write Sylvan; beasts understand you and you can read their noises and motions.

feature:feature:spirit-totem.description: Bonus action: summon a spirit at a point within 60 feet with a 30-foot aura for 1 minute (bonus action moves it 60 feet). Once per short or long rest. Bear: chosen creatures gain 5 + druid level temporary HP, and you and allies have advantage on Str checks and saves in the aura. Hawk: reaction to give advantage on an attack against a target in the aura; you and allies have advantage on Perception there. Unicorn: advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and when your slotted spell heals anyone, chosen creatures in the aura also regain HP equal to your druid level.

feature:feature:mighty-summoner.description: Beasts and fey your spells summon or create get 2 extra HP per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

feature:feature:guardian-spirit.description: A beast or fey you summoned that ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura regains HP equal to half your druid level.

feature:feature:faithful-summons.description: When reduced to 0 HP or incapacitated against your will, gain conjure animals as a 9th-level casting: four beasts of CR 2 or lower within 20 feet protect you for 1 hour, no concentration. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:arcane-archer-lore.description: Proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and the prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip.

feature:feature:arcane-shot.description: Learn two Arcane Shot options (one more at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th). Once per turn, when you fire a shortbow or longbow arrow as part of the Attack action, apply an option (decided on hit unless it has no attack roll). Two uses per short or long rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Int. Options, extra damage doubling at 18th: Banishing (Cha save or banished to the Feywild until the end of its next turn; +2d6 force at 18th), Beguiling (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or charmed by an ally within 30 feet until your next turn), Bursting (2d6 force to the target and everything within 10 feet), Enfeebling (+2d6 necrotic, Con save or its weapon damage is halved until your next turn), Grasping (+2d6 poison, speed -10 feet and 2d6 slashing whenever it moves, for 1 minute or until removed with Athletics vs your DC), Piercing (no attack roll: 1-by-30-foot line through cover, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 piercing, half on success), Seeking (no attack roll: hits a creature seen in the last minute around corners, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 force and you learn its location, half on success), Shadow (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or it can't see beyond 5 feet until your next turn).

feature:feature:magic-arrow.description: Nonmagical arrows you fire from a shortbow or longbow count as magical.

feature:feature:curving-shot.description: When you miss with a magic arrow, bonus action to reroll against a different target within 60 feet of the first.

feature:feature:ever-ready-shot.description: If you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, regain one.

feature:feature:cavalier:bonus-proficien.description: One of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

feature:feature:born-to-the-saddle.description: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less if not incapacitated; mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet of movement.

feature:feature:unwavering-mark.description: When you hit with a melee weapon, mark the creature until the end of your next turn: within 5 feet of you it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you. If it damages someone else, on your next turn a bonus-action melee attack against it has advantage and deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Str mod special attacks (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:warding-maneuver.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or shield: add 1d8 to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target has resistance to that damage. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:hold-the-line.description: Creatures provoke your opportunity attack when they move 5 feet or more within your reach, and a hit reduces their speed to 0 for the turn.

feature:feature:ferocious-charger.description: Once per turn, after moving 10 feet straight before a hit, the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Str) or falls prone.

feature:feature:vigilant-defender.description: A special reaction usable once on every other creature's turn, only for an opportunity attack, and not on a turn you use your normal reaction.

feature:feature:samurai:bonus-proficienc.description: One of History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

feature:feature:fighting-spirit.description: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary HP (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

feature:feature:elegant-courtier.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks; proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

feature:feature:tireless-spirit.description: If you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, regain one.

feature:feature:rapid-strike.description: Once per turn during the Attack action, give up advantage on one attack to make an extra weapon attack against that target.

feature:feature:strength-before-death.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you, reaction: take an extra turn immediately, interrupting the current one; damage at 0 HP still causes death save failures. Fall unconscious after it if still at 0. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:drunken-technique.description: Flurry of Blows also grants the Disengage action and +10 feet walking speed this turn.

feature:feature:tipsy-sway.description: Stand up from prone for 5 feet of movement. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, spend 1 ki as a reaction to have it hit another creature of your choice within 5 feet of you.

feature:feature:drunkard-s-luck.description: Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

feature:feature:intoxicated-frenzy.description: Flurry of Blows can make up to three more attacks (five total) if each one targets a different creature this turn.

feature:feature:path-of-the-kensei.description: Choose one melee and one ranged kensei weapon (simple or martial without heavy or special; longbow allowed), gaining proficiency; they count as monk weapons. One more at 6th, 11th and 17th. Agile Parry: after an unarmed strike in the Attack action while holding a melee kensei weapon, +2 AC until your next turn. Kensei's Shot: bonus action, ranged kensei hits deal +1d4 this turn. Way of the Brush: calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

feature:feature:one-with-the-blade.description: Kensei weapon attacks count as magical. Deft Strike: once per turn on a kensei weapon hit, spend 1 ki for extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

feature:feature:sharpen-the-blade.description: Bonus action: spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon you touch that bonus to attack and damage for 1 minute (not on a weapon that already has a bonus).

feature:feature:unerring-accuracy.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

feature:feature:radiant-sun-bolt.description: A ranged spell attack option in the Attack action: 30 feet, Dex to attack and damage, radiant, Martial Arts die. After using it in the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make it twice as a bonus action. With Extra Attack, any of your attacks can be this.

feature:feature:searing-arc-strike.description: Right after the Attack action, spend 2 ki to cast burning hands as a bonus action, +1 spell level per extra ki (max ki half your monk level).

feature:feature:searing-sunburst.description: Action: a 20-foot-radius sphere at a point within 150 feet; Con save or 2d6 radiant (opaque total cover protects). Spend up to 3 ki for +2d6 each.

feature:feature:sun-shield.description: Bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more (toggle as a bonus action). While lit, reaction when hit by a melee attack: deal 5 + Wis mod radiant to the attacker.

feature:feature:oath-of-conquest:oath-sp.description: Always prepared: armor of Agathys, command (3rd); hold person, spiritual weapon (5th); bestow curse, fear (9th); dominate beast, stoneskin (13th); cloudkill, dominate person (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-conquest:channel.description: Conquering Presence: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Guided Strike: +10 to an attack roll after seeing the roll.

feature:feature:aura-of-conquest.description: A 10-foot aura (30 feet at 18th) while not incapacitated: creatures frightened of you have speed 0 in it and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when they start their turn there.

feature:feature:scornful-rebuke.description: A creature that hits you takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1), if you aren't incapacitated.

feature:feature:invincible-conqueror.description: Action, 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one extra attack in the Attack action, and melee weapon crits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:oath-of-redemption:oath-.description: Always prepared: sanctuary, sleep (3rd); calm emotions, hold person (5th); counterspell, hypnotic pattern (9th); Otiluke's resilient sphere, stoneskin (13th); hold monster, wall of force (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-redemption:chann.description: Emissary of Peace: bonus action, +5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes. Rebuke the Violent: reaction right after an attacker within 30 feet damages someone other than you; it makes a Wis save, taking radiant damage equal to what it dealt, half on a success.

feature:feature:aura-of-the-guardian.description: Reaction when a creature within 10 feet (30 at 18th) takes damage: you take that damage instead; it can't be reduced and no other effects transfer.

feature:feature:protective-spirit.description: If you end your turn in combat below half your hit points and aren't incapacitated, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level HP.

feature:feature:emissary-of-redemption.description: Resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and a creature that hits you takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you took. Both stop working against a creature you attack, cast a spell on, or damage, until you finish a long rest.

feature:feature:gloom-stalker-magic.description: Known extra spells: disguise self (3rd), rope trick (5th), fear (9th), greater invisibility (13th), seeming (17th).

feature:feature:dread-ambusher.description: Add Wis mod to initiative. On your first turn of each combat, +10 feet walking speed, and the Attack action includes one extra weapon attack that deals +1d8 on a hit.

feature:feature:umbral-sight.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet if you have it). In darkness you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you.

feature:feature:iron-mind.description: Proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

feature:feature:stalker-s-flurry.description: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

feature:feature:shadowy-dodge.description: Reaction, before the result is known, when attacked without advantage: impose disadvantage.

feature:feature:horizon-walker-magic.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), misty step (5th), haste (9th), banishment (13th), teleportation circle (17th).

feature:feature:detect-portal.description: Action: learn the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:planar-warrior.description: Bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet: your next weapon hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus 1d8 force (2d8 at 11th).

feature:feature:ethereal-step.description: Bonus action: cast etherealness without a slot, ending at the end of the turn. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:distant-strike.description: During the Attack action, teleport up to 10 feet before each attack; if you attack two different creatures, make one extra attack against a third.

feature:feature:spectral-defense.description: Reaction when an attack damages you: resistance to all of that attack's damage this turn.

feature:feature:monster-slayer-magic.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), zone of truth (5th), magic circle (9th), banishment (13th), hold monster (17th).

feature:feature:hunter-s-sense.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet: learn its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (none, if it is shielded from divination). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:slayer-s-prey.description: Bonus action, mark a creature within 60 feet until a short or long rest or a new mark: the first weapon hit on it each turn deals +1d6.

feature:feature:supernatural-defense.description: Add 1d6 to saves your Slayer's Prey target forces and to checks to escape its grapple.

feature:feature:magic-user-s-nemesis.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell or teleports: Wis save against your spell DC or it fails and is wasted. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:slayer-s-counter.description: When your Slayer's Prey target forces a save, reaction: one weapon attack against it first; on a hit you automatically succeed on the save.

feature:feature:ear-for-deceit.description: On Insight checks to tell if a creature lies, treat a d20 of 7 or lower as 8.

feature:feature:eye-for-detail.description: Bonus action: a Perception check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Investigation check for clues.

feature:feature:insightful-fighting.description: Bonus action: your Insight vs a visible creature's Deception; on a win you can Sneak Attack it without advantage (not with disadvantage) for 1 minute or until you use this on another target.

feature:feature:steady-eye.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move no more than half your speed this turn.

feature:feature:unerring-eye.description: Action: sense illusions, shapechangers in another form, and other deceiving magic within 30 feet, unless blinded or deafened (not what is hidden). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:eye-for-weakness.description: Sneak Attack deals +3d6 against your Insightful Fighting target.

feature:feature:master-of-intrigue.description: Disguise kit, forgery kit, one gaming set and two languages; after 1 minute of listening you can mimic a creature's speech and accent in a language you know.

feature:feature:master-of-tactics.description: Help as a bonus action; when you help an ally attack, the target can be within 30 feet of you if it can see or hear you.

feature:feature:insightful-manipulator.description: After 1 minute observing or talking to a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Int, Wis, Cha, class levels.

feature:feature:misdirection.description: Reaction when targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet gives you cover: the attack targets that creature instead.

feature:feature:soul-of-deceit.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it, and you can present false thoughts (Deception vs Insight). Truth-detecting magic shows you as truthful if you wish, and magic can't compel you to tell the truth.

feature:feature:skirmisher.description: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: move up to half your speed without provoking.

feature:feature:survivalist.description: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, with double proficiency bonus on checks using them.

feature:feature:superior-mobility.description: +10 feet walking speed, and climbing and swimming speeds if you have them.

feature:feature:ambush-master.description: Advantage on initiative; attacks against the first creature you hit in the first round have advantage until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:sudden-strike.description: When you take the Attack action, one extra attack as a bonus action; it can Sneak Attack even if you already did this turn, but not the same target twice.

feature:feature:fancy-footwork.description: A creature you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

feature:feature:rakish-audacity.description: Add Cha mod to initiative. Sneak Attack without advantage when you're within 5 feet of the target, no other creature is within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage.

feature:feature:panache.description: Action: Persuasion vs Insight against a creature that hears and understands you. Hostile: for 1 minute it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can only make opportunity attacks against you (ends if an ally attacks or spells it, or you're 60+ feet apart). Not hostile: charmed for 1 minute as a friendly acquaintance, ending if harmed.

feature:feature:elegant-maneuver.description: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

feature:feature:master-duelist.description: Reroll a missed attack with advantage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:divine-magic.description: When you learn or replace a sorcerer spell or cantrip, you can pick from the cleric list; it becomes a sorcerer spell. Pick an affinity for a bonus spell that doesn't count against spells known: good cure wounds, evil inflict wounds, law bless, chaos bane, neutrality protection from evil and good.

feature:feature:favored-by-the-gods.description: When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4 to the total. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:empowered-healing.description: Once per turn, when you or an ally within 5 feet rolls healing dice for a spell, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any of them once, if you aren't incapacitated.

feature:feature:otherworldly-wings.description: Bonus action: spectral wings give a 30-foot flying speed until you're incapacitated, die or dismiss them.

feature:feature:unearthly-recovery.description: Bonus action below half your hit points: regain half your hit point maximum. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:eyes-of-the-dark.description: Darkvision 120 feet. At 3rd level you learn darkness (not counted against spells known) and can cast it for 2 sorcery points, seeing through it when you do.

feature:feature:strength-of-the-grave.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP, Cha save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 HP instead; not against radiant damage or a critical hit. Once per long rest after a success.

feature:feature:hound-of-ill-omen.description: Bonus action, 3 sorcery points: summon a Medium monstrosity dire wolf within 30 feet of a target you can see within 120 feet, with temporary HP equal to half your sorcerer level. It moves through creatures and objects (5 force if it ends in one), always knows the target's location, moves and attacks only that target, and while within 5 feet the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells. Lasts 5 minutes or until it or the target drops to 0.

feature:feature:shadow-walk.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 120 feet to a space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

feature:feature:umbral-form.description: Bonus action, 6 sorcery points, 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and move through creatures and objects (5 force if you end a turn inside one).

feature:feature:wind-speaker.description: Speak, read and write Primordial (understanding Aquan, Auran, Ignan and Terran).

feature:feature:tempestuous-magic.description: Bonus action right before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher: fly up to 10 feet without provoking.

feature:feature:heart-of-the-storm.description: Resistance to lightning and thunder. When you start casting a 1st-level-plus spell that deals lightning or thunder, chosen creatures within 10 feet take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

feature:feature:storm-guide.description: Action: stop rain in a 20-foot sphere around you. Bonus action each round: set the wind's direction in a 100-foot sphere until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:storm-s-fury.description: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level to the attacker, and a Str save against your spell DC or it is pushed up to 20 feet.

feature:feature:wind-soul.description: Immunity to lightning and thunder; magical flying speed 60 feet. Action: drop to 30 feet for 1 hour to give 3 + Cha mod creatures within 30 feet a 30-foot flying speed for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:expanded-spell-list.description: Added to your warlock list: cure wounds, guiding bolt (1st); flaming sphere, lesser restoration (2nd); daylight, revivify (3rd); guardian of faith, wall of fire (4th); flame strike, greater restoration (5th).

feature:feature:bonus-cantrips.description: Light and sacred flame, not counted against cantrips known.

feature:feature:healing-light.description: A pool of 1 + warlock level d6s, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: heal a creature within 60 feet, spending up to Cha mod dice (min 1).

feature:feature:radiant-soul.description: Resistance to radiant; add Cha mod to one radiant or fire damage roll of your spells against one target.

feature:feature:celestial-resilience.description: After a short or long rest, gain temporary HP equal to warlock level + Cha mod, and up to five creatures you can see gain half your warlock level + Cha mod.

feature:feature:searing-vengeance.description: Instead of a death save at the start of your turn, regain half your hit point maximum and stand if you like; chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + Cha mod radiant and are blinded until the end of the turn. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:the-hexblade:expanded-sp.description: Added to your warlock list: shield, wrathful smite (1st); blur, branding smite (2nd); blink, elemental weapon (3rd); phantasmal killer, staggering smite (4th); banishing smite, cone of cold (5th).

feature:feature:hexblade-s-curse.description: Bonus action, curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: add proficiency bonus to damage against it, your attacks against it crit on 19 or 20, and if it dies you regain warlock level + Cha mod HP (min 1). Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:hex-warrior.description: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons. After a long rest, touch a proficient weapon without two-handed: use Cha for its attack and damage until the next long rest; with Pact of the Blade this applies to every pact weapon.

feature:feature:accursed-specter.description: When you slay a humanoid, its spirit rises as a specter with temporary HP equal to half your warlock level and a bonus to attacks equal to your Cha mod; it obeys you until your next long rest. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:armor-of-hexes.description: Reaction when your cursed target hits you: roll a d6, and on 4 or higher the attack misses.

feature:feature:master-of-hexes.description: When your cursed target dies, move the curse to another creature within 30 feet (without regaining HP from the death).

feature:feature:arcane-deflection.description: Reaction when hit or when you fail a save: +2 AC against that attack or +4 to that save; then only cantrips until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:power-surge.description: Hold up to Int mod (min 1) power surges; reset to one on a long rest, gain one when you end a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, and one after a short rest if you have none. Once per turn when a wizard spell damages a target, spend one for extra force damage equal to half your wizard level.

feature:feature:durable-magic.description: +2 to AC and all saves while concentrating on a spell.

feature:feature:deflecting-shroud.description: When you use Arcane Deflection, up to three creatures within 60 feet take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

feature:feature:form-of-the-beast.description: When you rage, manifest a natural weapon (simple melee, Str) chosen each rage: Bite 1d8 piercing, once per turn regain HP equal to proficiency bonus if below half HP; Claws 1d6 slashing, one extra claw attack when you attack with a claw in the Attack action; Tail 1d8 piercing with reach, and reaction when a creature within 10 feet hits you to add 1d8 to AC.

feature:feature:bestial-soul.description: Natural weapons count as magical. After a short or long rest pick one until the next: swim speed and water breathing; climb speed with spider climbing; or once per turn add a Str (Athletics) check total to a jump's distance.

feature:feature:infectious-fury.description: While raging, on a natural weapon hit the target makes a Wis save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency) or, your choice, uses its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature you choose, or takes 2d12 psychic. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:call-the-hunt.description: When you rage, up to Con mod (min 1) willing creatures within 30 feet join: you gain 5 temporary HP per creature, and each can add 1d6 to one attack's damage per turn until the rage ends. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:magic-awareness.description: Action: until the end of your next turn, know the location and school of spells and magic items within 60 feet not behind total cover. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:wild-surge.description: When you rage, roll a d8 (save DC 8 + proficiency + Con): 1 chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or take 1d12 necrotic, and you gain 1d12 temporary HP; 2 teleport 30 feet, repeatable as a bonus action each turn; 3 an exploding spirit next to a creature within 30 feet, Dex save or 1d6 force, repeatable as a bonus action; 4 a held weapon deals force, gains light and thrown (20/60) and returns to your hand; 5 attackers who hit you take 1d6 force; 6 +1 AC for you and allies within 10 feet; 7 the ground within 15 feet is difficult terrain for enemies; 8 a creature within 30 feet makes a Con save or takes 1d6 radiant and is blinded until your next turn, repeatable as a bonus action. Each lasts until the rage ends.

feature:feature:bolstering-magic.description: Action, touch a creature (or yourself): either add 1d3 to attack rolls and ability checks for 10 minutes, or it regains a spell slot of level 1d3 or lower (once per long rest per creature). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:unstable-backlash.description: While raging, reaction right after you take damage or fail a save: roll a new Wild Surge, replacing the current one.

feature:feature:controlled-surge.description: Roll Wild Surge twice and choose; on a matching roll pick any effect.

feature:feature:mote-of-potential.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration, a mote orbits the creature until the die is used. Ability check: roll the die twice and pick. Attack roll: the target and chosen creatures within 5 feet of it make a Con save against your spell DC or take thunder damage equal to the roll. Saving throw: the creature gains temporary HP equal to the roll + your Cha mod (min 1).

feature:feature:performance-of-creation.description: Action: create one nonmagical Medium or smaller item worth up to 20 x bard level gp within 10 feet, lasting proficiency bonus hours (one at a time; Large at 6th, Huge at 14th). Once per long rest, or spend a 2nd-level or higher slot.

feature:feature:animating-performance.description: Action: animate a Large or smaller unattended nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for 1 hour (AC 16, HP 10 + 5 x bard level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; slam with your spell attack, 1d10 + PB force; nearby creatures' speed can change by 10 feet). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action (or with your Bardic Inspiration bonus action). Once per long rest, or spend a 3rd-level or higher slot.

feature:feature:creative-crescendo.description: Performance of Creation makes up to Cha mod items (min 2), only one of maximum size, with no gp limit.

feature:feature:silver-tongue.description: Treat a d20 of 9 or lower on Persuasion or Deception as a 10.

feature:feature:unsettling-words.description: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration on a creature within 60 feet: it subtracts the roll from its next save before your next turn.

feature:feature:unfailing-inspiration.description: A creature that adds your Bardic Inspiration and still fails keeps the die.

feature:feature:universal-speech.description: Action: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet understand you for 1 hour. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

feature:feature:infectious-inspiration.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet succeeds using your Bardic Inspiration: give a free die to another creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Cha mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:order-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: command, heroism (1st); hold person, zone of truth (3rd); mass healing word, slow (5th); compulsion, locate creature (7th); commune, dominate person (9th).

feature:feature:order-domain:bonus-profi.description: Heavy armor, and Intimidation or Persuasion.

feature:feature:voice-of-authority.description: When your 1st-level or higher spell targets an ally, that ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you choose.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-order-s.description: Action: chosen creatures within 30 feet that see or hear you make a Wis save or are charmed until the end of your next turn or until damaged, and you can make them drop what they hold.

feature:feature:embodiment-of-the-law.description: Cast a 1st-level or higher enchantment spell with a 1-action casting time as a bonus action. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:order-domain:divine-stri.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:order-s-wrath.description: When your Divine Strike damages a creature, curse it until your next turn: the next ally hit on it deals an extra 2d8 psychic.

feature:feature:peace-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: heroism, sanctuary (1st); aid, warding bond (3rd); beacon of hope, sending (5th); aura of purity, Otiluke's resilient sphere (7th); greater restoration, Rary's telepathic bond (9th).

feature:feature:implement-of-peace.description: Proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

feature:feature:emboldening-bond.description: Action: bond up to proficiency bonus willing creatures within 30 feet (yourself included) for 10 minutes; while within 30 feet of another bonded creature, each can add 1d4 to one attack, check or save per turn. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-balm-of.description: Action: move your speed without provoking; each creature you pass within 5 feet of regains 2d6 + Wis mod HP (min 1), once each.

feature:feature:protective-bond.description: When a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can use its reaction to teleport within 5 feet of it and take all the damage instead.

feature:feature:peace-domain:potent-spel.description: Add Wis mod to cleric cantrip damage.

feature:feature:expansive-bond.description: Emboldening and Protective Bond work within 60 feet, and a creature taking damage through Protective Bond has resistance to it.
