feature:feature:twilight-domain:domain-s.description: Always prepared: faerie fire, sleep (1st); moonbeam, see invisibility (3rd); aura of vitality, Leomund's tiny hut (5th); aura of life, greater invisibility (7th); circle of power, mislead (9th).

feature:feature:eyes-of-night.description: Darkvision 300 feet, seeing dim light as bright and darkness as dim. Action: share it with up to Wis mod (min 1) willing creatures within 10 feet for 1 hour, once per long rest or by spending a spell slot.

feature:feature:vigilant-blessing.description: Action: a creature you touch has advantage on its next initiative roll.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-twiligh.description: Action: a 30-foot sphere of dim light moves with you for 1 minute; a creature ending its turn in it gains 1d6 + cleric level temporary HP or ends one charmed or frightened effect.

feature:feature:steps-of-night.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: flying speed equal to walking speed for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:twilight-domain:divine-s.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:twilight-shroud.description: You and allies have half cover inside your Twilight Sanctuary.

feature:feature:circle-of-spores:circle-.description: Chill touch at 2nd. Always prepared: blindness/deafness, gentle repose (3rd); animate dead, gaseous form (5th); blight, confusion (7th); cloudkill, contagion (9th).

feature:feature:halo-of-spores.description: Reaction when a creature you can see moves within 10 feet or starts its turn there: Con save against your spell DC or 1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).

feature:feature:symbiotic-entity.description: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: gain 4 temporary HP per druid level; for 10 minutes (or until those HP are gone or you Wild Shape) Halo of Spores rolls its die twice and your melee weapon hits deal +1d6 necrotic.

feature:feature:fungal-infestation.description: Reaction when a Small or Medium beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet: it rises as a zombie with 1 HP for 1 hour, acting after you and only able to make one melee attack. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:spreading-spores.description: While Symbiotic Entity is active, bonus action: a 10-foot cube of spores within 30 feet for 1 minute; a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a Con save or takes your Halo damage (once per turn). You can't use the Halo reaction while it lasts.

feature:feature:fungal-body.description: Immune to blinded, deafened, frightened and poisoned; critical hits against you become normal hits unless you're incapacitated.

feature:feature:star-map.description: A Tiny star chart that is a druid focus. While holding it: you know guidance, guiding bolt is always prepared, and you can cast guiding bolt without a slot proficiency bonus times per long rest. A 1-hour ceremony during a rest replaces it.

feature:feature:starry-form.description: Bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use: glow for 10 minutes (bright 10 feet, dim 10 more) with a constellation. Archer: on activation and as a bonus action each turn, ranged spell attack within 60 feet for 1d8 + Wis radiant. Chalice: when a slotted spell heals, you or a creature within 30 feet regains 1d8 + Wis. Dragon: treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on Int and Wis checks and concentration saves as 10.

feature:feature:cosmic-omen.description: After a long rest, roll a die: even (Weal) lets you add 1d6, odd (Woe) subtract 1d6, as a reaction to an attack, save or check by a creature within 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:twinkling-constellations.description: Archer and Chalice become 2d8; Dragon grants a 20-foot flying speed with hover; you can switch constellation at the start of each of your turns.

feature:feature:full-of-stars.description: In Starry Form, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.

feature:feature:circle-of-wildfire:circl.description: Always prepared: burning hands, cure wounds (2nd); flaming sphere, scorching ray (3rd); plant growth, revivify (5th); aura of life, fire shield (7th); flame strike, mass cure wounds (9th).

feature:feature:summon-wildfire-spirit.description: Action, spend a Wild Shape use: a wildfire spirit appears within 30 feet for 1 hour, and creatures within 10 feet of it make a Dex save or take 2d6 fire. Small elemental, AC 13, HP 5 + 5 x druid level, speed 30, fly 30 hover; Flame Seed (spell attack, 60 feet, 1d6 + PB fire); Fiery Teleportation (it and willing creatures within 5 feet teleport 15 feet, then Dex save or 1d6 + PB fire for creatures near where it left). It acts after you and Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action.

feature:feature:enhanced-bond.description: While the spirit is summoned, add 1d8 to one damage or healing roll of your fire-damage or healing spells, and your ranged spells can originate from the spirit.

feature:feature:cauterizing-flames.description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or the spirit, a spectral flame stays for 1 minute; reaction when a creature enters it: heal it or deal fire damage, 2d10 + Wis mod. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:blazing-revival.description: When you drop to 0 HP with the spirit within 120 feet, it drops to 0 instead and you regain half your hit points and stand. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:psionic-power.description: Psionic Energy dice (d6; d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th), twice your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest; once per short or long rest regain one as a bonus action. Protective Field: reaction, spend a die to reduce damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by the roll + Int (min 1). Psionic Strike: once per turn after a weapon hit on a target within 30 feet, spend a die for force damage equal to the roll + Int. Telekinetic Movement: action, move a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature within 30 feet up to 30 feet (or a Tiny object to or from your hand); once per short or long rest, or spend a die.

feature:feature:telekinetic-adept.description: Psi-Powered Leap: bonus action, flying speed twice your walking speed this turn (once per short or long rest, or spend a die). Telekinetic Thrust: a Psionic Strike target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Int) or is knocked prone or moved 10 feet horizontally.

feature:feature:guarded-mind.description: Resistance to psychic. If you start your turn charmed or frightened, spend a die to end those effects.

feature:feature:bulwark-of-force.description: Bonus action: up to Int mod (min 1) creatures within 30 feet, you included, have half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

feature:feature:telekinetic-master.description: Cast telekinesis without components (Int); while concentrating on it, one weapon attack as a bonus action each turn. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

feature:feature:rune-knight:bonus-profic.description: Smith's tools; speak, read and write Giant.

feature:feature:rune-carver.description: Know 2 runes (3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th; swap one per level). After a long rest, inscribe each on a different worn or held object. Each invokes once per short or long rest; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Cloud: advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception; reaction to redirect an attack hitting you or a creature within 30 feet to another creature within 30 feet. Fire: double proficiency on tool checks; on a weapon hit, +2d6 fire and Str save or restrained 1 minute taking 2d6 fire each turn (save ends). Frost: advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation; bonus action, +2 to Str and Con checks and saves for 10 minutes. Stone: advantage on Insight, darkvision 120 feet; reaction when a creature ends its turn within 30 feet, Wis save or charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated for 1 minute (save ends). Hill (7th): advantage on saves against poison and poison resistance; bonus action, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute. Storm (7th): advantage on Arcana and can't be surprised; bonus action for 1 minute, reaction to give advantage or disadvantage to a roll within 60 feet.

feature:feature:giant-s-might.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: become Large if there's room, advantage on Str checks and saves, and once per turn +1d6 on a weapon or unarmed hit. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:runic-shield.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is hit: the attacker rerolls the d20. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:great-stature.description: Grow 3d4 inches; Giant's Might extra damage becomes 1d8.

feature:feature:master-of-runes.description: Each rune can be invoked twice per short or long rest.

feature:feature:runic-juggernaut.description: Giant's Might deals 1d10 and can make you Huge with +5 feet reach.

feature:feature:implements-of-mercy.description: Insight, Medicine and the herbalism kit, plus a mercy mask.

feature:feature:hand-of-healing.description: Action, 1 ki: touch a creature to restore Martial Arts die + Wis HP. In Flurry of Blows, replace one strike with it at no ki.

feature:feature:hand-of-harm.description: Once per turn on an unarmed hit, 1 ki: extra necrotic equal to Martial Arts die + Wis.

feature:feature:physician-s-touch.description: Hand of Healing also ends one disease or blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned. Hand of Harm can poison the target until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:flurry-of-healing-and-ha.description: In Flurry of Blows, replace each strike with Hand of Healing for free, and use Hand of Harm on a Flurry strike without ki (still once per turn).

feature:feature:hand-of-ultimate-mercy.description: Action, 5 ki: a creature dead under 24 hours returns with 4d10 + Wis HP, free of blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned and stunned. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:arms-of-the-astral-self.description: Bonus action, 1 ki, 10 minutes: chosen creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save or take two Martial Arts dice of force. While active, use Wis for Str checks and saves; unarmed strikes with the arms have +5 feet reach on your turn, can use Wis for attack and damage, and deal force.

feature:feature:visage-of-the-astral-sel.description: Bonus action (or with the arms), 1 ki, 10 minutes: see normally in magical and nonmagical darkness to 120 feet, advantage on Insight and Intimidation, and speak to only one creature within 60 feet or be heard to 600 feet.

feature:feature:body-of-the-astral-self.description: With arms and visage active: reaction to reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder damage by 1d10 + Wis (min 1), and once per turn an arms hit deals an extra Martial Arts die.

feature:feature:awakened-astral-self.description: Bonus action, 5 ki: arms, visage and body for 10 minutes, plus +2 AC and three attacks instead of two with Extra Attack when all use the arms.

feature:feature:oath-of-glory:oath-spell.description: Always prepared: guiding bolt, heroism (3rd); enhance ability, magic weapon (5th); haste, protection from energy (9th); compulsion, freedom of movement (13th); commune, flame strike (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-glory:channel-di.description: Peerless Athlete: bonus action, 10 minutes of advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, double carrying capacity and +10 feet on jumps. Inspiring Smite: bonus action right after a Divine Smite, share 2d8 + paladin level temporary HP among creatures within 30 feet.

feature:feature:aura-of-alacrity.description: +10 feet walking speed; allies starting their turn within 5 feet (10 feet at 18th) get +10 feet that turn, if you aren't incapacitated.

feature:feature:glorious-defense.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet is hit: add Cha mod (min 1) to its AC; if that makes it miss, make one weapon attack against the attacker. Cha mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:living-legend.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: advantage on Charisma checks, once per turn turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, and reaction to reroll a failed save. Once per long rest, or spend a 5th-level slot.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-watchers:oat.description: Always prepared: alarm, detect magic (3rd); moonbeam, see invisibility (5th); counterspell, nondetection (9th); aura of purity, banishment (13th); hold monster, scrying (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-the-watchers:cha.description: Watcher's Will: action, you and up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 30 feet have advantage on Int, Wis and Cha saves for 1 minute. Abjure the Extraplanar: action, aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 feet that hear you make a Wis save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

feature:feature:aura-of-the-sentinel.description: While not incapacitated, you and chosen creatures within 10 feet (30 at 18th) add your proficiency bonus to initiative.

feature:feature:vigilant-rebuke.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet succeeds on an Int, Wis or Cha save: the creature that forced it takes 2d8 + Cha mod force.

feature:feature:mortal-bulwark.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: truesight 120 feet, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and on a damaging hit the target makes a Cha save against your spell DC or is banished to its native plane (a success makes it immune for 24 hours). Once per long rest, or spend a 5th-level slot.

feature:feature:dreadful-strikes.description: Weapon hits deal +1d4 psychic, once per turn per target (1d6 at 11th).

feature:feature:fey-wanderer-magic.description: Known extra spells: charm person (3rd), misty step (5th), dispel magic (9th), dimension door (13th), mislead (17th). Also a cosmetic Feywild gift.

feature:feature:otherworldly-glamour.description: Add Wis mod (min +1) to Charisma checks; proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

feature:feature:beguiling-twist.description: Advantage on saves against charmed and frightened. Reaction when you or a creature within 120 feet succeeds on such a save: another creature within 120 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened by you for 1 minute (save ends).

feature:feature:fey-reinforcements.description: Know summon fey (not counted, no material component); cast it once per long rest without a slot. Any casting can skip concentration, lasting 1 minute.

feature:feature:misty-wanderer.description: Cast misty step without a slot Wis mod times (min 1) per long rest, and any misty step can bring a willing creature within 5 feet along.

feature:feature:gathered-swarm.description: Once per turn right after you hit with an attack: the target takes 1d6 piercing; or it makes a Str save against your spell DC or is moved 15 feet horizontally; or you move 5 feet horizontally.

feature:feature:swarmkeeper-magic.description: Mage hand, plus known extra spells: faerie fire (3rd), web (5th), gaseous form (9th), arcane eye (13th), insect plague (17th).

feature:feature:writhing-tide.description: Bonus action: 10-foot flying speed with hover for 1 minute. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:mighty-swarm.description: Gathered Swarm deals 1d8; a creature failing the move save can also be knocked prone; moving yourself grants half cover until your next turn.

feature:feature:swarming-dispersal.description: Reaction when you take damage: resistance to it, then teleport up to 30 feet. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:whispers-of-the-dead.description: After a short or long rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack until you choose another.

feature:feature:wails-from-the-grave.description: Right after Sneak Attack damage on your turn, a second creature within 30 feet of the first takes necrotic damage from half your Sneak Attack dice (round up). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:tokens-of-the-departed.description: Reaction when a creature dies within 30 feet: create a soul trinket (max proficiency bonus). While carrying one, advantage on death saves and Con saves. Destroy one to use Wails from the Grave without a use, or as an action to ask its spirit one question.

feature:feature:ghost-walk.description: Bonus action, 10 minutes: 10-foot fly speed with hover, attacks against you have disadvantage, move through creatures and objects (1d10 force if you end inside one). Once per long rest, or destroy a soul trinket.

feature:feature:death-s-friend.description: Wails from the Grave damages both creatures; if you have no soul trinket at the end of a long rest, one appears.

feature:feature:soulknife:psionic-power.description: Psionic Energy dice (d6; d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th), twice your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest; once per short or long rest regain one as a bonus action. Psi-Bolstered Knack: when you fail a proficient skill or tool check, add a die, spending it only if that turns it into a success. Psychic Whispers: action, telepathy within 1 mile with up to proficiency bonus creatures for hours equal to a die roll; the first use after a long rest is free.

feature:feature:soulknife:psychic-blades.description: When you take the Attack action, attack with a psychic blade (simple melee, finesse, thrown 60 feet): 1d6 + the ability mod psychic. Then a second blade as a bonus action for 1d4 if your other hand is free.

feature:feature:soul-blades.description: Homing Strikes: on a Psychic Blades miss, add a die and spend it only if it hits. Psychic Teleportation: bonus action, spend a die and teleport 10 x the roll feet to a space you can see.

feature:feature:psychic-veil.description: Action: invisible for 1 hour, ending after you deal damage or force a save. Once per long rest, or spend a die.

feature:feature:rend-mind.description: When Psychic Blades deal Sneak Attack, the target makes a Wis save (DC 8 + proficiency + Dex) or is stunned for 1 minute (save ends). Once per long rest, or spend three dice.

feature:feature:psionic-spells.description: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for a divination or enchantment of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: arms of Hadar, dissonant whispers, mind sliver (1st); calm emotions, detect thoughts (3rd); hunger of Hadar, sending (5th); Evard's black tentacles, summon aberration (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, telekinesis (9th).

feature:feature:telepathic-speech.description: Bonus action, a creature within 30 feet: telepathy within Cha mod miles (min 1) for sorcerer level minutes, in a shared language.

feature:feature:psionic-sorcery.description: Cast a Psionic Spell by spending sorcery points equal to its level instead of a slot, with no verbal, somatic or unconsumed material components.

feature:feature:psychic-defenses.description: Resistance to psychic; advantage on saves against charmed and frightened.

feature:feature:revelation-in-flesh.description: Bonus action, 10 minutes, one benefit per sorcery point: see invisible creatures within 60 feet; flying speed equal to walking with hover; swim speed twice walking and water breathing; squeeze through 1-inch gaps and escape nonmagical restraints or grapples for 5 feet of movement.

feature:feature:warping-implosion.description: Action: teleport up to 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet of where you left make a Str save or take 3d10 force and are pulled toward that space, half and no pull on a success. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

feature:feature:clockwork-magic.description: Known extra spells, swappable on level up for an abjuration or transmutation of the same level from the sorcerer, warlock or wizard list: alarm, protection from evil and good (1st); aid, lesser restoration (3rd); dispel magic, protection from energy (5th); freedom of movement, summon construct (7th); greater restoration, wall of force (9th).

feature:feature:restore-balance.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage: it rolls normally. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:bastion-of-law.description: Action, 1 to 5 sorcery points: a ward of that many d8s on you or a creature within 30 feet, lasting until your next long rest or new ward; the warded creature spends dice to reduce damage it takes.

feature:feature:trance-of-order.description: Bonus action, 1 minute: attacks against you can't have advantage, and you treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower on attacks, checks and saves as 10. Once per long rest, or 5 sorcery points.

feature:feature:clockwork-cavalcade.description: Action, a 30-foot cube from you: restore up to 100 HP split among chosen creatures, repair damaged objects entirely inside, and end spells of 6th level or lower on chosen creatures and objects. Once per long rest, or 7 sorcery points.

feature:feature:the-fathomless:expanded-.description: Added to your warlock list: create or destroy water, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, silence (2nd); lightning bolt, sleet storm (3rd); control water, summon elemental (water only) (4th); Bigby's hand, cone of cold (5th).

feature:feature:tentacle-of-the-deeps.description: Bonus action: a 10-foot tentacle at a point within 60 feet for 1 minute; melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of it for 1d8 cold (2d8 at 10th) and -10 feet speed until your next turn. Bonus action each turn: move it 30 feet and attack again. Proficiency bonus summons per long rest.

feature:feature:gift-of-the-sea.description: Swim speed 40 feet and water breathing.

feature:feature:oceanic-soul.description: Resistance to cold. While fully submerged, you and other submerged creatures understand each other's speech.

feature:feature:guardian-coil.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet of the tentacle takes damage: reduce it by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th).

feature:feature:grasping-tentacles.description: Know Evard's black tentacles (not counted), castable once per long rest without a slot; casting it gives temporary HP equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break concentration on it.

feature:feature:fathomless-plunge.description: Action: you and up to five willing creatures within 30 feet teleport up to 1 mile to a body of water you've seen (pond or larger) or within 30 feet of it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:the-genie:expanded-spell.description: Choose a patron kind: dao (earth), djinni (air), efreeti (fire) or marid (water). Added to your warlock list: detect evil and good, phantasmal force, create food and water, phantasmal killer, creation, and wish at 9th; plus by kind, dao sanctuary, spike growth, meld into stone, stone shape, wall of stone; djinni thunderwave, gust of wind, wind wall, greater invisibility, seeming; efreeti burning hands, scorching ray, fireball, fire shield, flame strike; marid fog cloud, blur, sleet storm, control water, cone of cold.

feature:feature:genie-s-vessel.description: A Tiny vessel (AC your spell DC, HP warlock level + proficiency, immune to poison and psychic) that is your warlock focus; replace it with a 1-hour ceremony during a rest. Bottled Respite: action, enter its 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high interior for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours, hearing outside; once per long rest. Genie's Wrath: once per turn on an attack hit, extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus, bludgeoning (dao), thunder (djinni), fire (efreeti) or cold (marid).

feature:feature:elemental-gift.description: Resistance to your patron's damage type. Bonus action: 30-foot flying speed with hover for 10 minutes, proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:sanctuary-vessel.description: Bring up to five willing creatures within 30 feet into the vessel and eject them as a bonus action. Ten minutes inside counts as a short rest, and Hit Dice spent there heal an extra amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:limited-wish.description: Action: produce the effect of any spell of 6th level or lower with a 1-action casting time, ignoring its requirements and costly components. Usable again after 1d4 long rests.

feature:feature:training-in-war-and-song.description: Light armor, one one-handed melee weapon type, and Performance.

feature:feature:bladesong.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, without medium or heavy armor or a shield: + Int mod (min 1) to AC and to concentration saves, +10 feet walking speed, advantage on Acrobatics. Ends if incapacitated, you don such armor or a shield, or attack two-handed. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:bladesinging:extra-attac.description: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one attack can be a cantrip.

feature:feature:song-of-defense.description: During Bladesong, reaction when you take damage: spend a spell slot to reduce it by 5 x the slot's level.

feature:feature:song-of-victory.description: During Bladesong, add Int mod (min 1) to melee weapon damage.

feature:feature:wizardly-quill.description: Bonus action: create an inkless Tiny quill; copying spells with it takes 2 minutes per spell level, and it can erase its own writing within 5 feet as a bonus action.

feature:feature:awakened-spellbook.description: While held: it is your focus; a slotted wizard spell can swap its damage type for one from another spell of the same level in the book; once per long rest cast a ritual at its normal casting time. Replace the book over a short rest with the quill.

feature:feature:manifest-mind.description: Bonus action: the book's spectral mind appears within 60 feet (dim light 10 feet, darkvision 60, shares senses with you, moves 30 feet as a bonus action). Proficiency bonus times per long rest, cast a wizard spell from its space. Ends beyond 300 feet, on dispel magic, or when dismissed. Once per long rest, or spend a spell slot.

feature:feature:master-scrivener.description: After a long rest, make a scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level, 1-action spell from your book that casts one level higher, readable only by you and fading after your next long rest. Spell scrolls cost half the gold and time with the quill.

feature:feature:one-with-the-word.description: Advantage on Arcana while carrying the book. Once per long rest, reaction when you take damage while the mind is manifested: dismiss it to negate the damage; the book loses spells totaling at least 3d6 levels for 1d6 long rests (or you drop to 0 HP if it can't cover the cost).

feature:feature:spirit-seeker.description: Cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals only.

feature:feature:totem-spirit.description: Choose a totem (with a physical totem object). Bear: while raging, resistance to all damage except psychic. Eagle: while raging, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action. Wolf: while raging, friends have advantage on melee attacks against hostile creatures within 5 feet of you.

feature:feature:aspect-of-the-beast.description: Choose a totem: Bear, double carrying capacity and advantage on Str checks to push, pull, lift or break; Eagle, see up to 1 mile in fine detail and dim light doesn't hinder Perception; Wolf, track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

feature:feature:spirit-walker.description: Cast commune with nature as a ritual only.

feature:feature:totemic-attunement.description: Choose a totem: Bear, while raging, hostile creatures within 5 feet that can see or hear you (and can be frightened) have disadvantage attacking anyone but you; Eagle, while raging, flying speed equal to walking speed in bursts (you fall if you end your turn aloft); Wolf, while raging, bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone after hitting it with a melee weapon.

feature:feature:college-of-valor:bonus-p.description: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

feature:feature:combat-inspiration.description: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration can add the die to a weapon damage roll, or use its reaction to add it to AC against an attack after seeing the roll.

feature:feature:battle-magic.description: When you use your action to cast a bard spell, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

feature:feature:knowledge-domain:domain-.description: Always prepared: command, identify (1st); augury, suggestion (3rd); nondetection, speak with dead (5th); arcane eye, confusion (7th); legend lore, scrying (9th).

feature:feature:blessings-of-knowledge.description: Two languages, and proficiency with double bonus in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-knowled.description: Action: proficiency with one skill or tool for 10 minutes.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-read-th.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save: on a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute and can end it to cast suggestion on it without a slot (it automatically fails); on a success you can't target it again until a long rest.

feature:feature:visions-of-the-past.description: Meditate (concentration, up to your Wis score in minutes) for visions: an object's recent owners and how they gained and lost it, or significant events in your surroundings over the last Wis-score days. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:light-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: burning hands, faerie fire (1st); flaming sphere, scorching ray (3rd); daylight, fireball (5th); guardian of faith, wall of fire (7th); flame strike, scrying (9th).

feature:feature:light-domain:bonus-cantr.description: Light, not counted against your cantrips.

feature:feature:warding-flare.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you: impose disadvantage (creatures that can't be blinded are immune). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-radianc.description: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 feet; hostile creatures within 30 feet make a Con save, 2d10 + cleric level radiant, half on a success.

feature:feature:improved-flare.description: Warding Flare also protects creatures within 30 feet that are attacked.

feature:feature:corona-of-light.description: Action, 1 minute: bright light 60 feet and dim 30 more; enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against fire or radiant spells.

feature:feature:nature-domain:domain-spe.description: Always prepared: animal friendship, speak with animals (1st); barkskin, spike growth (3rd); plant growth, wind wall (5th); dominate beast, grasping vine (7th); insect plague, tree stride (9th).

feature:feature:acolyte-of-nature.description: One druid cantrip (as a cleric cantrip, not counted) and one of Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-charm-a.description: Action: beasts and plants within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 minute or until damaged, friendly to you and those you choose.

feature:feature:dampen-elements.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: grant resistance to it.

feature:feature:nature-domain:divine-str.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:master-of-nature.description: Bonus action: command creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity on their next turns.

feature:feature:tempest-domain:domain-sp.description: Always prepared: fog cloud, thunderwave (1st); gust of wind, shatter (3rd); call lightning, sleet storm (5th); control water, ice storm (7th); destructive wave, insect plague (9th).

feature:feature:wrath-of-the-storm.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet hits you: Dex save, 2d8 lightning or thunder, half on a success. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-destruc.description: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, deal the maximum instead.

feature:feature:thunderbolt-strike.description: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, push it up to 10 feet.

feature:feature:tempest-domain:divine-st.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:stormborn.description: Flying speed equal to walking speed when not underground or indoors.

feature:feature:trickery-domain:domain-s.description: Always prepared: charm person, disguise self (1st); mirror image, pass without trace (3rd); blink, dispel magic (5th); dimension door, polymorph (7th); dominate person, modify memory (9th).

feature:feature:blessing-of-the-trickste.description: Action: a willing creature you touch (not you) has advantage on Stealth for 1 hour.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-invoke-.description: Action: an illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute (concentration), movable 30 feet as a bonus action within 120 feet. You can cast spells from its space, and you have advantage attacking a creature when you and the double are both within 5 feet of it.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-cloak-o.description: Action: invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast.

feature:feature:trickery-domain:divine-s.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:improved-duplicity.description: Invoke Duplicity makes up to four doubles.

feature:feature:war-domain:domain-spells.description: Always prepared: divine favor, shield of faith (1st); magic weapon, spiritual weapon (3rd); crusader's mantle, spirit guardians (5th); freedom of movement, stoneskin (7th); flame strike, hold monster (9th).

feature:feature:war-priest.description: When you take the Attack action, one weapon attack as a bonus action. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-guided-.description: +10 to your attack roll after seeing it.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-war-god.description: Reaction: +10 to an attack roll by a creature within 30 feet after seeing it.

feature:feature:war-domain:divine-strike.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:avatar-of-battle.description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

feature:feature:combat-wild-shape.description: Wild Shape as a bonus action. While transformed, bonus action to spend a spell slot and regain 1d8 HP per slot level.

feature:feature:circle-forms.description: Wild Shape into beasts up to CR 1 (ignoring the Max CR column); from 6th level up to druid level / 3.

feature:feature:primal-strike.description: Attacks in beast form count as magical.

feature:feature:elemental-wild-shape.description: Spend two Wild Shape uses to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

feature:feature:combat-superiority.description: Learn three maneuvers (two more at 7th, 10th and 15th, swapping one each time); one maneuver per attack. Four d8 superiority dice (five at 7th, six at 15th), regained on a short or long rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Str or Dex. Maneuvers: Commander's Strike, Disarming Attack, Distracting Strike, Evasive Footwork, Feinting Attack, Goading Attack, Lunging Attack, Maneuvering Attack, Menacing Attack, Parry, Precision Attack, Pushing Attack, Rally, Riposte, Sweeping Attack, Trip Attack.

feature:feature:know-your-enemy.description: After 1 minute observing or talking with a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Str, Dex, Con, AC, current HP, total class levels, fighter levels.

feature:feature:relentless.description: If you roll initiative with no superiority dice, regain one.

feature:feature:spellcasting.description: Wizard spells with Intelligence: 2 cantrips (3 at 10th) and spells known growing from 3 to 13, mostly abjuration and evocation (any school at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th). One-third caster slots up to 4th level.

feature:feature:weapon-bond.description: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to two weapons: you can't be disarmed of them unless incapacitated, and you can summon one to your hand as a bonus action from the same plane.

feature:feature:war-magic.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, one weapon attack as a bonus action.

feature:feature:eldritch-strike.description: A creature you hit with a weapon has disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:arcane-charge.description: When you Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet before or after the extra action.

feature:feature:improved-war-magic.description: When you use your action to cast any spell, one weapon attack as a bonus action.

feature:feature:shadow-arts.description: Action, 2 ki: cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence without material components. You know minor illusion.

feature:feature:shadow-step.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet to another dim or dark space, then advantage on your first melee attack this turn.

feature:feature:cloak-of-shadows.description: In dim light or darkness, action: invisible until you attack, cast a spell or enter bright light.

feature:feature:opportunist.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet is hit by someone else's attack: make a melee attack against it.

feature:feature:disciple-of-the-elements.description: Know Elemental Attunement plus one discipline (one more at 6th, 11th and 17th, swapping one each time). Spells from disciplines need no material components; from 5th level spend extra ki to upcast (max ki per spell 3 at 5th, 4 at 9th, 5 at 13th, 6 at 17th). Disciplines: Elemental Attunement (minor elemental tricks within 30 feet); Fangs of the Fire Snake (1 ki: +10 feet unarmed reach dealing fire, +1 ki for +1d10 fire); Fist of Four Thunders (2 ki: thunderwave); Fist of Unbroken Air (2 ki: Str save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, push 20 feet and prone; half only on success); Rush of the Gale Spirits (2 ki: gust of wind); Shape the Flowing River (1 ki: reshape ice and water in a 30-foot area); Sweeping Cinder Strike (2 ki: burning hands); Water Whip (2 ki: Dex save, 3d10 bludgeoning +1d10 per extra ki, prone or pull 25 feet; half only on success); at 6th Clench of the North Wind (3 ki: hold person) and Gong of the Summit (3 ki: shatter); at 11th Flames of the Phoenix (4 ki: fireball), Mist Stance (4 ki: gaseous form on yourself) and Ride the Wind (4 ki: fly on yourself); at 17th Breath of Winter (6 ki: cone of cold), Eternal Mountain Defense (5 ki: stoneskin on yourself), River of Hungry Flame (5 ki: wall of fire) and Wave of Rolling Earth (6 ki: wall of stone).

feature:feature:oath-of-the-ancients:oat.description: Always prepared: ensnaring strike, speak with animals (3rd); misty step, moonbeam (5th); plant growth, protection from energy (9th); ice storm, stoneskin (13th); commune with nature, tree stride (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-the-ancients:cha.description: Nature's Wrath: action, a creature within 10 feet makes a Str or Dex save (its choice) or is restrained by vines, repeating the save each turn. Turn the Faithless: action, fey and fiends within 30 feet that hear you make a Wis save or are turned for 1 minute or until damaged, revealing any disguised true form.

feature:feature:aura-of-warding.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 at 18th) have resistance to damage from spells.

feature:feature:undying-sentinel.description: Once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP without dying outright, drop to 1 instead. You suffer no drawbacks of age and can't be aged magically.

feature:feature:elder-champion.description: Action, 1 minute: regain 10 HP at the start of each turn, cast 1-action paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your paladin spells and Channel Divinity. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:oath-of-vengeance:oath-s.description: Always prepared: bane, hunter's mark (3rd); hold person, misty step (5th); haste, protection from energy (9th); banishment, dimension door (13th); hold monster, scrying (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-vengeance:channe.description: Abjure Enemy: action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save (fiends and undead with disadvantage) or is frightened with speed 0 for 1 minute or until damaged; on a success its speed is halved for that time. Vow of Enmity: bonus action, advantage on attacks against a creature within 10 feet for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP.

feature:feature:relentless-avenger.description: When you hit with an opportunity attack, move up to half your speed as part of that reaction without provoking.

feature:feature:soul-of-vengeance.description: Reaction when your Vow of Enmity target attacks: a melee weapon attack against it if in range.

feature:feature:avenging-angel.description: Action, 1 hour: 60-foot flying speed and a 30-foot aura; enemies entering it or starting their turn there in battle make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against them have advantage. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:ranger-s-companion.description: A Medium or smaller beast of CR 1/4 or lower; add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attacks, damage and proficient saves and skills; HP is the higher of its own or 4 x ranger level. It acts on your initiative and Dodges unless you use your action to command Attack, Dash, Disengage or Help (with Extra Attack you also make one weapon attack when commanding Attack). Replace it with 8 hours of bonding.

feature:feature:exceptional-training.description: On a turn it doesn't attack, bonus action to command Dash, Disengage or Help; its attacks count as magical.

feature:feature:bestial-fury.description: When commanded to Attack, it makes two attacks or uses Multiattack.

feature:feature:share-spells.description: A spell you cast targeting yourself can also affect your companion within 30 feet.

feature:feature:assassinate.description: Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet in the combat, and hits against surprised creatures are critical hits.

feature:feature:infiltration-expertise.description: Spend seven days and 25 gp to build a false identity that others believe while you wear it, until given obvious reason not to.

feature:feature:impostor.description: After 3 hours of study, mimic a person's speech, writing and behavior; advantage on Deception to avoid detection by wary observers.

feature:feature:death-strike.description: When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Con save (DC 8 + Dex + proficiency) or the attack's damage is doubled.

feature:feature:arcane-trickster:spellca.description: Wizard spells with Intelligence: mage hand plus two cantrips (another at 10th) and spells known growing from 3 to 13, mostly enchantment and illusion (any school at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th). One-third caster slots up to 4th level.

feature:feature:mage-hand-legerdemain.description: Your mage hand can be invisible, stow or retrieve objects in another creature's container, and use thieves' tools at range; Sleight of Hand vs Perception to go unnoticed. Control it with your Cunning Action bonus action.

feature:feature:magical-ambush.description: If you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, it has disadvantage on its saves against the spell this turn.

feature:feature:versatile-trickster.description: Bonus action: advantage on attacks this turn against a creature within 5 feet of your mage hand.

feature:feature:spell-thief.description: Reaction right after a creature casts a spell targeting or including you: it saves with its casting ability against your spell DC; on a failure the spell doesn't affect you and, if it is 1st level or higher and of a level you can cast, you know it for 8 hours while the caster can't cast it. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:wild-magic-surge.description: Once per turn after you cast a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the d100 Wild Magic Surge table (spells it produces ignore Metamagic and concentration).

feature:feature:tides-of-chaos.description: Advantage on one attack, check or save; regained after a long rest, or when the DM has you roll on the surge table after a 1st-level or higher sorcerer spell.

feature:feature:bend-luck.description: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 to another visible creature's attack, check or save after the roll.

feature:feature:controlled-chaos.description: Roll twice on the surge table and choose.

feature:feature:spell-bombardment.description: Once per turn, when a spell damage die rolls its maximum, roll one such die again and add it.

feature:feature:the-archfey:expanded-spe.description: Added to your warlock list: faerie fire, sleep (1st); calm emotions, phantasmal force (2nd); blink, plant growth (3rd); dominate beast, greater invisibility (4th); dominate person, seeming (5th).

feature:feature:fey-presence.description: Action: creatures in a 10-foot cube from you make a Wis save or are charmed or frightened (your choice) until the end of your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:misty-escape.description: Reaction when you take damage: invisible and teleport up to 60 feet, until your next turn or until you attack or cast. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:beguiling-defenses.description: Immune to charm; reaction when a creature tries to charm you: it makes a Wis save or is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.

feature:feature:dark-delirium.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save or is charmed or frightened for 1 minute (concentration, ends if damaged), lost in an illusory realm seeing only you. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:the-great-old-one:expand.description: Added to your warlock list: dissonant whispers, Tasha's hideous laughter (1st); detect thoughts, phantasmal force (2nd); clairvoyance, sending (3rd); dominate beast, Evard's black tentacles (4th); dominate person, telekinesis (5th).

feature:feature:awakened-mind.description: Speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet that understands a language.

feature:feature:entropic-ward.description: Reaction when attacked: impose disadvantage; if it misses, your next attack against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:thought-shield.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic, and a creature that deals you psychic damage takes the same amount.

feature:feature:create-thrall.description: Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the condition is removed, or you use this again; telepathy with it on the same plane.

feature:feature:abjuration-savant.description: Copying abjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:arcane-ward.description: When you cast a 1st-level or higher abjuration spell, create a ward (HP 2 x wizard level + Int, once per long rest) that takes damage for you; each later 1st-level or higher abjuration spell restores 2 x spell level HP to it.

feature:feature:projected-ward.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet takes damage: your ward absorbs it.

feature:feature:improved-abjuration.description: Add your proficiency bonus to ability checks made as part of abjuration spells (counterspell, dispel magic).

feature:feature:spell-resistance.description: Advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

feature:feature:conjuration-savant.description: Copying conjuration spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:minor-conjuration.description: Action: conjure a nonmagical object you've seen (up to 3 feet per side and 10 pounds) within 10 feet, glowing dimly; it lasts 1 hour or until it deals or takes damage.

feature:feature:benign-transposition.description: Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Small or Medium creature. Once per long rest, or after you cast a 1st-level or higher conjuration spell.

feature:feature:focused-conjuration.description: Damage can't break your concentration on conjuration spells.

feature:feature:durable-summons.description: Creatures you summon or create with conjuration spells have 30 temporary HP.

feature:feature:divination-savant.description: Copying divination spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:portent.description: After a long rest roll two d20s; before a roll by you or a creature you can see, replace it with one of them (once per turn). Unused ones are lost at the next long rest.

feature:feature:expert-divination.description: When you cast a 2nd-level or higher divination spell with a slot, regain a slot of a lower level (max 5th).

feature:feature:the-third-eye.description: Action, until incapacitated or a rest: darkvision 60 feet, see into the Ethereal Plane within 60 feet, read any language, or see invisible things within 10 feet. Once per rest.

feature:feature:enchantment-savant.description: Copying enchantment spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:hypnotic-gaze.description: Action, a creature within 5 feet that sees or hears you makes a Wis save or is charmed, speed 0 and incapacitated until the end of your next turn; extend it with your action each turn. Ends if you move away, it loses sight and sound of you, or it takes damage. Once per long rest per creature.

feature:feature:instinctive-charm.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you and another creature is in range: Wis save or it attacks the creature closest to it instead (a success makes it immune until a long rest).

feature:feature:split-enchantment.description: A 1st-level or higher enchantment spell that targets one creature can target a second.

feature:feature:alter-memories.description: A creature you charm with an enchantment can be left unaware of it; once before the spell ends, action: Int save or it forgets up to 1 + Cha mod hours of the charmed time.

feature:feature:illusion-savant.description: Copying illusion spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:improved-minor-illusion.description: Learn minor illusion (or another wizard cantrip if you know it), not counted; it can make a sound and an image at once.

feature:feature:malleable-illusions.description: Action: change an illusion of 1 minute or longer that you can see, within its normal parameters.

feature:feature:illusory-self.description: Reaction when attacked: the attack automatically misses. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:illusory-reality.description: Bonus action while a 1st-level or higher illusion spell lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute (it can't directly harm anyone).

feature:feature:necromancy-savant.description: Copying necromancy spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:grim-harvest.description: Once per turn, when your 1st-level or higher spell kills creatures (not constructs or undead), regain 2 x spell level HP (3 x for necromancy).

feature:feature:undead-thralls.description: Add animate dead to your book; it targets one extra corpse, and your undead gain HP equal to your wizard level and add your proficiency bonus to weapon damage.

feature:feature:inured-to-undeath.description: Resistance to necrotic, and your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

feature:feature:command-undead.description: Action, an undead within 60 feet makes a Cha save or obeys you until you use this again (Int 8+ has advantage; Int 12+ repeats the save each hour). A success makes it immune.

feature:feature:transmutation-savant.description: Copying transmutation spells costs half the gold and time.

feature:feature:minor-alchemy.description: Transform wood, stone (not gems), iron, copper or silver into another of those, 1 cubic foot per 10 minutes, for 1 hour or until your concentration ends.

feature:feature:transmuter-s-stone.description: 8 hours to make a stone granting its holder one of: darkvision 60 feet, +10 feet speed while unencumbered, Con save proficiency, or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Change it when you cast a 1st-level or higher transmutation spell; a new stone ends the old.

feature:feature:shapechanger.description: Add polymorph to your book; cast it on yourself without a slot into a beast of CR 1 or lower, once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:master-transmuter.description: Action, destroy your stone (remake after a long rest) for one: transmute a nonmagical object up to a 5-foot cube into one of equal or lesser value (10 minutes); remove curses, diseases and poisons and restore all HP to a creature you touch; raise dead without a slot; or reduce a willing creature's apparent age by 3d10 years (minimum 13).

feature:feature:battlerager-armor.description: Dwarves only (DM may lift). Spiked armor (medium, AC 14 + Dex max 2, 75 gp) is a weapon for you: while raging, a bonus-action spike attack for 1d4 + Str piercing, and a successful grapple from the Attack action deals 3 piercing.

feature:feature:reckless-abandon.description: Reckless Attack while raging gives temporary HP equal to your Con mod (min 1), lost when the rage ends.

feature:feature:battlerager-charge.description: Dash as a bonus action while raging.

feature:feature:spiked-retribution.description: While raging in spiked armor and not incapacitated, a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 3 piercing.

feature:feature:rallying-cry.description: When you use Second Wind, up to three allies within 60 feet who see or hear you regain HP equal to your fighter level.

feature:feature:royal-envoy.description: Persuasion proficiency (or one of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Performance) and double proficiency on Persuasion.

feature:feature:inspiring-surge.description: When you Action Surge, an ally within 60 feet who sees or hears you can use its reaction for one weapon attack (two allies at 18th).

feature:feature:bulwark.description: When you use Indomitable on an Int, Wis or Cha save, an ally within 60 feet who failed against the same effect and sees or hears you also rerolls.

feature:feature:touch-of-death.description: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Wis mod + monk level (min 1).

feature:feature:hour-of-reaping.description: Action: creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:mastery-of-death.description: When reduced to 0 HP, spend 1 ki to drop to 1 instead.

feature:feature:touch-of-the-long-death.description: Action, spend 1 to 10 ki: a creature within 5 feet makes a Con save, 2d10 necrotic per ki, half on a success.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-crown:oath-s.description: Always prepared: command, compelled duel (3rd); warding bond, zone of truth (5th); aura of vitality, spirit guardians (9th); banishment, guardian of faith (13th); circle of power, geas (17th).

feature:feature:oath-of-the-crown:channe.description: Champion Challenge: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you. Turn the Tide: bonus action, chosen creatures within 30 feet at half HP or less regain 1d6 + Cha mod (min 1).

feature:feature:divine-allegiance.description: Reaction when a creature within 5 feet takes damage: you take it instead; it can't be reduced.

feature:feature:unyielding-spirit.description: Advantage on saves against paralyzed and stunned.

feature:feature:exalted-champion.description: Action, 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage; allies within 30 feet have advantage on death saves, and you and they have advantage on Wis saves. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:the-undying:expanded-spe.description: Added to your warlock list: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, silence (2nd); feign death, speak with dead (3rd); aura of life, death ward (4th); contagion, legend lore (5th).

feature:feature:among-the-dead.description: Learn spare the dying; advantage on saves against disease. An undead that targets you directly makes a Wis save or must pick another target (a success, or your attacking it, makes it immune for 24 hours).

feature:feature:defy-death.description: When you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature with spare the dying, regain 1d8 + Con mod HP. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:undying-nature.description: Hold your breath indefinitely; no need for food, water or sleep; age one year per ten and immune to magical aging.

feature:feature:indestructible-life.description: Bonus action: regain 1d8 + warlock level HP and reattach a severed part you hold in place. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:death-domain:domain-spel.description: Always prepared: false life, ray of sickness (1st); blindness/deafness, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); animate dead, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, cloudkill (9th).

feature:feature:reaper.description: Learn one necromancy cantrip from any list. A necromancy cantrip that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-touch-o.description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend Channel Divinity for extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

feature:feature:inescapable-destruction.description: Necrotic damage from your cleric spells and Channel Divinity ignores necrotic resistance.

feature:feature:death-domain:divine-stri.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:improved-reaper.description: A 1st to 5th level necromancy spell that targets one creature can target two within range and within 5 feet of each other (consumed components needed for each).

feature:feature:oathbreaker:oath-spells.description: Replaces prior oath spells: hellish rebuke, inflict wounds (3rd); crown of madness, darkness (5th); animate dead, bestow curse (9th); blight, confusion (13th); contagion, dominate person (17th). Requires evil alignment.

feature:feature:oathbreaker:channel-divi.description: Control Undead: action, an undead within 30 feet makes a Wis save or obeys you for 24 hours (no effect if its CR is at least your level). Dreadful Aspect: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet that see you make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save if they end a turn more than 30 feet away.

feature:feature:aura-of-hate.description: You and fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Cha mod (min +1) to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th. One paladin's aura per creature.

feature:feature:supernatural-resistance.description: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons.

feature:feature:dread-lord.description: Action, 1 minute, once per long rest: bright light within 30 feet becomes dim; enemies frightened of you that start a turn in it take 4d10 psychic; attacks relying on sight have disadvantage against you and chosen allies in it; bonus action for a melee spell attack dealing 3d10 + Cha mod necrotic.

feature:feature:giant-s-power.description: Learn Giant (or another language if you know it) and druidcraft or thaumaturgy (Wis).

feature:feature:giant-s-havoc.description: While raging: add Rage Damage to Strength-based thrown weapon hits, reach +5 feet, and become Large if smaller and space allows.

feature:feature:elemental-cleaver.description: On entering rage, infuse a held weapon with acid, cold, fire, thunder or lightning: damage becomes that type, +1d6 of it, and it gains thrown (20/60) and returns after a throw. Bonus action to swap the type.

feature:feature:mighty-impel.description: Bonus action while raging: move a Medium or smaller creature in reach to a space within 30 feet; unwilling targets make a Str save (DC 8 + PB + Str). Unsupported targets fall prone.

feature:feature:demiurgic-colossus.description: Raging reach +10 feet and you can become Large or Huge; Mighty Impel works on Large or smaller; Elemental Cleaver extra damage becomes 2d6.

feature:feature:guiding-whispers.description: Learn guidance (not counted against cantrips known); range 60 feet for you.

feature:feature:spiritual-focus.description: A candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board or tarokka deck works as your focus. From 6th, damage or healing bard spells cast through it add 1d6 to one roll.

feature:feature:tales-from-beyond.description: Bonus action holding your focus, spend Bardic Inspiration and roll it on the Spirit Tales table; action to bestow the tale on a creature within 30 feet (or you). One tale held at a time, saves use your spell DC. Tales by roll: 1 Clever Animal (add your die to Int, Wis, Cha checks for 10 minutes), 2 Renowned Duelist (melee spell attack, two dice + Cha force), 3 Beloved Friends (target and one ally gain die + Cha temp HP), 4 Runaway (reaction teleport 30 feet, plus up to Cha mod others), 5 Avenger (1 minute, melee attackers take die force), 6 Traveler (die + bard level temp HP, +10 speed and +1 AC while they last), 7 Beguiler (Wis save or two dice psychic and incapacitated), 8 Phantom (invisible; first hit adds die necrotic and frightens), 9 Brute (Str save in 30 feet, three dice thunder and prone, half on success), 10 Dragon (30-foot cone, Dex save, four dice fire), 11 Angel (heal two dice + Cha and end blinded, deafened, paralyzed, petrified or poisoned), 12 Mind-Bender (Int save or three dice psychic and stunned).

feature:feature:spirit-session.description: Hour-long ritual (can be during a rest) with up to PB willing creatures: temporarily learn a divination or necromancy spell from any class of level up to the number of participants and that you can cast. Once per long rest; known until your next long rest.

feature:feature:mystical-connection.description: Roll twice on Spirit Tales and choose; doubles let you choose any tale.

feature:feature:the-undead:expanded-spel.description: Added to your warlock list: bane, false life (1st); blindness/deafness, phantasmal force (2nd); phantom steed, speak with dead (3rd); death ward, greater invisibility (4th); antilife shell, cloudkill (5th).

feature:feature:form-of-dread.description: Bonus action, 1 minute, PB times per long rest: gain 1d10 + warlock level temp HP, immunity to frightened, and once per turn a hit can force a Wis save or the target is frightened until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:grave-touched.description: No need to eat, drink or breathe. Once per turn change an attack's damage to necrotic; in Form of Dread roll one extra damage die.

feature:feature:necrotic-husk.description: Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread). Reaction when reduced to 0 HP: drop to 1 instead, chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d10 + warlock level necrotic, and you gain a level of exhaustion. Recharges after 1d4 long rests.

feature:feature:spirit-projection.description: Action, once per long rest, up to 1 hour (concentration): project your spirit, leaving your body unconscious. Gain BPS resistance, no V, S or costless M components for conjuration and necromancy, fly speed equal to walking (hover, move through objects), and in Form of Dread heal half the necrotic damage you deal once per turn.

feature:feature:draconic-disciple.description: Draconic Presence: reaction to reroll a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check (once per long rest if it succeeds). Draconic Strike: unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison. Tongue of Dragons: learn Draconic or another language.

feature:feature:breath-of-the-dragon.description: Replace one attack of the Attack action with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line: Dex save vs ki DC, two Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on success (three dice at 11th). PB uses per long rest, then 2 ki each.

feature:feature:wings-unfurled.description: When you use Step of the Wind, gain a fly speed equal to walking speed until the end of your turn. PB uses per long rest.

feature:feature:aspect-of-the-wyrm.description: Bonus action, 10-foot aura for 1 minute: Frightful Presence (bonus action, Wis save or frightened, repeating) or Resistance to a chosen element for you and allies in it. Once per long rest or 3 ki.

feature:feature:ascendant-aspect.description: Augment Breath: 1 ki for a 60-foot cone or 90-foot line dealing four dice. Blindsight 10 feet. Explosive Fury: activating Aspect of the Wyrm forces chosen creatures in the aura to make a Dex save or take 3d10 of a chosen element.

feature:feature:draconic-gift.description: Learn thaumaturgy (ranger spell) and Draconic or another language.

feature:feature:drake-companion.description: Action: summon your Small dragon drake within 30 feet (AC 14 + PB, HP 5 + 5 x ranger level, speed 40, bite +3 + PB for 1d6 + PB piercing, reaction Infused Strikes adds 1d6 of its essence to an ally's weapon hit within 30 feet). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison essence for its immunity. Acts on your turn; Dodges unless you spend a bonus action to command it. Once per long rest or a 1st-level slot.

feature:feature:bond-of-fang-and-scale.description: Drake gains wings (fly speed equal to walking), grows to Medium and can be ridden (no flying while ridden), bite adds 1d6 of its essence, and you gain resistance to its essence type.

feature:feature:drake-s-breath.description: Action: you or the drake exhale a 30-foot cone of a chosen element, Dex save vs spell DC, 8d6 (10d6 at 15th), half on success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

feature:feature:perfected-bond.description: Bite adds another 1d6 (2d6 total); drake grows to Large and can fly while ridden; reaction PB times per long rest to give you or the drake resistance to one instance of damage while within 30 feet.

feature:feature:manifest-echo.description: Bonus action: create an echo of yourself within 15 feet (AC 14 + PB, 1 HP, immune to conditions, uses your saves); it moves 30 feet on your turn for free and is destroyed beyond 30 feet. Bonus action and 15 feet of movement to swap places; Attack action attacks can originate from it; reaction opportunity attacks from its space.

feature:feature:unleash-incarnation.description: When you take the Attack action, make one extra melee attack from the echo. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:echo-avatar.description: Action: see and hear through the echo for up to 10 minutes (you are blinded and deafened); it can be up to 1,000 feet away.

feature:feature:shadow-martyr.description: Reaction before an attack roll against a creature you see: teleport the echo within 5 feet of it and the attack targets the echo. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:reclaim-potential.description: When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Con mod temp HP if you have none. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:legion-of-one.description: Manifest two coexisting echoes; and when you roll initiative with no Unleash Incarnation uses, regain one.

feature:feature:chronal-shift.description: Reaction after you or a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: force a reroll (after seeing the result). Twice per long rest.

feature:feature:temporal-awareness.description: Add your Int mod to initiative.

feature:feature:momentary-stasis.description: Action: a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet makes a Con save or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:arcane-abeyance.description: When you cast a spell of 4th level or lower, store it in a bead for 1 hour (AC 15, 1 HP); a holder can release it as an action using your attack bonus and DC. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:convergent-future.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, check or save: set the roll to the minimum needed to succeed or one less. Gain a level of exhaustion, removable only by a long rest.

feature:feature:adjust-density.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: halve or double the weight of a Large or smaller creature or object within 30 feet (Huge at 10th). Halved: +10 speed, double jump, disadvantage on Str checks and saves. Doubled: -10 speed, advantage on Str checks and saves.

feature:feature:gravity-well.description: When a spell you cast hits a creature with an attack, it fails a save, or it is willing, move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space.

feature:feature:violent-attraction.description: Reaction: a weapon hit by a creature within 60 feet deals an extra 1d10, or a fall within 60 feet deals an extra 2d10. Int mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

feature:feature:event-horizon.description: Action, concentration up to 1 minute: hostile creatures starting a turn within 30 feet make a Str save, taking 2d10 force and speed 0 on a failure, or half damage and 2 extra feet per foot moved on a success. Once per long rest or a 3rd-level slot.

feature:feature:lunar-embodiment.description: Learn the Lunar Spells (not counted against spells known): shield, ray of sickness, color spray (1st); lesser restoration, blindness/deafness, alter self (3rd); dispel magic, vampiric touch, phantom steed (5th); death ward, confusion, hallucinatory terrain (7th); Rary's telepathic bond, hold monster, mislead (9th). After a long rest pick Full, New or Crescent Moon; cast that phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest.

feature:feature:moon-fire.description: Learn sacred flame (not counted against cantrips); it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

feature:feature:lunar-boons.description: Metamagic on spells of your phase's schools costs 1 less sorcery point (Full: abjuration, divination; New: enchantment, necromancy; Crescent: illusion, transmutation). PB times per long rest.

feature:feature:waxing-and-waning.description: Bonus action and 1 sorcery point to change phase. You can cast each phase's 1st-level spell once free per long rest while in that phase.

feature:feature:lunar-empowerment.description: Full: bonus action to shed 10-foot bright light, advantage on Investigation and Perception for you and chosen creatures in it. New: advantage on Stealth, and attacks against you have disadvantage while you are in darkness. Crescent: resistance to necrotic and radiant.

feature:feature:lunar-phenomenon.description: Bonus action (or as part of changing phase), once per long rest each or 5 sorcery points. Full: chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save or are blinded until the end of their next turn, and one creature regains 3d8 HP. New: Dex save or 3d10 necrotic and speed 0, and you turn invisible until the end of your next turn. Crescent: teleport 60 feet with one willing creature, both gaining resistance to all damage until your next turn.

feature:feature:martial-maneuvers.description: Learn three Carrion Raven maneuvers (one more at 6th, 10th, and 14th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your Barbarian level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Con mod. Apex Dominance (5, action): Str save (Disadvantage if you grapple it) or 6d10 force, half on success; kills outright at 0 HP. Axolotl's Regeneration (2 or 6, bonus action): heal 1d12 + Con mod; at 6 points also regrow a limb or organ. Bestial Transformation (8, action): polymorph yourself into a beast of CR up to half your level, keeping mental scores. Call of the Beast Lord (5, action, concentration): summon a beast of CR up to your level for 10 minutes. Carrion Feast (4, action): melee attack with +5d6 necrotic and temp HP equal to it. Falcon's Glide (1, reaction): slow a fall to 60 feet per round, and 1 more point per bonus action for 30-foot flight that turn. Feral Fighting (1, bonus action): an unarmed strike dealing 1d8. Hibernating Bear Recuperation (5, action): a 10-minute sleep with resistance to non-psychic damage that counts as a short rest, ends poison, removes 1 exhaustion, and turns spent Hit Dice into temp HP. Pack Leader (1, reaction): when an adjacent enemy is attacked, give that attack advantage and attack it yourself. Predator's Howl (2, bonus action): two creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened until your next turn, taking +1d6 psychic from weapon hits. Shape of the Behemoth (3, action, concentration, 1 minute): grow a size (max Large), +5 feet reach, +1d6 weapon damage, 1d6 temp HP each turn. Slippery Otter (1, bonus action): swim 30, hold breath for twice your Con score in minutes, bonus action Dash in water for an hour. Snout of the Bloodhound (1, 1 minute): for an hour, advantage on Perception and tracking, add PB to initiative, no disadvantage against invisible creatures. Stoic Oxen Spirit (2, reaction): end charmed or frightened and gain advantage against its source until the end of your next turn. Trampling Bull (3, bonus action): move your speed through creatures your size or smaller; each makes a Str save or falls prone and takes 1d8 + Str mod bludgeoning. Tusks of the Rampaging Mammoth (3, action): a melee attack dealing +3d12 and pushing a Huge or smaller target 15 feet. Woolly Beast's Hide (2+, reaction): reduce a hit's damage by 1d6 per 2 points and gain that much temp HP.

feature:feature:feral-celerity.description: Make one weapon attack as part of the bonus action that starts your rage, and you can concentrate on maneuvers (not spells) while raging.

feature:feature:raven-s-spirit.description: Proficiency in Animal Handling (or Athletics, Nature, or Survival if you have it), and you can cast speak with animals as a ritual.

feature:feature:ferocious-rage.description: When you rage, chosen creatures within 10 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save against your maneuver DC or are frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

feature:feature:violent-hunger.description: Once per attack, when a weapon damage die rolls its maximum, spend 1 maneuver point to roll another of that die and add it.

feature:feature:chilling-melody.description: Learn two necromancy cantrips from any list; they are bard spells and don't count against your cantrips known.

feature:feature:pluck-the-heartstrings.description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can spend it when dealing weapon damage to add the roll as necrotic damage, or as a reaction when a living creature drops to 0 hit points to drop to 1 instead.

feature:feature:stir-the-bones.description: Learn animate dead (a bard spell that doesn't count against spells known). When you give out Bardic Inspiration, up to PB undead you control within 60 feet each gain a Dirge die usable like Bardic Inspiration within 10 minutes, and you can command them with the same bonus action. An undead that spends a Dirge die on a hit also adds it to damage.

feature:feature:dance-of-the-dead.description: Once per short or long rest, a single-target necromancy spell you cast can target a second creature in range at no extra component cost.

feature:feature:inquisition-domain-spell.description: Always prepared at cleric levels: 1st detect magic, identify; 3rd see invisibility, silence; 5th dispel magic, remove curse; 7th arcane eye, locate creature; 9th creation, hallow.

feature:feature:witch-hunter-s-strike.description: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, a weapon hit deals +1d8 force (2d8 against a concentrating creature); at 14th level 2d8 and 3d8. If the target then fails its concentration save, gain temp HP equal to that extra damage.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-spell-s.description: As a bonus action, a creature within 30 feet (or you) gains 1d10 + cleric level temp HP for up to 1 hour; while they last it has resistance to spell damage and advantage on saves against spells.

feature:feature:rebuke-invoker.description: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per long rest, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell: Constitution save or 1d8 per slot level (cantrips count as 1st) + Wis mod force, half on success.

feature:feature:inquisition-domain:divin.description: Once per turn a weapon hit deals +1d8 force (2d8 at 14th level).

feature:feature:supernal-safeguard.description: Spell Shield can target up to your Wisdom modifier (min 2) creatures.

feature:feature:blade-breaker:martial-ma.description: Learn three Blade Breaker maneuvers (more at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th; swap one each time). Maneuver points equal twice your fighter level, regained on a long rest; one maneuver per turn; save DC 8 + PB + Str or Dex mod. Arcing Iron (1+, bonus action): your next melee attack also hits each other creature in reach, 1 point per extra target. Armor-Crushing Blows (4): a hit deals no damage but a Dex or Con save or nonmagical armor loses 2 AC (destroyed if already damaged). Blade Breaking Blow (4): the same against a nonmagical weapon (half damage, then destroyed). Blade of Eternal Demise (3, action): for 8 hours your weapon's damage to a named creature also lowers its HP maximum until a long rest, and it can't be revived while the weapon touches it. Commanding Grasp (2, action): a creature your size or smaller within 30 feet makes a Str save or is teleported next to you and grappled. Contest of Wills (1, bonus action): opposed Intimidation; the winner has advantage on attacks against the other until the end of its next turn. Disarming Swipe (2): a hit deals no damage but a Str or Dex save or it drops its weapons and shield. Helmsplitter (4): on a hit, Con save or stunned until the end of its next turn (disadvantage if you had advantage). Iron Tempest (4, action): your hits this turn deal +2d6 and you make PB extra attacks, each at a different target. Refusal to Bleed (1, reaction): reduce damage by 1d10 + fighter level; 3 more points extends it to that attacker until your next turn. Steely Determination (1): Second Wind heals an extra fighter level. Unstoppable Missile (2, action): throw your melee weapon in a 30-foot line; Dex save or weapon damage + Str or Dex mod, 1 point more per creature for +2d6. Wall of Blades (2, reaction): when hit, attack the attacker and use the attack roll as your AC until your next turn.

feature:feature:stance-of-the-blade-brea.description: Learn a stance (more at 7th, 10th, and 15th); enter one on initiative and switch as a bonus action. Adamantine Bull: reaction to push a same-size-or-smaller melee attacker 5 feet on a failed Str save (10 feet at 18th). Iron Punisher: advantage on your melee attacks but attacks against you have advantage (+2d6 damage at 18th). Steel Serpent: +5 feet reach on your turn (always at 18th). Weightless Mithral: advantage on Dex saves (bonus action Dodge at 18th).

feature:feature:unyielding-determination.description: Advantage on saving throws made during your turn.

feature:feature:breaker-of-minds.description: As a bonus action, spend up to 3 maneuver points to deal 1d6 psychic per point to a creature you are grappling.

feature:feature:adrenaline-rush.description: Second Wind also restores maneuver points equal to half your fighter level.

feature:feature:blooded-clarity.description: Below half your hit points, add a d10 to the first attack roll or save you make each turn, and maneuvers cost 1 point less (min 1).

feature:feature:oath-of-zeal:oath-spells.description: Always prepared at paladin levels: 3rd detect evil and good, hunter's mark; 5th detect thoughts, knock; 9th fear, tongues; 13th divination, locate creature; 17th insect plague, scrying.

feature:feature:oath-of-zeal:channel-div.description: Mark of the Heretic: as a bonus action mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; your weapon attacks against it crit on 19-20 and you can use your reaction to attack it whenever its turn starts. Inquisitor's Eye: as a bonus action gain advantage on Investigation, Insight, and Perception for 10 minutes and you can't be surprised.
