feature:feature:sanguine-recall.description: Once per long rest as an action, recover spell slots totaling up to half your cleric level (none 6th or higher), taking 1d8 unreducible necrotic per slot level.

feature:feature:blood-domain:divine-stri.description: Once per turn your weapon hits deal +1d8 necrotic (2d8 at 14th).

feature:feature:vascular-corruption-aura.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute hostile creatures with blood that first move within 30 feet on a turn or start there take 3d6 necrotic and regain only half hit points while inside.

feature:feature:moon-domain:domain-spell.description: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st faerie fire, silent image; 3rd invisibility, moonbeam; 5th hypnotic pattern, major image; 7th greater invisibility, hallucinatory terrain; 9th dream, passwall.

feature:feature:clarity-of-catha.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save, use your reaction to give it advantage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-blessin.description: As an action, bless a willing creature within 30 feet: Watchful Moon (1 hour: +10 feet speed and advantage on smell-based or tracking Perception and Survival) or Blood-Drenched Moon (10 minutes: advantage on attacks against targets next to an ally).

feature:feature:channel-divinity-mind-of.description: Spend a Channel Divinity to concentrate on two Moon Domain spells at once; concentration saves for both have disadvantage and a failure ends both.

feature:feature:empowered-cantrips.description: Your cleric cantrips deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

feature:feature:eclipse-of-ill-omen.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, create 60 feet of reddish dim light (concentration, 1 minute): creatures you don't exempt have disadvantage on saves, and once per turn when you deal radiant damage there you can curse one, halving its speed and preventing healing.

feature:feature:defile-ground.description: Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, corrupt a 10-foot radius within 60 feet for 1 minute (20 feet at 10th): difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time each turn a creature there takes damage from an attack or spell it takes +1d4 necrotic (1d6 at 10th, 1d8 at 14th). Move it 30 feet as a bonus action; fliers are unaffected.

feature:feature:blighted-shape.description: Proficiency in Intimidation. In Wild Shape you gain +2 AC and darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet).

feature:feature:call-of-the-shadowseeds.description: When a creature that isn't undead or a construct takes damage in your defiled ground, use your reaction to summon a blighted sapling within 5 feet that can attack immediately and then obeys you on your initiative (AC 10 + PB, hit points twice your druid level, claws with your spell attack for 2d4 + PB piercing; two attacks at 14th). Proficiency bonus uses per long rest.

feature:feature:foul-conjuration.description: Beasts, fey, and plants you summon or create are immune to necrotic, poison, and poisoned, and explode when reduced to 0 (or on your action), forcing a Constitution save against necrotic damage scaled by their CR.

feature:feature:incarnation-of-corruptio.description: Resistance to necrotic and +2 AC; starting your turn in your defiled ground, a bonus action grants temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:extract-aspects.description: When you hit a creature with a Flurry of Blows attack, you analyze it: you learn its damage vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities and its condition immunities, and until you finish a rest, when it misses you, use your reaction to make an unarmed strike against it if in reach.

feature:feature:extort-truth.description: When you hit with an unarmed strike (or a harmless touch), spend 1 ki: on a failed Charisma save the creature can't speak a deliberate lie and Charisma checks against it have advantage for up to 10 minutes; you know whether it saved.

feature:feature:mystical-erudition.description: Learn a language and gain proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion (or double your proficiency bonus in one you have). Again at 11th and 17th level.

feature:feature:mind-of-mercury.description: Once per turn after using your reaction, spend 1 ki to take another reaction (one per trigger).

feature:feature:debilitating-barrage.description: When you hit with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki to give the creature vulnerability to a damage type for 1 minute or until it takes that type (resistance is suppressed instead; immunity unaffected). Once per creature per 24 hours.

feature:feature:tenets-of-the-open-sea.description: No Greater Life than a Life Lived Free; Trust the Skies; Adapt Like the Water; Explore the Uncharted.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-open-sea:oat.description: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd create or destroy water, expeditious retreat; 5th augury, misty step; 9th call lightning, freedom of the waves; 13th control water, freedom of movement; 17th commune with nature, freedom of the winds.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-open-sea:cha.description: Marine Layer: as an action, fog fills 20 feet around you for 10 minutes, moving with you; heavily obscured except lightly obscured for you and creatures within 5 feet. Fury of the Tides: as a bonus action for 1 minute, once per turn a weapon hit can push the target 10 feet, dealing bludgeoning equal to your Charisma modifier if it hits an obstacle or creature.

feature:feature:aura-of-liberation.description: You and chosen creatures within 10 feet (30 feet at 18th) can't be grappled or restrained and ignore underwater movement and attack penalties; those already held can escape nonmagical restraints for 5 feet of movement.

feature:feature:stormy-waters.description: When a creature moves into or out of your reach, use your reaction: it takes 1d12 bludgeoning and makes a Strength save or falls prone.

feature:feature:mythic-swashbuckler.description: Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute: advantage on Athletics and a climb speed equal to walking speed (or doubled), advantage on attacks against a lone adjacent creature, Dash or Disengage as a bonus action, and advantage on Dexterity checks and saves against effects you can see.

feature:feature:essence-runes.description: You have essence runes equal to your sorcerer level. At the end of a turn you spend sorcery points, that many runes become charged; a bonus action and 1 sorcery point charges two more. Five or more charged runes shed light. Expended runes go inert, and all revert after a long rest.

feature:feature:runic-magic.description: Spells known at sorcerer levels (not counted against spells known): 1st longstrider, protection from evil and good; 3rd lesser restoration, protection from poison; 5th glyph of warding, magic circle; 7th death ward, freedom of movement; 9th greater restoration, telekinesis. On leveling, swap one for an abjuration or transmutation spell of the same level.

feature:feature:glyph-of-aegis.description: When you take damage, use your reaction and expend charged runes to reduce it by 1d6 per rune (d8 at 14th). From 6th level, as an action touch a creature and expend up to 3 runes to give it that protection against its next damage within an hour.

feature:feature:sigilic-augmentation.description: Expend a charged rune as a reaction for advantage on a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check, or once per long rest on such a saving throw.

feature:feature:manifest-inscriptions.description: As an action, expend a charged rune to reveal hidden or invisible traps, runes, wards, sensors, and glyphs within 60 feet for 1 minute, with advantage on Arcana to understand them and the ability to read them.

feature:feature:runic-torrent.description: Once per short or long rest, when you cast a spell, expend 2 charged runes to make it deal force damage; affected creatures make a Strength save or are knocked prone or pushed 15 feet.

feature:feature:arcane-exemplar.description: Once per long rest as a bonus action, expend a charged rune to become pure magic until the end of your turn (extend a turn at a time by expending more): fly 60 feet, disadvantage on saves against your sorcerer spells, resistance to spell damage, and heal the level of each spell you cast. Afterward you are stunned until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:blood-channeling.description: While below your hit point maximum, your body is an arcane focus. You can replace a costly material component of a wizard spell by taking 1d10 unreducible necrotic per 50 gp (if it drops you to 0 the spell fails but the slot isn't spent).

feature:feature:sanguine-burst.description: When you roll damage for a spell of 1st level or higher, take necrotic damage equal to its level to reroll up to your Intelligence modifier damage dice.

feature:feature:bond-of-mutual-suffering.description: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to deal it the same damage (not constructs or undead). Once per short or long rest (twice from 14th).

feature:feature:glyph-of-hemorrhaging.description: Once per short or long rest, when your spell damages a creature (not undead or construct), curse it for 1 minute: attacks that hit it deal +1d6 necrotic; Constitution save at the end of each turn ends it.

feature:feature:thicker-than-water.description: Regain extra hit points equal to your proficiency bonus from spells and magical healing, and while concentrating you resist nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.

feature:feature:asmodeus-s-blessing.description: Gain proficiency in your choice of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion, and you can now read and write the languages from Forked Tongue as well as speak them.

feature:feature:architect-of-ruin:spellc.description: You cast illrigger spells from the Architect of Ruin list using Charisma (spell save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier; attack bonus proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier), with an unholy symbol as a focus (needs a free hand, which can also perform somatic components); slots return on a long rest. Cantrips known: 2 at 3rd, 3 at 10th. Spells known by illrigger level: 3 at 3rd, 4 at 4th, 5 at 7th, 6 at 8th, 7 at 10th, 8 at 11th, 9 at 13th, 10 at 14th, 11 at 16th, 12 at 19th, 13 at 20th; on gaining a level you may swap one known spell for another of a level you have slots for. Slots (1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 3rd 2/0/0/0, 4th to 6th 3/0/0/0, 7th to 9th 4/2/0/0, 10th to 12th 4/3/0/0, 13th to 15th 4/3/2/0, 16th to 18th 4/3/3/0, 19th to 20th 4/3/3/1.

feature:feature:architect-of-ruin-spell-.description: Cantrips: chill touch, dancing lights, fire bolt, hellfire, message, minor illusion, ray of frost, shocking grasp, thaumaturgy, vengeful blade, vicious mockery. 1st: bane, burning hands, charm person, color spray, command, detect magic, disguise self, Hell's lash, hellish rebuke, shield, shield of faith, silent image. 2nd: arcanist's magic aura, augury, blur, darkness, detect thoughts, enthrall, heat metal, hold person, infernal challenge, invisibility, lesser restoration, mirror image, ray of enfeeblement, scorching ray, silence, suggestion. 3rd: bestow curse, dispel magic, fear, fly, haste, major image, mote of Hell, phantom steed, remove curse, revivify, slow. 4th: aura of desecration, banishment, blight, compulsion, death ward, dimension door, dominate beast, greater invisibility, hallucinatory terrain, locate creature, maligned weapon, phantasmal killer, wall of death.

feature:feature:architect-of-ruin:invoke.description: You gain two options. Enervating Spell: when an illrigger spell of 1st level or higher damages a creature, expend a seal (no action) to make it vulnerable to that spell's damage, suppressing any resistance or immunity it has to it. Spellblade: as an action, make a melee weapon attack and also cast a known illrigger spell whose casting time is one action.

feature:feature:hellish-versatility.description: Once on each of your turns, you can replace one Extra Attack attack with casting one of your illrigger cantrips.

feature:feature:asmodeus-s-interdiction.description: You always know these extra interdict boons, which don't count against your boons known. Axiomatic Seals (7th, passive): when you burn seals for damage, add your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to each seal's damage roll. Spellbreaker (13th): when an interdicted creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell, use your reaction to burn one or more of its seals for no damage and cast counterspell on it without a slot, at a level 1 higher per seal beyond the first. Hell Mage (18th, passive): when you or an ally within 30 feet succeeds on a save against an enemy's spell or magical effect, you can place up to your proficiency bonus in seals on that enemy at once.

feature:feature:submit.description: When you cast a known illrigger spell, you can burn two seals on an interdicted creature (no action) to give it disadvantage on its save against that spell.

feature:feature:vile-transmogrification.description: As a bonus action, either expend a spell slot to regain seals equal to its level, or expend seals to regain a spell slot whose level is one-third the seals spent (six seals for a 2nd-level slot). Each option is usable once per long rest.

feature:feature:moloch-s-blessing.description: Gain proficiency in Persuasion or Deception; if already proficient in the chosen skill, double your proficiency bonus for its checks. Forked Tongue gives one more language (three at 3rd level, four at 9th), and when you speak a language from it, you have advantage on Charisma checks to influence creatures who hear and understand you.

feature:feature:charm-enemy.description: When you use your bonus action to place a seal on a Humanoid, it must succeed on a Charisma save against your interdict save DC or be charmed by you, seeing you as a friendly acquaintance, for 1 hour or until you or your companions harm it; it knows afterward that you charmed it. With the same bonus action you can burn seals on other interdicted Humanoids within 30 feet, and each must also save after taking the seal damage or be charmed the same way. Uses equal your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), regained on a long rest.

feature:feature:hellspeaker:invoke-hell.description: You gain two options. Honey-Sweet Blades: give yourself advantage on a weapon attack against an interdicted creature (no action), and a hit becomes a critical hit. Turncoat: as an action, up to your proficiency bonus in enemies within 60 feet that can hear you each make a Charisma save (interdict save DC) or use their reaction to make a weapon attack against one target you pick, which can't be themselves.

feature:feature:moloch-s-interdiction.description: You always know these extra interdict boons, which don't count against your boons known. Red Cant (7th): when you make a Charisma check, expend a seal to treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Slippery Ploy (13th): when a creature targets you with an attack, spell, or other magical effect, use your reaction to place a seal on it; it makes a Charisma save (interdict save DC) or must pick a new target or lose the attack or effect. Incontrovertible (18th, passive): interdicted creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves.

feature:feature:intransigent.description: While you are conscious, you and any creatures you choose within 10 feet are immune to being charmed.

feature:feature:let-s-make-a-deal.description: As a bonus action, offer a deal to a willing ally within 60 feet that can hear you. Once in the next 10 minutes it can take advantage plus a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus on one attack roll or save; success grants temporary hit points equal to your illrigger level, while failure gives it disadvantage on its next attack roll or save that can't be offset by advantage. A creature can hold only one deal at a time. Uses equal your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest.

feature:feature:quid-pro-quo.description: As an action, a creature you can see within 30 feet makes a Charisma save or is banished to Hell for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and returning to the nearest unoccupied space to where it left; a creature that succeeds is immune for 24 hours. While it is gone, a devil jurist (Flee, Mortals!) or horned devil appears in its place as your obedient ally until the banishment ends. After a successful banishment, you can't use this again until you finish a long rest.

feature:feature:devastator.description: As an action, make a weapon attack and choose up to your proficiency bonus in willing creatures you can see within 30 feet; each can use its reaction to make a weapon attack or cast a damaging cantrip with a 1-action casting time. Usable once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:painkiller:invoke-hell.description: You gain two options. Grand Strategist: with no action, up to your proficiency bonus in creatures within 60 feet that can hear you each immediately move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Punishment: when an attack damages you, use your reaction to have the attacker make a Wisdom save (interdict save DC), taking necrotic damage equal to the damage it dealt you on a failure or half as much on a success.

feature:feature:dispater-s-interdiction.description: You always know these extra interdict boons, which don't count against your boons known. Telekinetic Seal (7th): when a creature you can see moves within 5 feet of you, use your reaction to place a seal on it; it must succeed on a Wisdom save (interdict save DC) or be pushed 15 feet away or knocked prone, your choice. By the Throat (13th): when you use a bonus action to place or move a seal onto a creature no more than one size larger than you, it makes a Wisdom save (interdict save DC) or is restrained until the end of its next turn. Dispater's Supremacy (18th, passive): your attacks against interdicted creatures crit on 18 to 20.

feature:feature:you-die-on-my-command.description: When an ally within 30 feet who can hear you drops to 0 hit points without dying outright, use your reaction to have it drop to 1 hit point instead. Usable once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:deathstrike.description: When you hit an interdicted creature with a melee weapon attack, use your reaction to burn one of its seals and make the hit a critical hit, also doubling the burned seal's damage dice. Uses equal your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest.

feature:feature:marked-for-death.description: Your first attack against an interdicted creature on each of your turns has advantage.

feature:feature:strike-from-the-dark.description: Once per turn, when you hit an interdicted creature with a melee weapon attack made with advantage, add damage equal to a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus, plus 1d4 more if the target is in dim light or darkness.

feature:feature:shadowmaster:invoke-hell.description: You gain two options. Master of Disguise: as an action, cast disguise self without a spell slot. No Escape: as a bonus action, a creature you can see within 30 feet makes a Charisma save (interdict save DC), with disadvantage if it is in dim light or darkness; on a failure its speed is halved and it can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you, ending if you are incapacitated or die or it ends up more than 30 feet away.

feature:feature:belial-s-interdiction.description: You always know these extra interdict boons, which don't count against your boons known. Veil of Lies (7th): as a bonus action, expend a seal to become invisible for 10 minutes or until you attack or cast a spell. Hell's Assassin (13th, passive): reroll any 1 or 2 on seal damage dice or weapon damage dice against interdicted creatures, keeping the new roll. Dark Malediction (18th, passive): interdicted creatures emit darkness in a 10-foot radius that mundane light can't brighten but darkvision sees through; where it overlaps light made by magic or psionics, that light wins.

feature:feature:umbral-killer.description: Gain 60 feet of darkvision (or add 60 feet to existing darkvision), +10 feet of speed, and advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:doomed-to-the-shadows.description: Strike from the Dark now deals a number of d8s equal to your proficiency bonus, plus 2d8 (instead of 1d4) if the target is in dim light or darkness. When you deal Strike from the Dark damage, you can use your reaction to burn a seal on the target to blind it for 1 minute instead of dealing that seal's damage.

feature:feature:roar-of-defiance.description: When you use your bonus action to start raging, you can also roar: until the start of your next turn, chosen creatures within 30 feet that can hear you have disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you. For the rest of the rage, when a creature within 5 feet that heard the roar damages you, you can use your reaction to force a Constitution save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier); on a failure it takes 1d6 thunder damage (2d6 at 10th level). Each creature can take this damage from you only once.

feature:feature:running-leap.description: While raging, your standing long jump covers a number of feet equal to your Strength score, and with a 10-foot running start it covers twice your Strength score.

feature:feature:lion-s-glory.description: When you start raging, pick allies that can see you, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Until the rage ends, each picked ally adds your current Rage Damage bonus to the damage of its melee weapon attacks. Usable once per long rest.

feature:feature:resonant-bellow.description: As a bonus action, you roar to end the frightened condition on yourself and on any creatures you choose within 60 feet that can hear you. Every creature freed this way gains temporary hit points equal to 1d12 + your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), lasting 1 hour. Usable once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:victorious-roar.description: If you hit with two or more attacks in one turn, you can use a bonus action to target one creature you can see within 30 feet with a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier). On a failure it takes psychic damage equal to your barbarian level and is frightened until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half and isn't frightened.

feature:feature:hellish-aspect.description: Entering a rage gives you cosmetic fiendish traits (you remain your own creature type). While raging, you resist fire damage, and the first creature you hit with a weapon attack on each of your turns takes an extra 1d6 fire damage (2d6 at 10th level).

feature:feature:hell-s-vengeance.description: While you are raging, if an ally you can see within 60 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to deal fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus to the creature that dealt it.

feature:feature:hellfire-shield.description: When you start raging, you can wreath yourself in flame as the fire shield spell, but only the warm shield option, and it lasts until the rage ends. Usable once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:devilish-essence.description: While raging, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. When a spell damages you during your rage, you can use your reaction to gain temporary hit points equal to your barbarian level.

feature:feature:totem-dragon.description: Choose a dragon to emulate, which sets your damage type: black or copper (acid), blue or bronze (lightning), brass, gold, or red (fire), green (poison), silver or white (cold). You can speak and read Draconic and have resistance to that damage type.

feature:feature:wyrm-teeth.description: While raging, you can use a bonus action to bite one creature you can see within 5 feet; you are proficient with this bite. A hit deals 1d8 + your Strength modifier piercing damage plus extra damage of your totem dragon's type equal to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:legendary-might.description: When you fail a saving throw, you can turn it into a success. Once per long rest, or twice per long rest once you reach 14th level.

feature:feature:aspect-of-the-dragon.description: Each time you start raging, pick one aspect. Dragon Heart: gain 1d12 + your barbarian level temporary hit points (this aspect then needs a short or long rest before you can pick it again). Dragon Hide: +2 to AC. Dragon Sight: blindsight 60 feet. Dragon Wings: flying speed 30 feet, but not while wearing armor unless it is built to allow wings, and unadapted clothing may be ruined.

feature:feature:wyrm-lungs.description: While raging, you can use an action to breathe a 60-foot cone; creatures inside make a Dexterity save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier), taking 12d8 damage of your totem dragon's type on a failure or half on a success. Usable once per long rest.

feature:feature:black-powder-domain-spel.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 1 fog cloud, thunderwave; 3 heat metal, shatter; 5 fireball, stinking cloud; 7 confusion, wall of fire; 9 cloudkill, deadly salvo (a Tome of Heroes spell).

feature:feature:black-powder-domain:bonu.description: You gain proficiency with your choice of alchemist's supplies or gunsmith's tools, and with all simple and martial weapons that have the gunpowder property. A thrown item with the gunpowder property, such as a bomb, isn't treated as an improvised weapon for you.

feature:feature:gunpowder-blessing.description: As an action, touch a weapon a willing creature is holding to give it the gunpowder weapon property for 1 minute, or until you use this feature again.

feature:feature:channel-divinity-imbue-r.description: As an action with your holy symbol, choose one: apply your Gunpowder Blessing for 1 minute to one weapon carried by each creature you choose within 30 feet; or curse up to your proficiency bonus in gunpowder weapons within 30 feet so that for 1 minute they can't burst (remove curse cast on a weapon restores it).

feature:feature:explosive-infusion.description: As a bonus action, spend a 1st-level spell slot to charge a nonmagical, one-handed object you hold or carry (a vial, a ball bearing) for 1 minute; before it expires, use an action to throw it at a point within 20 feet, where creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Higher slots add 1d6 per level above 1st, the damage can burst as a gunpowder weapon (counting as one effect no matter how many targets), and spending a Channel Divinity as part of the throw widens the area to 20 feet. If not thrown in time, the charge simply fades.

feature:feature:black-powder-domain:divi.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 fire damage (2d8 at 14th level).

feature:feature:greater-explosive-infusi.description: Explosive Infusion can now charge a nonmagical object that isn't worn or carried and fits in a 5-foot cube, for 10 minutes. You can detonate it as an action while within 100 feet, as a reaction to a trigger you define (such as a creature coming within 20 feet), or on a timer of up to 10 minutes (no range limit); creatures within 20 feet of it make the save. Spending a Channel Divinity when you charge it gives creatures disadvantage on that save, and before detonation you can touch it as an action to defuse it and regain the spell slot.

feature:feature:circle-of-bees:circle-sp.description: You learn the true strike cantrip. Always prepared at Druid levels (not counted against prepared spells, and treated as druid spells): 3 blur, bombardment of stings (a Tome of Heroes spell); 5 fly, haste; 7 giant insect, locate creature; 9 insect plague, telepathic bond.

feature:feature:bee-bond.description: You gain proficiency in Acrobatics or Stealth (your choice), and you can speak and understand Bee Dance; bees won't attack you even under magical compulsion. When a beast other than a bee attacks you with a weapon that deals poison damage, it must pass a Charisma save against your spell save DC or have disadvantage on attacks against you until the start of its next turn.

feature:feature:bee-stinger.description: As an action, spend one use of Wild Shape to grow a stinger for hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down) or until you Wild Shape again. Your unarmed strikes then use Wisdom for the attack and deal 1d4 + Wisdom modifier piercing plus poison damage equal to half your proficiency bonus. From 6th level these strikes count as magical and the poison damage equals your full proficiency bonus; the piercing die becomes 1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, and 1d10 at 14th level.

feature:feature:bumblebee-rush.description: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action, and when you do, attack rolls against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

feature:feature:hive-mind.description: When you cast telepathic bond, linked creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks if any linked creature is proficient in a skill that applies. If one linked creature succeeds on a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or a Wisdom (Insight) check, all of them succeed. A linked creature attacking has advantage if another linked creature that can see it spends its reaction to help.

feature:feature:mantle-of-bees.description: As an action, cloak yourself in bees for 1 hour (dismiss anytime, no action): +2 AC and advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee weapon makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC, taking 1d8 piercing plus 1d8 poison damage and being poisoned until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half damage and no poison on a success. While the mantle lasts, you can use an action to send the swarm to a 10-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet: Constitution save, 4d6 piercing plus 4d6 poison damage and poisoned for 1 minute on a failure, half and not poisoned on a success, after which the mantle ends. Once per short or long rest, or recreate it by expending a spell slot of 5th level or higher.

feature:feature:unarmed-warrior.description: While you wear no heavy armor and wield no weapons or shield, your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage (d8 at 10th level, d10 at 18th level), and when you take the Attack action to make unarmed strikes you can make one more unarmed strike as a bonus action.

feature:feature:resilient-fighter.description: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum 1) to death saving throws. You can use Second Wind a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a short or long rest.

feature:feature:uncanny-fortitude.description: When damage that isn't from a critical hit drops you to 0 hit points, you can make a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage taken) to drop to 1 hit point instead; usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Your Second Wind now restores 1d10 + your fighter level + your Constitution modifier hit points.

feature:feature:debilitating-blow.description: If you hit the same target with two unarmed strikes in one turn, you can use a bonus action to force a Constitution save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier). On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made before the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:withstand-death.description: When you drop to 0 hit points, you can use Second Wind as a reaction if you have uses left, either before or after Uncanny Fortitude resolves. A natural 1 on a death saving throw counts as only one failure.

feature:feature:opportunistic-brawler.description: You have advantage on initiative rolls. When a creature you can see enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can make an opportunity attack against it with an unarmed strike, and you get reactions each turn equal to your proficiency bonus, usable only for opportunity attacks.

feature:feature:archery-training.description: Shortbows and longbows are monk weapons for you, and having a hostile creature within 5 feet doesn't give you disadvantage on ranged attacks with them. The bonus action unarmed strike from Martial Arts or Flurry of Blows can deal piercing damage instead.

feature:feature:flurry-of-deflection.description: You gain extra reactions equal to your proficiency bonus, usable only for Deflect Missiles. If you reduce the missile's damage to 0 and it is bow ammunition, you can spend 1 ki point to fire it back with your shortbow or longbow. From 9th level, Deflect Missiles reduces the damage by 2d10 + Dexterity modifier + monk level.

feature:feature:needle-eye-of-insight.description: Your shortbow and longbow attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage. When you make a ranged attack with one, you can spend 1 ki point so your ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:steel-rain-blossom.description: While wielding a shortbow or longbow, use an action to target a point you can see within the weapon's normal range: each creature within 15 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes piercing damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die (total cover means automatic success). Spend up to 3 ki points to add one Martial Arts die each. You can also replace the bonus action unarmed strike of Martial Arts or Flurry of Blows with a shortbow or longbow ranged attack.

feature:feature:improbable-shot.description: When using Needle Eye of Insight, spend 3 ki points to ignore all cover, even solid barriers, against a target you have seen in the past minute that is within normal range. Alternatively, once per long rest, spend 5 ki points to hit a target you have seen within the past minute that is now on another plane or in an extradimensional space.

feature:feature:soulspy:spellcasting.description: You cast cleric spells using Wisdom (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier, attack bonus proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier) and regain slots on a long rest. You know 3 cleric cantrips (4 at 10th level) and 3 cleric spells of 1st level at 3rd, rising per the Soulspy Spellcasting table to 13 at 20th, with slots up to 4th level on the third-caster track (2 first-level slots at 3rd; 2nd-level slots from 7th, 3rd-level from 13th, a 4th-level slot at 19th). Spells must be abjuration or necromancy except the ones learned at 3rd (one of the initial three), 8th, 14th, and 20th, and on level up you may swap one known spell under the same rule.

feature:feature:soulspy:bonus-proficienc.description: You gain proficiency in Religion if you lack it.

feature:feature:divine-symbol.description: As an action, create an intangible, invulnerable Tiny holy symbol that floats within 5 feet for 1 minute (ends early if you die or dismiss it). It is a spellcasting focus for your cleric spells; it sheds bright light 10 feet and dim light another 10 feet, which you can toggle as a bonus action (snuffing one nonmagical light within 10 feet when you douse it); and as a bonus action it can become thieves' tools (losing its other functions) or change back. When created and as an action on each of your turns, it can fire at a creature within 30 feet with a ranged spell attack for 1d8 radiant or necrotic damage, rising to 2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, and 4d8 at 17th level.

feature:feature:sacred-stealth.description: You can apply Sneak Attack to a creature hit by your Divine Symbol if an ally that isn't incapacitated is within 5 feet of the target and you lack disadvantage. Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) per short or long rest.

feature:feature:touching-the-soul.description: Your touch-range cleric spells can be delivered through your Divine Symbol to a creature you can see within 30 feet, after which the symbol vanishes. Sacred Stealth can't apply to spells delivered this way.

feature:feature:life-thief.description: When your Divine Symbol attack or a cleric spell or cantrip deals radiant or necrotic damage, a friendly creature you can see within 30 feet (you included) regains hit points equal to half that damage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:gun-savant.description: You gain proficiency with simple firearms, the musket, and your choice of alchemist's supplies or gunsmith's tools. You can use Intelligence instead of Dexterity for firearm attack and damage rolls, and a firearm can serve as your spellcasting focus.

feature:feature:arcane-arms.description: As an action with a gun in hand, invoke one effect (silent unless noted), a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Arcane Dusting: 15-foot cone makes magical or spell-affected creatures and objects glow with 5-foot dim light until the end of your next turn. Flare: a light rising up to 100 feet that hovers then drifts down over the next round, visible 1 mile by day or 5 at night, or fired up to 50 feet in another direction so creatures within 5 feet of its path pass a Dexterity save against your spell save DC or have disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks for 1 minute. Lockbuster: an attack roll against a lock in normal range that destroys it if it meets the lock's pick DC (advantage if magically protected). Smokescreen: heavily obscuring 10-foot-radius sphere (20 feet at 6th level) centered on you until the end of your next turn or until a 10 mph or stronger wind clears it. Starter's Gun: chosen allies within 30 feet gain +10 feet of speed until the start of your next turn (and can Dash as a bonus action from 10th level). Tracer Shot: a firearm attack against a creature within 60 feet that, on a hit, deals normal damage and outlines it as faerie fire until the start of your next turn (1 minute from 10th level).

feature:feature:spell-shot.description: When you cast a spell that uses a melee spell attack, you can fire it through your firearm using the firearm's normal range, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Your firearm attacks also count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage.

feature:feature:improved-arcane-arms.description: Arcane Arms gains new options, and you can spend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to regain uses equal to half the slot's level. False Shot: a fake shot at a target within 30 feet, Wisdom save against your spell save DC or paralyzed with fear until the start of your next turn, frightened of you instead on a success. Invigorating Burst: you and chosen creatures within 20 feet gain 2d4 temporary hit points for 1 hour. Shot in the Arm: as a bonus action, a friendly creature within 60 feet loses one level of exhaustion, or if it has none gains 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour and advantage on its next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. Warning Shot: chosen creatures you can see within 30 feet become indifferent to creatures of your choice for 1 minute, ending early if a target is attacked, harmed by a spell, sees an ally harmed, or you invoke another Arcane Arms effect.

feature:feature:hand-cannon.description: When you make a ranged attack roll with a firearm, you can spend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to add the slot's level to the attack roll. On a hit, a 30-foot by 5-foot line extends directly away from you starting at the target; creatures in it make a Dexterity save against your spell save DC, taking 1d6 force damage per slot level on a failure or half on a success. This damage can burst as a gunpowder weapon, counted as a single effect.

feature:feature:webbing.description: As a bonus action, shoot a strand of web up to 60 feet that lasts 1 minute: use it as a rope, pull an unattended object, shut a door, or grab a small object under 10 pounds. Aim it at a point you can see within 60 feet to haul yourself there in a straight line (uses movement, provokes opportunity attacks as normal). As a reaction when falling, you can pull yourself up to 10 feet in any direction or anchor a web rope up to 60 feet long to a point of your choice.

feature:feature:venomous-strike.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can make the Sneak Attack dice d8s that deal poison damage.

feature:feature:wall-crawling.description: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can move along walls and upside down on ceilings with your hands free. While on a ceiling, you can hide from creatures at least 10 feet below you even without cover.

feature:feature:web-walker.description: You can cast web at will with no spell slot or components, with a save DC of 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus. Movement restrictions from webbing don't affect you.

feature:feature:paralytic-venom.description: When Venomous Strike deals poison Sneak Attack damage, you can force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus); on a failure the target is paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:future-you-patron:expand.description: Added to the warlock list for you, by spell level: 1st accelerate/decelerate, instant replay; 2nd delay, recall; 3rd haste, protection from energy; 4th death ward, dire warning; 5th evasiveness, legend lore (all but haste, protection from energy, death ward, and legend lore are new spells from this book).

feature:feature:future-you-quirks.description: You gain one roleplaying trait from the subclass's d6 quirk table; it has no mechanical effect.

feature:feature:it-happened-like-this.description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, the GM secretly rolls a d20 and a d4 and tells you the d20 result, unless the d4 shows 4, in which case you are told a random number from 1 to 20 instead. Once, before rolling, you can replace one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw with the number you were told; if it was false, the GM reveals that after you use it.

feature:feature:i-could-do-with-fewer-sc.description: When a creature you can see attacks you, you can use your reaction to gain +10 AC against that attack. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:expect-an-ambush.description: You can't be surprised while conscious, and you have advantage on initiative rolls.

feature:feature:grandfather-paradox.description: As an action, target a creature that can hear you with an Intelligence save against your warlock spell save DC; on a failure it is stunned for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:rite-of-the-dawn.description: You learn this extra crimson rite, which deals radiant damage. While it is active the weapon sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius, you resist necrotic damage, and your hits against undead with that weapon add one more hemocraft die of rite damage.

feature:feature:curse-specialist.description: You gain one additional use of Blood Maledict, and your blood curses can affect creatures that have no blood.

feature:feature:aether-walk.description: At the start of your turn, if you aren't incapacitated, you can slip partly into the Ethereal for rounds equal to your Hemocraft modifier (minimum 1): you move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain and can see and affect things on the Ethereal Plane. Ending a turn inside an object deals 1d10 force damage; if the effect ends while you are inside one, you shunt to the nearest unoccupied space and take force damage equal to twice the feet moved. Once per short or long rest, twice starting at 15th level.

feature:feature:brand-of-sundering.description: Your hits with a crimson-rite weapon add one more hemocraft die of rite damage. A branded creature with Incorporeal Movement or a similar trait can't pass through creatures or objects while the brand lasts.

feature:feature:blood-curse-of-the-exorc.description: You learn this curse; it doesn't count against curses known. Bonus action: one creature you can see within 30 feet that is charmed, frightened, or possessed is freed of those effects. Amplify: whatever charmed, frightened, or possessed it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must pass a Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:rite-revival.description: If you have at least one active crimson rite and drop to 0 hit points without being killed outright, you can end all your active rites to stay at 1 hit point instead.

feature:feature:heightened-senses.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.

feature:feature:hybrid-transformation.description: As a bonus action, take a hybrid form for up to 1 hour; you can still speak, use equipment, and wear armor. Revert as a bonus action, and you revert automatically if you fall unconscious or die. Once per short or long rest. This replaces the normal lycanthropy rules.

feature:feature:hybrid-form-benefits.description: Feral Might: advantage on Strength checks and saves, and +1 to melee damage rolls (+2 at 11th level, +3 at 18th). Resilient Hide: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered, plus +1 AC while not in heavy armor. Predatory Strikes: your unarmed strikes count as one weapon for Crimson Rite, can use Dexterity for attack and damage, and deal 1d6 bludgeoning or slashing (1d8 at 11th level); after you make an unarmed strike with the Attack action, you can make another as a bonus action. Bloodlust: if you begin your turn below half your hit point maximum, make a DC 8 Wisdom save (automatic failure if you are concentrating or can't concentrate, as while raging); on a failure you move straight at the nearest creature (random if tied) and take the Attack action against it, optionally with Extra Attack, then regain control.

feature:feature:stalker-s-prowess.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet, your long jump by 10 feet, and your high jump by 3 feet. In hybrid form you gain Improved Predatory Strikes: +1 to unarmed strike attack rolls (+2 at 11th level, +3 at 18th), and with a crimson rite active on them your unarmed strikes count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

feature:feature:advanced-transformation.description: Hybrid Transformation can be used twice per short or long rest. Your hybrid form gains Lycan Regeneration: at the start of each turn, if you have at least 1 hit point but less than half your maximum, regain 1 + your Constitution modifier hit points (minimum 1), applied before any bloodlust save.

feature:feature:brand-of-the-voracious.description: In hybrid form you have advantage on bloodlust saves and on attack rolls against a creature you have branded.

feature:feature:hybrid-transformation-ma.description: Hybrid Transformation has unlimited uses and lasts until you revert, fall unconscious, or die.

feature:feature:blood-curse-of-the-howl.description: You learn this curse; it doesn't count against curses known. Action: every creature within 30 feet that can hear you (except any you choose that you can see) makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn, and is also stunned while frightened this way if it failed by 5 or more. A creature that succeeds is immune to this curse for 24 hours. Amplify: range becomes 60 feet.

feature:feature:mutagencraft.description: When you finish a short or long rest you can brew mutagens that only work on you and go inert if unused by the end of your next short or long rest. Drinking one is a bonus action; its effect and side effect last until your next short or long rest unless noted, and you can use an action to purge all active mutagens. Mutagens per rest / formulas known: 1/4 at 3rd level, 2/5 at 7th, 2/6 at 11th, 3/7 at 15th, 3/8 at 18th. Whenever you learn a formula, you may also swap one you know.

feature:feature:mutagen-formulas.description: A mutagen with a level listed can be learned at that level. Aether (11th level): 20-foot flying speed for 1 hour; disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks. Alluring: advantage on Charisma checks; disadvantage on initiative. Celerity: Dexterity and its maximum rise by 3 (4 at 11th level, 5 at 18th); disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Conversant: advantage on Intelligence checks; disadvantage on Wisdom checks. Cruelty (11th level): after taking the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action; disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves. Deftness: advantage on Dexterity checks; disadvantage on Wisdom checks. Embers: fire resistance, cold vulnerability. Gelid: cold resistance, fire vulnerability. Impermeable: piercing resistance, slashing vulnerability. Mobility: immune to grappled and restrained (and paralyzed from 11th level); disadvantage on Strength checks. Nighteye: darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet if you have it); disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks when you, your target, or what you are looking at is in direct sunlight. Percipient: advantage on Wisdom checks; disadvantage on Charisma checks. Potency: Strength and its maximum rise by 3 (4 at 11th, 5 at 18th); disadvantage on Dexterity saves. Precision (11th level): weapon attacks crit on 19 or 20; disadvantage on Strength saves. Rapidity: speed +10 feet (+5 more at 15th level); disadvantage on Intelligence checks. Reconstruction (7th level): for 1 hour, at the start of each turn with at least 1 but under half your maximum hit points, regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus; speed reduced by 10 feet. Sagacity: Intelligence and its maximum rise by 3 (4 at 11th, 5 at 18th); disadvantage on Charisma saves. Shielded: slashing resistance, bludgeoning vulnerability. Unbreakable: bludgeoning resistance, piercing vulnerability. Vermillion: one extra Blood Maledict use; disadvantage on death saves.

feature:feature:strange-metabolism.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can suppress one active mutagen's side effect for 1 minute.

feature:feature:brand-of-axiom.description: Branding a creature ends any illusion or invisibility on it, and it can't benefit from either while branded. If it is in an alternate form (polymorph, Change Shape, Shapechanger, Wild Shape, and the like), it must pass a Wisdom save or revert to its true form and be stunned until the end of your next turn. Any later attempt by a branded creature to change form requires a Wisdom save; on a failure the attempt fails and it is stunned until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:blood-curse-of-corrosion.description: You learn this curse; it doesn't count against curses known. Bonus action: one creature within 30 feet is poisoned, repeating a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end it. Amplify: it takes 4d6 necrotic damage when cursed and again on each failed save to end the curse.

feature:feature:exalted-mutation.description: As a bonus action, end one active mutagen and its side effect and immediately gain the effect of another mutagen whose formula you know. Uses equal your Hemocraft modifier (minimum 1), regained on a long rest.

feature:feature:order-of-the-profane-sou.description: Bind yourself to a patron: the Archfey, the Fiend, the Great Old One, the Undying, the Celestial, the Hexblade, the Fathomless, the Genie, or the Undead. Your choice shapes Rite Focus, Revealed Arcana, and Unsealed Arcana.

You cast warlock spells using your Hemocraft ability (spell save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Hemocraft modifier; spell attack proficiency bonus + Hemocraft modifier). Cantrips known: 2, rising to 3 at 10th level. Spells known (blood hunter level: count): 3rd 2, 5th 3, 7th 4, 9th 5, 11th 6, 13th 7, 15th 8, 17th 9, 19th 10, 20th 11, chosen from the warlock list at or below your slot level, and you may swap one when you gain a level. Pact slots, all of one level and regained on a short or long rest: one 1st-level slot at 3rd to 5th, two 1st-level slots at 6th, two 2nd-level at 7th to 12th, two 3rd-level at 13th to 18th, two 4th-level at 19th and 20th. With warlock levels, add one-third of your blood hunter levels (rounded down) to your warlock level for slots.

feature:feature:rite-focus.description: While a crimson rite is active, your weapon serves as your warlock spellcasting focus and you gain a patron benefit. Archfey: a creature you damage with the rite weapon gives off a faint glow and gets no benefit from cover or invisibility until the end of your next turn. Celestial: bonus action, spend a Blood Maledict use to heal a creature you can see within 60 feet for one hemocraft die + your Hemocraft modifier (minimum +1). Fathomless: you can breathe underwater, and once per turn a rite-weapon hit can cut the target's speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Fiend: with Rite of the Flame, reroll 1s and 2s on rite damage dice, keeping either result. Genie: bonus action, spend a Blood Maledict use for a 30-foot flying speed for rounds equal to your Hemocraft modifier (minimum 1). Great Old One: when you score a critical hit, the target and any creatures you choose within 10 feet of it are frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Hexblade: after a blood curse affects a creature, your next hit on it while the curse lasts adds damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Undead: reaction to halve necrotic damage you take, and your look reflects your patron while a rite is active. Undying: when you drop a hostile creature of at least mild threat (DM's call) to 0 hit points, regain hit points equal to one hemocraft die roll.

feature:feature:mystic-frenzy.description: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

feature:feature:revealed-arcana.description: Once per long rest, cast a patron spell using a pact slot: Archfey blur, Celestial lesser restoration, Fathomless gust of wind, Fiend scorching ray, Genie phantasmal force, Great Old One detect thoughts, Hexblade branding smite, Undead blindness/deafness, Undying silence.

feature:feature:brand-of-the-sapping-sca.description: Creatures you have branded have disadvantage on saving throws against your warlock spells.

feature:feature:unsealed-arcana.description: Once per long rest, cast a patron spell without spending a slot: Archfey slow, Celestial revivify, Fathomless lightning bolt, Fiend fireball, Genie protection from energy, Great Old One haste, Hexblade blink, Undead speak with dead, Undying bestow curse.

feature:feature:blood-curse-of-the-soul-.description: You learn this curse; it doesn't count against curses known. Reaction when a creature other than a construct or undead drops to 0 hit points within 30 feet: until the end of your next turn your attacks have advantage and you resist all damage. Amplify: you also regain one expended warlock spell slot; you can amplify this curse only once per long rest.

feature:feature:exsanguinate.description: When you burn one or more seals on a creature that isn't a construct or undead, you can pick an ally you can see within 30 feet; that ally gains temporary hit points equal to the damage those seals dealt.

feature:feature:sutekh-s-blessing.description: You become proficient in Religion. As an action, until the end of your next turn you sense the distance, direction, and creature type of every creature with blood within 120 feet, even unseen; 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin lead sheet, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks it. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

feature:feature:sanguine-knight:invoke-h.description: You gain two Invoke Hell options. Embolden Allies: as a bonus action, split healing equal to five times your illrigger level among yourself and any creatures within 30 feet of you. Vitalize: with no action required, chosen creatures within 30 feet of you add your proficiency bonus to ability checks for 1 minute.

feature:feature:sutekh-s-interdiction.description: You automatically learn these interdict boons at the listed illrigger levels; they are always known and don't count toward your boons known. Foul Interchange (7th level): as an action, expend a seal to end one condition (blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or poisoned) on a creature you can see within 30 feet; a different creature you can see within 60 feet must pass a Constitution save or gain that condition until the end of your next turn (if it is immune, the original creature is still cured). Dazed means a creature can only move, take an action, or take a bonus action on its turn, and becoming dazed on its own turn ends that turn. Sanguine Gift (13th level): when a creature you can see within 30 feet regains hit points, expend a seal (no action) to add hit points equal to your illrigger level. Blood for Blood (18th level, passive): whenever an interdicted creature damages one of your allies, the interdicted creature takes necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:bloodstroke.description: When a melee attack hits an ally who has temporary hit points from your Exsanguinate, the attacker takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to your illrigger level.

feature:feature:haemal-exchange.description: When an interdicted creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll or saving throw, you can use your reaction to burn one of its seals: it subtracts a d8 roll from that result, and an ally within 30 feet adds a d8 roll to their next attack roll or saving throw.

feature:feature:artifact-historian.description: Identify is added to your grimoire, and you cast it without material components.

feature:feature:trinkets.description: Each trinket use casts a spell once with no spell slot or components. Hateful Arrowhead: ray of enfeeblement or scorching ray. Mirrored Prism: blur or mirror image, self only. Razortooth Bandages: cure wounds or inflict wounds, cast at the slot level shown in your Ritual Level column.

feature:feature:relics.description: Once per short or long rest, use one relic to cast a spell with no spell slot or components. Antediluvian Dynamo: fireball or lightning bolt. Lich's Deathmask: counterspell or dispel magic. Mortal Coil: animate dead or revivify; casting animate dead this way turns all undead raised by your earlier castings of that spell back into corpses.

feature:feature:magic-item-collection.description: You can produce one item from an extradimensional vault, changing the choice after each long rest: carpet of flying, cloak of the bat, flame tongue, gauntlets of ogre power, instant fortress, ring of regeneration, ring of telekinesis, sun blade, or wand of wonder.

feature:feature:phylactery.description: You gain a phylactery that is always attuned to you without counting against your attunement limit. It holds 5 charges and recovers 1d4 + 1 each dawn. 1 charge: cast false life at 2nd level with no slot or components. 1 charge: as a bonus action, regain one spent trinket use. 2 charges: as a reaction when dropped to 0 hit points but not killed outright, drop to 1 instead. 3 charges: make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach for 5d6 necrotic damage, regaining hit points equal to the damage dealt.

feature:feature:trinket.description: Archaic Scroll: you can cast a ritual with Rushed Incantation without spending one of its uses (this spends a trinket use).

feature:feature:thesis.description: Choose a thesis; its spells are added to your grimoire once you gain access to them and count as investigator spells even if absent from the Investigator Spells list. As an action, you can spend a Rushed Incantation use to cast a thesis spell. Corpus: 1st jump, longstrider; 2nd alter self, heat metal; 3rd gaseous form, meld into stone. Ignis: 1st burning hands, thunderwave; 2nd gust of wind, scorching ray; 3rd call lightning, wind wall. Mortis: 1st bane, false life; 2nd blindness/deafness, darkness; 3rd revivify, vampiric touch. Regis: 1st charm person, hideous laughter; 2nd enthrall, suggestion; 3rd dispel magic, hypnotic pattern.

feature:feature:erudite-spell.description: When you cast a spell that calls for a saving throw, one target makes its first save against it with disadvantage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:encyclopedic-expertise.description: Whenever you see a spell cast or study a magical effect, you identify the spell, the magic item, or the monster responsible, unless it is unique or otherwise unrecorded in arcane texts.

feature:feature:eidetic-memory.description: Any ritual you watch being cast can be copied into your grimoire. Also, once per long rest, when you see a spell of 5th level or lower with a casting time of 1 action cast within the last minute, you can use your action and spend a Rushed Incantation use to cast it yourself with no spell slot; it can't have costly or consumed material components.

feature:feature:investigator-s-hunch.description: After at least 10 minutes sorting documents and clues, you make Intelligence checks about them with advantage.

feature:feature:detective:trinkets.description: Each trinket use, as a bonus action, casts a spell once with no spell slot or components. Fogstone Periapt: misty step. Glass Medallion: invisibility, self only. Skeleton's Key: knock.

feature:feature:predictive-intuition.description: As a bonus action, study a creature you can see within 30 feet. Before the start of your next turn, either add 1d4 to your next attack roll against it or subtract 1d4 from its next attack roll against you.

feature:feature:interrogator-s-instinct.description: You know whether a creature you hear speaking is charmed, possessed, or otherwise magically forced to speak, and you have advantage on ability checks to detect lies you hear.

feature:feature:power-of-deduction.description: As an action, study a creature you can see within 30 feet. For 1 minute, you have advantage on attack rolls against it and on Intelligence and Charisma checks to interact with it. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:exterminator:bonus-profi.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor and martial weapons.

feature:feature:exterminator:trinkets.description: Consecrated Whetstone: as a bonus action, cast magic weapon once with no spell slot or components. Gilded Dragon Scale: as a bonus action, gain resistance to a damage type of your choice for 1 minute. Wyverntooth Necklace: after hitting with a melee weapon attack, use a bonus action to add 2d8 poison damage.

feature:feature:monster-slayer.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), restored on a short or long rest.

feature:feature:silvered-edge.description: A creature you damage with a weapon attack can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. A creature you drop to 0 hit points can't rise as undead or be revived by anything short of wish for 7 days.

feature:feature:killer-instinct.description: You can use Exploit Weakness twice per turn, but not twice against the same target.

feature:feature:inquisitor:bonus-profici.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor.

feature:feature:exorcist-s-doctrines.description: You gain proficiency in Religion and double your proficiency bonus on checks using it.

feature:feature:inquisitor:trinkets.description: Each trinket use takes a bonus action. Alabaster Balm: cast lesser restoration once with no spell slot or components. Hallowed Chalice: create one flask of holy water that turns ordinary after 24 hours; the chalice works five times before it is spent. Reliquary of Doubt: cast detect thoughts once with no spell slot or components, sensing only thoughts tied to negative emotions such as guilt, regret, or fear.

feature:feature:inquisitor:divine-strike.description: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you can add 1d6 radiant damage.

feature:feature:rote-piety.description: You can use Opportunistic Piety three times, regaining all uses on a short or long rest.

feature:feature:excommunication.description: As an action, mark a creature you can see within 60 feet; it must succeed on a Constitution or Wisdom save (your choice) or be marked for 1 minute. A marked creature can't regain hit points or have advantage on attack rolls or ability checks, and it takes 2d6 radiant damage each time it takes an action. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:foretelling.description: After each long rest, roll two d20s and record them. Before an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw by you or a creature you can see, you can swap in a foretold roll (once per turn, each roll used once). As an action you can spend a Rushed Incantation use to add another foretold roll, holding at most three; unused rolls vanish when you finish a long rest.

feature:feature:medium:trinkets.description: Dead Ringer: as an action, cast speak with dead once with no spell slot or components, asking only one question. Heptagonal Spectacles: as a bonus action, cast see invisibility once with no spell slot or components. Lucent Mirror: as a bonus action, partly enter the Ethereal Plane for up to 1 minute, moving through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if you end your turn inside one) and resisting all damage; the effect ends once you take damage.

feature:feature:forewarning-presence.description: Reroll one of your attack rolls or ability checks and keep the new result. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:whispers-from-beyond.description: Once per long rest, the GM gives you a one-word hint about your best course of action, a promising lead, or similar guidance.

feature:feature:third-eye.description: Once per long rest, cast true seeing as a bonus action with no spell slot or components.

feature:feature:occultist:trinket.description: Rune Keeper's Eyeglass: as a bonus action, you can read all writing for 1 hour.

feature:feature:occultist:pact-magic.description: You learn two warlock cantrips (a third at 10th level) and two 1st-level warlock spells, learning more per the Occultist Spellcasting table; all slots share one level and return on a short or long rest. Slots: 1 at 3rd-4th (1st level), 2 at 5th-6th (1st), 2 at 7th-12th (2nd), 2 at 13th-18th (3rd), 2 at 19th-20th (4th). Spells known: 2 at 3rd, rising by one every two levels to 10 at 19th, and 11 at 20th; each must be of your slot level or lower, and you can swap one known spell each time you gain an investigator level. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability, using your investigator save DC and attack bonus.

feature:feature:eldritch-ruin.description: When you use Exploit Weakness, you can give up its extra damage to cast a cantrip as a bonus action.

feature:feature:eyes-of-another-world.description: You see invisible creatures and objects and those on the Ethereal Plane, perceive the true form of shapechangers and magically altered creatures, and instantly know if a creature you can see is possessed.

feature:feature:maleficium.description: When you use Exploit Weakness on a creature, you can cast bestow curse on it as a bonus action with no spell slot or components, and it saves with disadvantage. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:bravado.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and double your proficiency bonus on checks using it.

feature:feature:spy:trinkets.description: Each trinket use takes a bonus action. Glass Dust: become invisible until the start of your next turn, ending early if you take damage. Horn-Rimmed Glasses: cast disguise self once with no spell slot or components. Martini Glass: cast charm person once with no spell slot or components.

feature:feature:cloak-and-dagger.description: Attacks against a creature that is surprised or hasn't yet acted in combat treat your weapon's damage dice as rolling their maximum.

feature:feature:shaken-not-stirred.description: When you fail a Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Persuasion) check, reroll it and use the new result. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:body-double.description: When you drop a Humanoid to 0 hit points, use your reaction to take on its appearance as with disguise self, while its body and all physical evidence of its death turn invisible for 8 hours. Alternatively, use an action on a Humanoid corpse dead no more than 24 hours for the same effect. Once per long rest.

feature:feature:feral-trance.description: As a bonus action, enter a trance for 1 minute: advantage on Strength checks and saves, +10 feet walking speed, advantage on Strength-based melee weapon attacks against a creature you have marked, but attacks against you have advantage. It ends early if you fall unconscious or end a turn without having attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since your last turn, and you can end it as a bonus action. Once per short or long rest.

feature:feature:predator-s-scent.description: Your marks can last up to 24 hours, and while a creature is marked you know its direction and distance as long as it is on your plane.

feature:feature:bloodwrath-guardian:evas.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:form-of-the-primal-beast.description: Once per long rest, as an action, transform for 1 minute: you get all Feral Trance benefits and 40 temporary hit points, and melee weapon hits can inflict bleeding wounds (not on Constructs, Oozes, or Undead). A creature loses 1d8 hit points at the start of each of its turns per wound and can't regain hit points while bleeding, unless it spends an action to stop all its bleeding; it can carry wounds up to your proficiency bonus.

feature:feature:battle-tactics.description: You have battle dice that recharge on a short or long rest or when you roll initiative: 2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 7th, 3d10 at 13th, 4d10 at 19th. Once per turn, spend one to perform a maneuver; maneuver save DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). Maneuvers: Bull Rush (after moving 10+ feet straight and making a melee weapon attack, bonus action to add the die to a shove's Athletics check, then knock prone or push up to 10 feet); Bulwark (after a melee hit, bonus action; reduce the next damage that creature deals you before your next turn by the die roll); Cleave (once per turn after dropping a hostile creature to 0 or scoring a melee weapon critical, move up to 15 feet and make another melee weapon attack in the same action, adding the die to damage on a hit); Heel-Cutter (add the die to an opportunity attack roll, and the target must pass a Strength save or have speed 0 until the end of its turn); Reckless Assault (gain advantage on the attack, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn); Staggering Strike (bonus action with a weapon attack against a Large or smaller creature; on a hit it must pass a Constitution save or be incapacitated until the start of your next turn).

feature:feature:grey-watchman:hold-the-l.description: When you use Warden's Grasp, one other creature you choose in the area gains +1 to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn while it stays in the area.

feature:feature:fortification-expert.description: You have advantage on checks to build fortifications, find weak points or entrances in walls and defenses, or climb built walls. Three-quarters cover counts as total cover for you.

feature:feature:mettle.description: When an effect lets you make a Constitution save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:unbreakable-sentinel.description: Once per long rest, as an action, gain for 1 minute: +2 AC, a regained battle die each time you hit a creature you have marked, and one extra reaction per round (still at most one per turn).

feature:feature:darkvision.description: You gain darkvision 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet. From 13th level, you can see through magical darkness too.

feature:feature:nightgaunt:marked-for-de.description: If a melee weapon attack against a creature you have marked deals more damage than its remaining hit points, it drops to 0 hit points.

feature:feature:undead-empathy.description: An Undead that targets you with an attack must first make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier); on a failure the attack misses, and if its Intelligence is 4 or less it is friendly to you and your allies for 1 minute.

feature:feature:gravelord.description: Once per long rest, as an action, take on undeath for 1 minute: immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition; Undying usable three times per long rest instead of once; and once per turn, when your melee weapon attack damages a hostile creature, add 4d6 necrotic damage and gain that much temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:soulblood-shaman:spellca.description: You learn two druid cantrips (a third at 10th level) and know three 1st-level druid spells, two of which must be evocation or transmutation. Later spells must be evocation or transmutation except those gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level, which can be any school; you can swap one known spell per warden level under the same rule. Slots return on a long rest; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier; attack modifier proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier). Spells known: 3 at 3rd, 4 at 4th-6th, 5 at 7th, 6 at 8th-9th, 7 at 10th, 8 at 11th-12th, 9 at 13th, 10 at 14th-15th, 11 at 16th-18th, 12 at 19th, 13 at 20th. Slots (1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 2 at 3rd; 3 at 4th-6th; 4/2 at 7th-9th; 4/3 at 10th-12th; 4/3/2 at 13th-15th; 4/3/3 at 16th-18th; 4/3/3/1 at 19th-20th.

feature:feature:soulblood.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can mark it as a reaction.

feature:feature:whispers-of-beyond.description: Spend 1 minute in contemplation when making an Intelligence or Wisdom check to gain advantage, provided your ancestors could plausibly know the answer.

feature:feature:soulblood-shaman:spell-r.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

feature:feature:ethereal-watcher.description: Once per long rest, as an action, become spirit-like for 1 minute: as a bonus action you can turn ethereal as per etherealness; you can use your bonus action to return when you use Warden's Mark or Warden's Grasp, or when you cast a spell on your turn; on returning, creatures you choose within 10 feet take 4d6 force damage; and you can cast your known 1st- and 2nd-level druid spells without spending slots.

feature:feature:roots-of-rock.description: Using Warden's Grasp gives you +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Also, until you move, hostile effects can't shove or push you unless you allow it, you have advantage on Strength saves against being knocked prone, you can't slip or fall from ledges, and you are immune to fly, levitate, and telekinesis.

feature:feature:earthshatter.description: You can use Warden's Grasp as an action instead; each affected creature must pass a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or fall prone. Uses equal your Strength modifier (minimum 1), restored on a long rest.

feature:feature:immortal-mountain.description: Once per long rest, as an action, encase yourself in stone for 1 minute: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage you take is reduced by 5, Roots of Rock applies the whole time, and you can leave a 5-foot-wide trail of difficult terrain as you move.

feature:feature:thunderblast.description: When you hit a creature you have marked with a melee weapon attack, creatures you choose within 5 feet of it take 1d8 lightning damage.

feature:feature:flash-from-above.description: While under open sky, you can use an action to produce a harmless but dramatic lightning bolt or thunderclap, even without clouds.

feature:feature:static-burst.description: When you use Warden's Grasp as a bonus action, affected creatures can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:stormlord.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Once per long rest, as an action, call lightning onto yourself for 1 minute: your flying speed doubles, and you can cast call lightning as a bonus action without a slot (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier), calling later bolts as a bonus action.

feature:feature:green-mark.description: While a creature you have marked is within 30 feet of you, the ground it moves across is difficult terrain.

feature:feature:verdant-skin.description: You gain Stealth proficiency if you lack it. As an action, wrap yourself in vines and leaves; until you move, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in vegetation.

feature:feature:form-of-the-oak-sentinel.description: Once per long rest, as an action, transform for 1 minute: your AC becomes 20 if lower, your melee attacks have 10-foot reach, and you can use Warden's Grasp as an action to make a separate attack against each affected creature.

feature:feature:house-of-bishops:spellca.description: You gain Intelligence-based slot spellcasting from the wizard spell list; slots return on a long rest. You start knowing three 1st-level wizard spells, two of which must be conjuration or evocation, and every later spell must be conjuration or evocation except the ones gained at 8th, 14th, and 20th level. Each warmage level you may swap one known wizard spell for another of a level you have slots for (subject to the same school limit). By warmage level (spells known, slots 1st/2nd/3rd/4th): 3: 3 known, slots 2; 4: 4 known, slots 3; 5: 4 known, slots 3; 6: 4 known, slots 3; 7: 5 known, slots 4/2; 8: 6 known, slots 4/2; 9: 6 known, slots 4/2; 10: 7 known, slots 4/3; 11: 8 known, slots 4/3; 12: 8 known, slots 4/3; 13: 9 known, slots 4/3/2; 14: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 15: 10 known, slots 4/3/2; 16: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 17: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 18: 11 known, slots 4/3/3; 19: 12 known, slots 4/3/3/1; 20: 13 known, slots 4/3/3/1. Warmage Edge applies to your leveled warmage spells as if they were cantrips, except magic missile.

feature:feature:arcane-study.description: Gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, or Religion.

feature:feature:mystical-companion.description: You learn find familiar as a ritual, free of your spells known, and can pick an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite form in addition to the usual forms.

feature:feature:siege-casting.description: Your warmage spells deal double damage to objects and structures. Spells of yours that use a spell attack can reach up to twice their normal range, with disadvantage on the attack beyond normal range.

feature:feature:spell-sculpting.description: When your warmage spell affects creatures you can see, choose up to your Intelligence modifier of them: they automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage where a success would normally halve it.

feature:feature:arcane-dominance.description: As a bonus action, spend spell slots totaling 6 or more levels to recover one expended use of Arcane Surge.

feature:feature:bluff.description: Gain proficiency in Deception and the playing card set (if you lack them), and you can use Intelligence instead of Charisma for Charisma (Deception) checks.

feature:feature:deck-of-fate.description: When you roll initiative, shuffle a standard 52-card deck and draw five.
